title: Humanscale QuickStand Eco Sit Stand Workstation Single, Dual, or Laptop
descriptionHtml:
Save 10% today by using "SHOP10" at checkout

Tired of your old desk?  Why are so many people still using old-style desks? Stand up and create a better posture for your back and neck with the Humanscale Eco. The next level technology in portable lightweight sit-stand workstations. 

Cleaner, a lot simpler to use and made from more eco-friendly materials than any other item before. It's a giant leap over the current sit-stand workstations offered on the market. Extremely easy to assemble, lightweight, and extremely portable. Moving from a sit to stand position has never been easier before. Revamping your ordinary desk into a healthy workplace.

QuickStand Eco is the only product in the sit or stand category to have been certified with a Declare label from The International Living Future Institute. Changing the definition of current sit or stand surfaces, QuickStand Eco is way more refined, sleeker and easier to use. It features easy setup, effortless adjustability and incomparable portability revolutionizing traditional desktop into an active and healthy workspace.

Its expert engineering offers a knob and lever-free adjustments and its self-locking mechanism keep the equipment stable and safe while you are working. Further, with great considerations to the product’s impact to the people, QuickStand echo is built with non-toxic and sustainable materials to provide added value for the users.

Its minimal aesthetic can blend into any environment and with its friendly cable management system, cords and cable can be hidden effortlessly

Features

  • Simple and easy setup for any workspace.
  • Intuitive design makes it easy to move from a sitting position to a standing.
  • Sleek clean lines make it great for home and office use.
  • Environmentally friendly hence the Eco line.
  • Cable management built internally.
  • Will not take up your whole desk with its small footprint
  • Completely assembled out of the box
  • Declare Certification with the Declare label from the ILFL

﻿Sleek and Eco Freindly 

﻿Beautifly designed it and transforms your workspace into something special.

Home and Office Use

Easily use at home or in your office at work. Creat a comfortable workspace.

  


Specifications

  • Size - H 28.1" x W 28" x 29.2"
  • Work Surface - W 28" x D 19"
  • Weight - 38.5 lbs 
  • Verticle monitor adjustment - 5'
  • Height adjustment - 18.6"

title: Triple Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Whether you are a worker, a gamer, or both, you need good tech to support your tech. A good desk setup is as important as solid computer hardware. Freedom flexibility, and versatility aren’t words that come to mind for most people as they sit at their boring old desks of the past.

Probably because they haven’t spent time with the Jestik Trinity Triple or Dual Monitor Stand. A high end, super durable monitor arm perfect for anyone with an LCD style screen, and a hunger for quality.

This monitor arm will give you the full freedom to optimize your setup to your exact specifications, making time at the desk as comfortable as possible.

A premium product at a moderate price, the Jestik Trinity Monitor Stand has something for everyone.

 

TECHNICALSPECIFICATIONS

  • Solidly built so that you can mount up to three 27" for Triple Capacity or up to two 32" for Dual Capacity.
  • Heavy-duty design and engineering to support monitors weighing up to 17 lbs.
  • Heavy-duty design and engineering to support monitors weighing up to 17 lbs.
  • Freely and quickly switch from portrait to landscape orientations with the smooth 360° turning feature
  • Enjoy clutter-free, organized work or gaming space with easy, effective cable management system.
  • Fully-customizable features add ergonomic versatility and maximum viewing comfort requiring no tools. A quick setup that will only take a few seconds of your time.
  • Fully compatible with 75×75 and 100×100 VESA monitor mount patterns.

A Smart Use of Space: Free up precious desk real-estate by mounting up to three monitors on a high quality mounting arm that looks professional, and performs with precision.

Adjustability: 360 degrees of adjustability gives you the opportunity to tilt, swivel, and change up the positioning of your screen(s) to ensure that you are perfectly comfortable in any position.

Uncompromising Stability: Work or game comfortable and confident in the fact that your gear is in safe hands. A durable mount with uncompromising stability, the Jestik Trinity mount will be able to sustain up to seventeen pounds worth of weight, keeping all of your stuff safe and sound.

Vertical Adjustability: Add ergonomic adjustability to your setup via a quick vertical adjustment feature that allows you to seamlessly keep your workspace optimized to your exact specifications.

 

KEY FEATURES

Game Safely

Whether you are powering through a big assignment at work, or just logging those sweet weekend gaming hours on your favorite computer setup, a conventional desk will be putting lots of strain on your back and neck.

Enter the Jestik Trinity monitor stand. The vertical and 360 degree adjustability features mean that you can game safely, confident and comfortable in the fact that your desk is complementing the unique comfort needs of your body.

You’ll feel the difference in your neck when the gaming binge is over.

Desk Real-estate is a Precious Commodity

Desk real estate is a precious commodity that none of us ever have quite enough of. If your work space or gaming station is in a perpetual state of disaster, you know what we are talking about.

The Jestik Trinity mount won’t be able to do anything about your pens, papers, and other debris that collects over the course of a working day. But, it will do something even better—put that bulky three monitor setup of yours out of the way, and in perfect positioning for comfortable viewing.

Quality That You Can Trust

Computer hardware is sensitive stuff. If you take your gear seriously, you are well-aware of that fact. Not all products are up to the task of taking care of your treasured computer setup. The Jestik Trinity Monitor, however, is more than up for the task. The arm itself features a hyper durable C clamp that will be able to fit securely onto virtually any desk, making the arm both versatile and safe. The simple bolt mount system makes setting up the rig as simple and quick as possible.

Clamp aside though, the mounting arm is designed to live up to the great responsibility of your trust. It is built from high-grade aluminum and stainless steel to ensure that the product will stand the test of time.

But of course, it doesn’t matter how long the arm lasts if it can’t support your stuff, right? The Trinity features a maximum weight capacity of up to seventeen pounds, meaning most monitors will be safely accommodated.

The beautiful thing about a ruggedly sturdy monitor stand? You never need to worry about how tough it is. You set the monitor up, and then you’re free to rock and roll. It takes care of the rest.

Warranty

Can you say, “lifetime warranty?” Of course, you never want to need a good warranty, but they are certainly a good thing to have. You know what sort of company offers a lifetime warranty? The kind that believes in the product they have produced.

The sturdy, consistent reliability of the Jestik is made to perform perfectly for many years to come. However, if something does happen, you deserve the peace of mind of knowing that the problem will be taken care of promptly. Enter the lifetime warranty.

If you find yourself in the unlikely position of experiencing a problem with the Jestik Trinity mount, you can redeem your warranty, and relax as the problem is taken care of for you.

No loopholes here. Just good customer service. The warranty covers all workmanship and material defects, ensuring you will be taken care of no matter what.

100% Money Back Guarantee

Sometimes even a really great product isn’t quite what you are looking for. Hey. It happens. Jestik stands by their products 100%. That is why they offer a 100% money back guarantee on this monitor arm for the first thirty days after purchase.

It’s all in keeping in line with their VIP (very important promise) customer service. If you own a Jestik product, you are guaranteed to be treated with the respect and transparency that you deserve.

title: Penclic R3 Wireless Mouse
descriptionHtml:
Dispel wrist pains forever with the Penclic R3 Wireless Mouse. With a unique pen form, Stockholm-based company Penclic claims this mouse design can prevent carpal tunnel syndrome and other repetitive strain injuries (RSI). With Penclic R3’s pen-grip design, your fingers are placed in a more comfortable position, taking away all the unnatural twisting and clicking when using a regular mouse.

The Penclic B3 has three buttons and a scroll wheel on the pen shaft. It’s compatible with both Mac and PC, without unnecessary installation of extra drivers to make it work. What’s more, this mouse can accommodate both left- and right-handed users.

Specifications:

Hand Info: Left and Right
Wired or Wireless: Wireless (with USB nano receiver)
Scroll wheel: Yes (located on the pen shaft)
Buttons: 3
Resolution: 800-1200- 1600 dpi
Height: 140 mm
Weight: 41 g
Base: 44.1 mm x 20 mm
Color: Black

Features:

Non-traditional pen-grip design for more relaxed, precise point-and- click movements.
Three buttons and a scroll wheel on the pen shaft.
No need for a mouse pad; the base works on any flat surface.
Connects through a wireless nano receiver into the USB port.
Energy-saving mode starts after 10 minutes of inactivity. Press one of the buttons to resume work.
Compatible with Windows, Mac OS, most Linux. No need to install extra drivers.
For left-handed and right-handed users.

title: HealthPostures 6300 TaskMate Go Standing Desk
descriptionHtml:
The 6300 TaskMate Go Standing Desk is a sleek, affordable way to enjoy your work throughout the day.  It lets you move from sitting to a standing position with a little less effort but letting you improve productivity and comfort

This extensive sit stand desk is full of features that sets it apart from the others.  All you need is to clamp it to your existing work surface and mount your computer monitor.  A simple press of the conveniently placed lever is all you need to move your monitor, keyboard, mouse and other items into a comfortable standing position.  Releasing the lever at the desired height causes the unit to lock into place which results to a sturdy, height adjustable computer standing desk. This comes along with a premium keyboard tray with wrist rest standard and a built-in copy holder standard.

The HealthPosture TaskMate Go 6300 is a stylish and ergonomic material which gives you the energy to focus throughout the day but also helps you maintain healthy body and mind.

 

 

 

Specifications:
       
Innovative 2-point clamping system which provides unparalleled stability
VESA standard monitor mounting
Optional dual monitor mounting accessory available


Other Features:

Adjustable monitor mount
Easy height adjustment
Auxiliary work surface included
Made in USA

title: Evoluent Wrist Comfort Mouse Pad-MP1
descriptionHtml:
Evoluent Wrist Comfort Mouse Pad

Ordinary mousepads create unnecessary friction and movements that affect pointer precision while you work. Not with Evoluent WCM. The surface is made from a proprietary low-friction material while the bottom is made from non-slip, high-traction material. The result: a smooth, flat surface that will stay in place even for hours. Its cushiony gel support is softer than other pads, helping relieve stress and discomfort. Ideal for gamers, office workers and ordinary people who use computers for hours.

Specifications

  • High precision surface for gliding your mouse.
  • Extra-large, soft wrist support.
  • Non-slip, non-sticky bottom so pad will stay in place.

title: Humanscale OfficeIQ
descriptionHtml:
HUMANSCALE OFFICEIQ

Designed to encourage balanced movement, OfficeIQ helps users make the most of their sit/stand workstations. OfficeIQ is an unobtrusive, lightweight alternative that is compatible with Humanscale’s height-adjustable solutions.

Marrying software innovation with Humanscale’s expert ergonomic design, OfficeIQ is the winner when it comes to office intelligence and the next big thing in changing traditional offices into active, intelligent workspaces. It aids in making furniture work for people and helps you make healthier decisions throughout your day even when you’re not in the office.

Recent research has revealed that alternating sitting and standing throughout the day can aid in reducing the effects of sedentary behavior such as heart disease and high blood pressure. It can also contribute to boosting energy levels, focus, and mood.


Personalized Alerts

OfficeIQ users can customize alerts that remind them when to sit or stand. Users can opt-in to set personalized goals and receive real-time feedback on their daily activity and incremental caloric expenditure. Personal information is protected by the “Don’t Be Creepy” policy.


Workplace Intelligence

Organizations can receive aggregated, anonymous insights into occupancy and utilization rates — ensuring smarter scheduling, design, and purchase decisions.


Gamify The Experience

The OfficeIQ Gateway includes an HDMI output to display the company activity dashboard for when departments want to “compete” — added incentive for users to move more!

But that's not all - we take your health seriously. The Evoluent VMCRW is your knight in shining armor against the dreaded carpal tunnel syndrome. By aligning your hand in an ergonomic position, it acts as a formidable barrier, preventing the onset of this debilitating condition.

<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer in mouse technology, the revolutionary Evoluent VerticalMouse 4 Right Mac! <div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Vertical and wireless revolution.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Evoluent VerticalMouse 4 Small Wireless, where small, vertical, and wireless unite to redefine your mouse experience. This compact marvel is specially designed for right-handers with petite hands, making it the ultimate ergonomic companion.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Revolutionary hand comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its patented Evoluent design, this mouse revolutionizes how you interact with your computer. It effortlessly cradles your hand in an upright and neutral position, eliminating the need for awkward forearm twisting.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/evoluent-mouse-evoluent-verticalmouse-4-small-wireless-2530715271273_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559203379"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">"Unleash productivity freedom.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The VerticalMouse 4 Small Wireless empowers you to break free from the limitations of traditional mice, providing a liberating experience that enhances your productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evoluent4-mouse-small-wireless-right-hand-l1atxi-1_480x480.jpg?v=1687795007"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Personalized efficiency.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The customizable buttons allow you to personalize your workflow, boosting efficiency and convenience. Every click and scroll becomes a seamless extension of your intentions, empowering you to conquer your digital realm effortlessly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Evoluent-Vertical-Mouse-Manager-2097344588-1589608913769_480x480.webp?v=1687559541"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Hand Info: Right; less than 7 inches or 178 mm long</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wireless (with USB mini receiver)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Resolution: Variable, from 800 to 2600 dpi</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Buttons: 6 programmable buttons</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sensor: Laser</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Convenient and ergonomic design; the shape is molded for uncompromised comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Six programmable buttons for more versatility and additional functionality.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No need to change grip to access the pointer speed buttons (extra low, low, medium, and high); LED indicates the current pointer speed.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Improved thumb rest and an extended flange to prevent pinky from rubbing the desk.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Powerful yet easy-to-use software driver; compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal for hand length less than 7 inches or 178 mm (from top of middle finger to the wrist crease).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Made from 30% recycled plastics.</li>
</ul>

</div>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergo bliss revolutionized.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the sleek and stunning Evoluent VM4RB, a must-have accessory that will make Mac users jump for joy! This stylish-white wonder is specifically crafted for right-handed individuals, offering a revolutionary patented design that takes ergonomic comfort to the next level..</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Blissful hand harmony.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to those dreadful carpal tunnel syndrome and pesky repetitive stress injuries caused by awkward hand positioning. With the Evoluent VM4RB, your right hand will experience pure bliss as it rests in an upright, neutral position, perfectly supported by this cutting-edge masterpiece.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/evoluent-mouse-evoluent-verticalmouse-4-right-bluetooth-2530715730025_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559203842" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/evoluent-mouse-evoluent-verticalmouse-4-right-bluetooth-2530715730025_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559203842"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Wireless wonder.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> The Evoluent VerticalMouse 4 Right Bluetooth is specially designed to complement your Mac setup flawlessly. Its seamless connectivity with Bluetooth technology ensures a hassle-free and wire-free experience, allowing you to navigate easily and gracefully.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/binye_0764_480x480.jpg?v=1687553118"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">"Intuitive control mastery.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This mouse is more than just a pretty face. Its intuitive controls and customizable buttons put you in the driver's seat, empowering you to optimize your workflow like never before. From scrolling through documents to browsing the web, every interaction becomes a delightful experience with the Evoluent VM4RB.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evoluent_evoluent_verticalmouse_4_right_bluetooth_for_mac_p5_510x630_822a3e17-db21-4ff6-be10-40f0c6460b57_480x480.jpg?v=1687552520"></div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Hand Info: Right; at least 7 inches or 178 mm long</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wireless (Bluetooth connectivity)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Resolution: Variable, from 800 to 2600 dpi</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Buttons: 6 programmable buttons</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sensor: Laser</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Convenient and ergonomic design; the shape is molded for uncompromised comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Six programmable buttons for more versatility and additional functionality.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No need to change grip to access the pointer speed buttons (extra low, low, medium, and high); LED indicates the current pointer speed.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Improved thumb rest and an extended flange to prevent pinky from rubbing the desk.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal for hand length of at least 7 inches or 178 mm (from top of middle finger to the wrist crease).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Powerful yet easy-to- use software driver; compatible with Mac OS 10.5 and higher.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comes in stylish white color.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">For Mac users.</li>
</ul>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionary comfort.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Evoluent VerticalMouse 4 Left (VM4L), the revolutionary member of the Evoluent family that breaks free from the ordinary! Prepare to embark on a journey into the realm of ergonomic bliss, where comfort and functionality blend seamlessly with an intriguingly unconventional design.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Goodbye discomfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to the risks of carpal tunnel syndrome and bid farewell to the discomfort caused by unnatural hand positioning. The VM4L's patented shape has been meticulously engineered to cradle your left hand in an upright, neutral position, ensuring a symphony of comfort and support like no other.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/evoluent-mouse-evoluent-verticalmouse-4-left-2530716352617_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559203946"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Glide to success.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Imagine gliding effortlessly across your computer screen, effortlessly maneuvering through your tasks while your hand rests in an ergonomically optimal posture. The VM4L is your gateway to a world where productivity and comfort join forces to enhance your daily computing experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/vm4L-hi_480x480.jpg?v=1687548616" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Comfort meets style.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its eye-catching aesthetics, cutting-edge functionality, and unwavering commitment to your comfort, this mouse is the perfect companion for those seeking an ergonomic revolution. Join the movement today and experience a new comfort level, one click at a time.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/I3791369-1_480x480.jpg?v=1687548851"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Hand Info: Left; at least 7 inches or 178 mm long</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wired (6.6-ft cord with USB connector)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Resolution: Variable, from 800 to 2600 dpi</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Buttons: 6 programmable buttons</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sensor: Laser</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Convenient and ergonomic design; the shape is molded for uncompromised comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Six programmable buttons for more versatility and additional functionality.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No need to change grip to access the pointer speed buttons (extra low, low, medium, and high); LED indicates the current pointer speed.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Improved thumb rest and an extended flange to prevent pinky from rubbing the desk.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Powerful yet easy-to-use software driver; compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal for hand length of at least 7 inches or 178 mm (from top of middle finger to the wrist crease).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Made from 30% recycled plastics.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize your grip.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer in ergonomic technology: the Evoluent VM4S VerticalMouse! Brace yourself for an extraordinary experience as this compact wonder takes center stage, 10% smaller than its predecessors but with no compromises on functionality.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Ergo perfection.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed with the utmost care, the Evoluent VM4S is tailored to fit perfectly in the hands of right-handed users with smaller hands. Say goodbye to discomfort and hello to a world of ergonomic bliss! Its patented Evoluent design revolutionizes how you interact with your computer, keeping your hand upright and neutral.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/41mQEz1GYxL._SL250_480x480.jpg?v=1687558632" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/41mQEz1GYxL._SL250_480x480.jpg?v=1687558632"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Compact comfort.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Evoluent VerticalMouse 4 Small effortlessly combines comfort and precision, making it a dream come true for anyone seeking a compact, ergonomic solution.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/I3791381-4_480x480.jpg?v=1687559370" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/I3791381-4_480x480.jpg?v=1687559370"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash your workflow.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With customizable buttons and a scroll wheel that responds to your every whim, you have the power to personalize your workflow like never before. Efficiency and convenience are at your fingertips.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Evoluent-Vertical-Mouse-Manager-2097344588-1589608913769_480x480.webp?v=1687559541" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Evoluent-Vertical-Mouse-Manager-2097344588-1589608913769_480x480.webp?v=1687559541"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Hand Info: Right; less than 7 inches or 178 mm long</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wired (through USB connector)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Resolution: Variable, from 800 to 2600 dpi</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Buttons: 6 programmable buttons</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sensor: Laser</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Convenient and ergonomic design; the shape is molded for uncompromised comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Six programmable buttons for more versatility and additional functionality.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No need to change grip to access the pointer speed buttons (extra low, low, medium, and high); LED indicates the current pointer speed.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">An improved thumb rest and an extended flange to prevent pinky from rubbing the desk.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Powerful yet easy-to- use software driver; compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal for hand length less than 7 inches or 178 mm (from top of middle finger to the wrist crease).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Made from 30% recycled plastics.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Editor’s Choice (with a 4.5 rating) by PCMag.com; one of the Best Products of 2011.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Captivating and transformed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Evoluent Vertical Mouse 4 Right Wireless - a revolution in an ergonomic design that will transform how you navigate your digital world. Prepare to be captivated by its strikingly unique shape and unrivaled functionality.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp"> Effortless navigation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Its ingenious construction is a true lifesaver, ensuring your hand remains in a natural, stress-free alignment as you navigate effortlessly through your tasks.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/VM4RW2_480x480.jpg?v=1687555833"></div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Wireless freedom.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the Evoluent Vertical Mouse 4 Right Wireless, you'll experience the ultimate liberation. Unleash yourself from the constraints of cables, reveling in the blissful wireless connectivity that empowers you to roam and explore without limits.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evoluent-d-wireless-q22rqc-1_480x480.jpg?v=1687556262"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Innovate, elevate, and converge.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Experience the future of mousing innovation. Elevate your efficiency. Embrace comfort like never before. Choose the Evoluent Vertical Mouse 4 Right Wireless, and step into a world where performance and well-being converge in perfect harmony.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/41vjcXf4GFL._CR3_0_1914_1080_SR684_386_480x480.jpg?v=1687556840"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Hand Info Right; at least 7 inches or 178 mm long</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless Wireless (with USB mini receiver)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Resolution: Variable, from 800 to 2600 dpi</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Buttons: 6 programmable buttons</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sensor: Laser</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Convenient and ergonomic design; the shape is molded for uncompromised comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Six programmable buttons for more versatility and additional functionality.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No need to change grip to access the pointer speed buttons (extra low, low, medium, and high); LED indicates the current pointer speed.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Improved thumb rest and an extended flange to prevent pinky from rubbing the desk.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal for hand length of at least 7 inches or 178 mm (from the top of middle finger to the wrist crease).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Powerful yet easy-to- use software driver; compatible with Windows, Mac, and Linux.<br>Made from 30% recycled plastics.</li>
</ul>

title: Humanscale CPU555
descriptionHtml:
The Humanscale CPU555 is the most impressive CPU holder on the market. Its heavy-duty construction helps to easily accommodate oversized CPUs. It can also be an ideal material for protecting mini units from workplace hazards.


It features a robust, sustainable design that is made with cold-rolled, powder-coated steel. The Humanscale CPU555 can fit oversized CPUs effortlessly while still allowing full access to cables and ports.


It also boasts an additional security option to help protect CPUs from theft or tampering, making the CPU555 a perfect solution for protecting your technology investment.

 

 

Specifications:

  • Proprietary friction locks and Quick Track for easy installation
  • Under-the-desk track provides for convenient stowing
  • One-touch 360° swivel motion
  • Elevates CPUs off the floor

FEATURES:

  • equipped to deal with the heaviest of CPUs.
  • easy-grasp handle and a 360-degree rotation for complete access to cables and ports..
  • An additional security option protects CPUs from theft or tampering.
  • contains 23% post-consumer recycled content.
  • It is made predominately of steel so it is highly recyclable.
  • It is built to last to lessen its environmental impact.

title: Humanscale Switch Mouse
descriptionHtml:
The Humanscale Switch Mouse

The Switch Mouse is a perfect mousing solution that brings unprecedented ergonomics to you and all the other users. Its design features a peripheral device, including a V-shaped-based and four-way scrolling dish to ensure exceptional comfort for users.

The Switch Mouse is specifically designed to provide you with maximum comfort. Its unique design helps reduce injury risks among computer users. Further, it is the sole mousing solution that can accommodate both left and right-handed users.

A number of hand and wrist injuries can be caused by long-term mouse use. The Switch Mouse utilizes modern ergonomics research to dramatically lessen health risks associated with long-term mouse use by creating integrated palm support to hinder wrist anchoring.


Ingenious Design

The tilted angle of the Switch Mouse, created by the V-shaped bottom of the device, positions the wrist and forearm at a 45-degree angle – a natural pronation known to minimize pressure in the carpal tunnel. The Switch Mouse’s circular five-button navigation dish minimizes tendon movement and, as an added benefit, allows for horizontal scrolling.


Ergonomic Ease

Many hand and wrist injuries can be attributed to long-term mouse use. The Switch Mouse uses the latest ergonomics research to minimize health risks associated with long-term mouse use by offering integrated palm support to prevent wrist anchoring.


Personal Adaptability

The Switch Mouse is length adjustable to fit hands of nearly any size. Its symmetric shape equally accommodates right or left-handed use of the device.

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Comfort revolution.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you tired of straining your neck and back while hunched over your laptop? Say goodbye to uncomfortable working postures with the innovative L6 Notebook Manager. Designed to prioritize your comfort and reduce the risk of long-term injury, this sleek and versatile accessory is a game-changer for laptop users everywhere.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> No more laptop hunch or awkward positions that leave you feeling sore and fatigued. With the L6, you can achieve the ideal ergonomic posture effortlessly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/humanscale-l6-notebook-manager-500x500_480x480.jpg?v=1688661829"></div>

</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Next-level laptop experience.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Equipped with a range of practical features, the L6 Notebook Manager takes your laptop experience to the next level. Its cable management system keeps your workspace tidy and organized, eliminating annoying tangled cords.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/17_humanscale_ergo_laptop_holder_1_480x480.jpg?v=1688662160"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash your potential.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Upgrade your laptop experience today and embrace the comfort, convenience, and ergonomic excellence of the L6 Notebook Manager. Say goodbye to discomfort and hello to productivity like never before. Elevate your workspace and unlock your full potential with the L6 Notebook Manager – because you deserve the best!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-laptop-holder-humanscale-l6-notebook-manager-2530719268969_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559190447"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">7.3" Height-Adjustability</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Accommodates notebooks at least 10" wide and 6" deep, and up to 1.5" thick <br>Dimensions: 10.9" D x 13.5" W x 10.1" H</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Total Convenience: At a lightweight 8.4lbs, the L6 can be used anywhere you would set up a laptop.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Personal Adjustability: The innovative clutch hinge allows the user to effortlessly adjust their laptop’s display to the height convenient for them.</li>

title: Humanscale M8 Crossbar Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
The M8 arm with crossbar features incomparable configuration for dual monitors. The side-by-side monitors can be easily adjusted for ideal alignment along with built-in-fine-tune adjustors, creating easy viewing and fine aesthetics.


The M8 arm with crossbar is capable of handling most monitors available in the market. Its high capacity construction boasts various design configurations such as quick release ball joint for easy installation and removal of  monitors. It also has an impressive cable management system to reduce cable clutter. Its 180-degree stop mechanism also helps to prevent wall damage from over rotation.


ts superb weight capacity, the M8 with optional crossover can be everybody’s solutions for a customized workspaces. In contrast to other high-capacity monitor arms with bulky designs, the M8 with crossbar allows flawless ergonomic functions and easy adjustment in a pleasing and modern articulating monitor arm.

Specifications:

Arm Style: Fixed Angled/ Dynamic

Crossbar accommodates two monitors, up to 20 lbs. each

descriptionHtml:
HUMANSCALE M10 MONITOR ARM

The M10 brings new life to being a monster of a monitor arm. Holding up to 48 pounds is unheard of in Monitor Arms. The new revolutionary monitor arm improves your workspace by raising the monitor up and out of the way and clearing up much-needed desk space. While keeping an elegant and beautiful design. The new Humanscale M10 features a new patented Weight-Compensating spring and Smart stop functionality. The M10 enables you to make your work area flexible in an ever-changing environment.

  

Sleek, Safe Design

M10’s Smart Stop feature allows the user to stop each joint anywhere along its rotation to prevent monitor or arm overhand on the desk edges. In addition, a built-in Counterbalance Indicator lets the installer counterbalance the monitor weight without a monitor.

 

Ease-of-Use and Agility

With innovative features like its Compensator Mechanism and Self-Lubricating Precision Bearings, M10 allows users to effortlessly adjust their monitor(s) to their optimal ergonomic position while also providing top-to-bottom cable management.

 

Integrated Technology

M10 is compatible with Humanscale’s revolutionary docking station, M/Connect 2, to eliminate desktop cables and provide a more streamlined workspace. It is also compatible with M/Power – a USB Type-A and Type-C charging station that offers convenient, high-speed charging for personal devices

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 7509 Data Entry Monitor Arm and Keyboard Tray

Introducing the ultimate data entry workstation for those who demand the best - the 7509 Data Entry Monitor Arm! This remarkable piece of technology offers unparalleled flexibility and convenience, making it the perfect choice for space-sensitive environments where multiple users need to access a computer while standing.

The 7509 Data Entry Monitor Arm boasts a keyboard tray that can be easily folded flat when not in use, allowing you to maximize your workspace. Its slide-out mouse tray is also designed to accommodate both left- and right-handed users, ensuring maximum comfort and efficiency.

Perfect for a variety of industries, including medical, dental, retail, and manufacturing, the 7509 Data Entry Monitor Arm is an ideal solution for those who require a versatile and reliable workstation. Supporting weights of 6-23 lbs, this powerful arm comes complete with Flexmount, making it easy to install and use right out of the box.

So why settle for a subpar workstation when you can have the best? Choose the 7509 Data Entry Monitor Arm and experience the ultimate in flexibility, convenience, and comfort.

  • Built-in mouse tray accommodates left- and right-handers.

  • Monitor mount offers 18" of vertical range and 27" of horizontal range.
  • Arm rotates 360 degrees at three joints.

descriptionHtml:

No need to sweat if you want to set-up your dual monitors by yourself with ease. With Better Balance mechanism, you can adjust the position of your dual monitors smoothly. Moreover, view your monitors in both landscape and portrait modes.

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Streamline your setup.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you tired of wrestling with bulky monitors and cluttered workspaces? It's time to upgrade to the 7500 Deluxe Monitor Arm! This game-changing product takes the hassle out of mounting screens with its sleek and intuitive design. Say goodbye to straining your back and hello to effortless adjustability.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Simplify your space.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Thanks to its integrated cable management system, you can finally enjoy a clean and organized workspace. And with the ability to easily raise, lower, and rotate your monitor with just one hand, you'll wonder how you ever worked without it.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">

<h3 class="titleComp">Simple and compact. <br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">When you're not using it, simply fold it up to a compact 4.5 inches of space, freeing up even more room on your desk. And with six different mounting configurations provided by FLEXmount, you'll be able to find the perfect fit for your workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/innovative-monitor-arm-flat-white-2-13-lb-monitor-innovative-7500-heavy-duty-deluxe-single-monitor-arm-2530726084713_1800x1800.png?v=1559187181"></div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/innovative-monitor-arm-vista-black-2-13-lb-monitor-innovative-7500-heavy-duty-deluxe-single-monitor-arm-2530725986409_1800x1800.png?v=1571421423"></div>

seo.description: Elevate your workspace with the 7500 Deluxe Monitor Arm! No more screen mounting problems, cluttered wires, or awkward positioning. Get yours now!

title: Hat Design Works 7000 Articulating Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
The best-selling 7000 Articulating Monitor Arm suspends your flat monitor for a more

comfortable viewing and clutter-free working desktop.

This monitor arm has FLEXmount so that you can mount your monitors in six different ways: desk edge, wall, thru-desk, side bolt, grommet, or reverse wall. Should you change your mind after a few months, you can just change the mounting without buying anything.

With choices of three models, you can mount monitors 2 to 31 pounds in weight. For a clutter-free space, there is an integrated cable organizer and the ability to retract the arm to a mere 3” to save more space. The counterbalance adjustment system allows you to rotate and adjust your monitor with just a fingertip.

All these features combine to make 7000 an excellent choice for ergonomics and functionality in the office.

Specifications

Vertical range: 8” (20.3 cm) to 16" (40.6 cm)

Horizontal range: Up to 24" (61 cm); arm retracts to about 3"

Weight capacity:

  • 7000-500: supports monitors 2-13 lbs (0.9-5.9 kg)
  • 7000-800: supports monitors 7.5-25lbs (3.4-11.3 kg)
  • 7000-1000: supports monitors 12-31 lbs (5.4-14.1 kg)

Monitor tilt: 200 degrees

Monitor view: Portrait or landscape

Rotation: 360 degrees at 3 joints

Mounting options: FLEXmount, Slatwall, wall, thru-desk

VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm

Color: Flat White, Silver, Vista Black

seo.description: Declutter your workspace with the 7000 Articulating Monitor Arm. Six mount options for comfortable and flexible viewing.

title: Hat Design Works 5900 EVO Articulating Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Mount your flat monitor to save precious desk space, without ignoring ergonomics. The EVO Articulating Monitor Arm is packed with high-quality features—an excellent cable management system; quick installation capabilities; sleek and modern design that will fit well in your working space.

At its core is Better Balance, a mechanism to support your monitor with true constant force. The result? A fluid motion so you can effortlessly position your monitor across the arm’s entire range.

And did we say it is award-winning? With the 2017 Red Dot Product Design and the Best of NeoCon Silver 2016 awards, you’ll never go wrong with the EVO Articulating Monitor Arm.

Features

Integrated cable management system to keep your working space clutter-free from wires and cables

Quick-install mechanism with its durable 75-mm and 100-mm VESA adapters for faster installation

180-degree rotation stops to prevent your monitor arm from banging into walls and screens

Tension adjustment at each joint

 

Specifications

Vertical range: 9.2” (23.4 cm) to 19.6” (26.4 cm)
Horizontal range: 3.8” (9.7 cm) to 18.0” (45.7 cm)
Weight capacity: Supports monitors 1-12 lbs (0.5-5.4 kg)
Monitor tilt: 140 degrees up, 45 degrees down
Monitor pivot: 90 degrees to the left, 90 degrees to the right
Monitor view: Portrait or landscape
Mounting option: Clamp to desk edge, grommet, thru-desk
VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm
Color: Flat White, Silver, Vista Black

title: WorkRite Adjustable Corner Diagonal-179ACD-B
descriptionHtml:
WorkRite 179ACD Adjustable Corner Diagonal

Introducing the ultimate solution for cramped workspaces - The Adjustable Diagonal Corner Sleeve! Say goodbye to wasted space and hello to maximum productivity with this game-changing accessory. Designed to fit seamlessly into the inside corner of your l-shaped desk, it transforms previously unusable space into a functional workspace.

Compatible with Workrite keyboard trays, Pinnacle 2, and Pinnacle AD arms, this versatile corner sleeve is a must-have for anyone looking to optimize their workstation. With a keyboard arm and platform that offer height adjustment capabilities, you can easily achieve the perfect ergonomic setup for your needs.

Whether you're working from home or in a bustling office, the Adjustable Diagonal Corner Sleeve will revolutionize the way you work. Don't let tight spaces hold you back - upgrade your workstation today and experience the ultimate in comfort and efficiency.

Specifications

  • Converts 90º & curved corners (up to 9") to usable work areas
  • Allows use of adjustable arm and keyboard platform when the natural corner of the work surface does not permit it
  • Adjusts to fit 1" to 2.25" thick worksurfaces
  • Clamping design eliminates spacers, saving installation time
  • Works with the Pinnacle 2 and Pinnacle AD arms
  • Works with the following Workrite platforms: 2180S, 2181SN, 2100FT, 317RL, 2110D, 2110RL, 180
  • Dimensions: 12" W × 1.75" H
Available in black

seo.title: he Adjustable Diagonal Corner Sleeve is ideal for tight workspaces where every inch of space counts. A keyboard arm and platform provides height adjustability and will absolutely convert your workstation into a ergonomic one.

title: Hat Design Works Winston Workstation for Apple iMac
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Winston Workstation for Apple iMac

Good news for Apple users. With the Winston Workstation® for Apple iMac, it’s now time to turn your desk into a healthy workspace. Do your work while standing, and prevent those adverse conditions linked with excessive sitting.

This Winston Workstation® is made for single and dual monitor set-ups. If you’re using one iMac monitor, choose either the freestanding version (compatible with the iMac stand) or the VESA-compliant model. Also, you can mount two iMac monitors simultaneously with the dual VESA-compatible model.

A locking cylinder is present to mount both monitor and desk with stability. The desk’s surface is big enough to hold your keyboard, mouse, and other desk accessories. The built-in cable organizer ensures your desk remains clutter-free. With the free-standing base, you can retrofit this workstation in any corner of the office.

The Winston Workstation® for Apple iMac is ideal for graphic design studios, architecture firms, and other offices with iMac users.
The Winston Workstation® for Apple iMac can support up to two monitors. The single monitor WNST-APL- 1 model is available in two versions: freestanding and VESA-compatible. The dual monitor WNST-APL- 2 is available in VESA-compatible version.

Around 17” height adjustment range and a locking cylinder to keep both monitor and workstation in place. No need to adjust the parts manually.

Spacious worksurface. The large desk surface and convenient storage tray provide adequate room for keyboard, mouse, tablet, and other desk accessories. Everything you’ll need is within your reach.

Integrated cable management system to keep your working space clutter-free from wires and cables.

Two mounting configurations: the freestanding base and the desk clamp.

Available in white color that complements the iMac’s appearance.

Winston Workstation® is designed and assembled in the US.

Specifications


Vertical range: 17” (43.2 cm)
Weight capacity: WNST-APL- 1: supports 10-26 lbs (4.5-11.8 kg)
WNST-APL- 2: supports 15-36 lbs (6.8-16.3 kg)
Desk surface dimensions: 30.0” (76.2 cm) W x 23.0” (58.4 cm) D
Mounting options: Freestanding, desk clamp
Versions: WNST-APL- 1: freestanding and VESA-compatible WNST-APL- 2: VESA-compatible
VESA Compatibility: Yes (Apple VESA adapter kit not included)
Color Flat White

title: Hat Design Works Winston Desk
descriptionHtml:
The Winston Desk

Turn your desk into a standing one in just a few minutes. The Winston Desk has a gas-assisted lift mechanism so you can easily switch between sitting and standing modes. It houses an upper surface for your display monitor and a retractable lower deck for a keyboard and mouse. It is a simple sit-stand solution for your office.

Comes Fully Assembled

Upon delivery, The Winston Desk comes fully assembled, so you don’t need to install or assemble anything. Just put the monitors on top and place the keyboard and other accessories in the lower deck, and you can now start your work immediately.

Easy Height Adjustment

Easily raise and lower the Winston Desk to the exact height that you would like by simply pulling on the handle and releasing it to the desired height.

Rock Solid Work Surface

Its solid base ensures a stable work surface along its vertical range. It also makes the Winston Desk strong enough to support up to 35 lbs of total weight.

  • Available in three versions: 36", 36” corner, and 42". (The 36" corner model, WNST-DESKCR-36, is specially designed for corners or L-shaped desks.)
  • A gas-assisted lifting mechanism for raising and lowering the desk.
  • The upper desk surface has a 0.5″ bolt-thru hole and a reinforced edge. An optional monitor arm can then be mounted thru-desk or with a desk clamp.
  • The lower work surface that holds the keyboard and mouse can be retracted for comfort.
  • Solid base provides a stable work surface along the vertical range of the Winston Desk.

 

Specifications

  • Vertical range: 5.4” to 18.4”
  • Weight capacity: Supports up to 35 lbs (15.8 kg)
  • Base dimensions: 34.6” W x 24.3” D
  • Desktop dimensions: WNST-DESK- 36 and WNST-DESKCR- 36: 36.0” W x 27.4”-30.9” D WNST-DESK- 42: 42.0” W x 27.4”-30.9” D
  • Desktop thickness: 0.6” (minimum 1.5” off desk)
  • Color: WNST-DESK- 36 and WNST-DESK- 42: White, Black
  • WNST-DESKCR- 36: Black

title: HealthPostures 6350 TaskMate Go Dual Monitor Standing Desk
descriptionHtml:
The 6350 TaskMate Go dual monitor standing desk is a stylish but cheap way to appreciate a fit and active work style you have always been longing for.  It helps you move yourself up from a sit to stand position with less effort but with complete comfortability.

The combined TaskMate Go with the dual monitor arm provides you the sit stand desk just right for you and how you work.  Just fasten it to your existing work area and simply mount your monitor.  A slight press of the handy placed lever is all you need to move your monitor, keyboard, mouse and other items into a convenient standing position.  Setting free of the lever at the preferred height causes the unit to lock into place giving you sturdy, dual monitor adjustable standing desk. It can make you simply move your sitting position to standing for extended work time.

The HealthPosture TaskMate Go 6350 gives you the energy you need for the entire day of work as it also helps you with health-related issues.

Specifications:
Innovative 2-point clamping system which provides unparalleled stability
VESA standard monitor mounting

Other Features:
Dual monitor set-up
No tension springs to adjust
Made in USA

title: Hat Design Works Winston E Sit-Stand Workstation Single, Dual, And Triple
descriptionHtml:
Winston Electric

Don't worry about lifting your sit-stand workstation again. The Winston Electric offers the best in class sit-to-stand experience. The Winston E features a buttery smooth electric motor and on-touch programming for easy height adjustment. Easily save your favorite sit-to-stand position for your ideal height.

 

Great Features

The Winston E comes loaded with tons of features right out of the box. Designed and engineered with ease of you and full mobility in mind. The engineers have thought about every detail for Winston so you are free to think about your tasks at hand.

 

Monitor Adjustability

Depth adjustment is key in using a dual monitor setup. The adjustments allow the users to ergonomic place the monitors for the best viewing angle.

 

Effortless movement

With the simple one-touch button, you can easily lower and raise your screens from a sitting position to a standing one.


Easy Install

The Winston-E can be easily placed in small offices in less than 20 minutes. It can remember your preferences, so you can quickly adjust the height of the sit and stand modes of this mount. While the desk surface is compact, it’s still spacious to accommodate your keyboard, mouse, and storage tray. The built-in cable organizer ensures your desk remains clutter-free.


2016 Product Innovations Awards

Winston-E received the Grand Prize in Buildings Magazine’s 2016 Product Innovations Awards. This recognition is a testament to the innovative design and functionality of this electric desk converter.

 

Features

  • Winston-E with Compact Work Surface comes in single, dual, or triple monitor setups. For multiple monitor set-ups, individual monitors can be independently adjusted for comfortable viewing.
  • Electrically powered for one-touch height adjustment and bigger weight capacity. Also included is a programmable control for storing height parameters for sit and stand modes.
  • A compact work surface suited for limited office areas, yet still provides adequate room for keyboard, mouse, and storage tray. Everything you’ll need is within your reach.
  • Integrated cable management system to keep your working space clutter-free from wires and cables.
  • Winston Workstation® is designed and assembled in the US.

 

Specifications

Weight capacity:

  • WNSTE-1- CW: supports up to 40 lbs (18 kg)
  • WNSTE-2- CW: supports up to 40 lbs (18 kg)
  • WNSTE-3- CW: supports up to 40 lbs (18 kg)
  • WNSTE-2- CW can mount two monitors up to 30”wide.
  • WNSTE-3- CW can mount three monitors up to 24” wide.

 

  • Monitor view: Portrait or landscape
  • Desk surface dimensions: 30.0” (76.2 cm) W x 16.0” (40.6 cm) D
  • Mounting options: Freestanding, desk clamp, thru-mount
  • VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm (VESA adapters included)
  • Color: Gray Duotone
  • Vertical range: 18.4” (46.7cm)

title: Humanscale Quickstand Lite
descriptionHtml:
Humanscale QUICKSTAND LITE

The Red Dot Award-winning QuickStand Lite transforms any fixed-height desk into an active one. Its minimalist aesthetic complements any office environment and supports a variety of hardware. An adjustable keyboard and monitor arm platform provides exceptional stability while typing. An innovative counterbalance mechanism enables users to transition from sitting to standing positions with ease and encourages more movement—creating a truly active workspace.

Ease Of Movement

QuickStand Lite features an innovative counterbalance mechanism that enables users of varying heights to transition from sitting to standing positions with ease, offering 20” of total height range and an added 5.5” of vertical monitor adjustment. Its effortless functionality encourages users to be active throughout the day.

Strength and Stability

QuickStand Lite’s adjustable keyboard and monitor arm platform provides exceptional stability while typing. The main assembly holds single or dual monitors up to 25 lbs. and can be converted to either configuration with minimal tools and components.

Versatility

QuickStand Lite can be attached to any existing, fixed-height desk. Its minimal footprint frees up space, and its unique adjustability is perfect for home or corporate workspaces, temporary hot desks, collaborative workstations and check-in points.

Features and Specifications

  • Vertical height range of 20"
  • Additional 5.5" of vertical monitor adjustment
  • Gray and Black finishes available
  • Four monitor mount options, including single and dual monitors
  • Made with highly recyclable aluminum parts
  • Three base mount options

Keyboard and Monitor Mount Specifications: 

Base Mount Options:

 

Grommet Mount: Clamp inserted into grommet hole on worksurface

Clamp Mount (shown in pictures): used on side/end of a worksurface

 

Monitor Mount Options:

 

Light Monitor Mount: holds a single monitor up to 11 lbs.

Heavy Monitor Mount: holds a single monitor between 12-22 lbs.

Standard Crossbar: holds two monitors side by side with a maximum size of 24" each and a combined weight of 22 lbs.

Wide Crossbar: holds two monitors side by side with a maximum size of 27" each and a combined weight of 22 lbs.

 

Finish Options:

Product Care

To clean surfaces use mild liquid soap and water. Gently wipe thoroughly with a soft cloth to remove dirt and stains. Dry gently with a dry soft cloth.

title: HealthPostures 6200 TaskMate Journey Standing Desk
descriptionHtml:
The TaskMate Journey electric standing desk conveys substantial ergonomic abilities while it’s electric lift system produces the easy press of a button for a quick turn from sitting to standing.

This flexible sit to stand workstation is suitable on top of any desk, place or any corner, best option for workplaces, home offices, cubicles and more.  The exceptional keyboard procedure and all-in-one keyboard tray allows you an array of ergonomic positions to maintain the serious professional mobile while working.

The HealthPosture TaskMate Journey is the excellent addition to your working environment as it goes together with your health, happiness and productivity.

 




Features:

  • 14” x 11” work surface
  • Easy to push toggle switch in the center of unit
  • All-in-one keyboard tray
  • Double-jointed keyboard mechanism
  • Can lift up to 75lbs
  • Can accommodate a dual monitor arm
  • Proudly made in the USA

Travel Range 14”

Tabletop 6” from surface in the lowest position

Shipping Weight 70 lbs

<h3>Retro bliss reimagined.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Step back in time and immerse yourself in the nostalgia of a bygone era with the Matias Mini Tactile Pro Keyboard for Mac - a keyboard that effortlessly evokes the charm of vintage typewriters, not once, but twice over!</p>

</h3>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Serenity in keystrokes.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the keyboard that speaks volumes through its silence - the Matias Quiet Pro Keyboard for Mac. Elevate your typing experience to a new level of tranquility without compromising on performance. Designed with Mac users in mind, this mechanical marvel redefines what a keyboard can be.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Whispering cloud productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Imagine the sensation of typing on a cloud, where every keystroke is a whisper of productivity. Gone are the days of the disruptive clicky-clacky noise that disrupts your flow and draws unwanted attention. With the innovative Quiet Click key switch technology, embrace the perfect harmony of tactile feedback and serene quietness.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/81db5dMJodL_480x480.jpg?v=1692901120"></div>

</h3>

</div>
</div>

</div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Dimensions: 18.1” x 6.5” x 1.4”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wired (through USB connector)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 2.75 lbs 2.75 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Gray and Black</li>

</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Traditionally-sculpted keytops and the new Quiet Click mechanical switches. For unparalleled comfort, without sacrificing tactile feedback.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Special anti-ghosting circuitry lets our keyboard keep up with fast typing.</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Function keys for controlling screen brightness, volume, iTunes, and more.</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Petite powerhouse.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Matias Mini Quiet Pro Keyboard for PC: Your Productivity Powerhouse in a Petite Package!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Max productivity and min space.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Tired of wrestling for space on your desk? Say hello to the ultimate solution: the Matias Mini Quiet Pro Keyboard for PC. This isn't just a keyboard; it's a space-saving marvel engineered to turbocharge your productivity while embracing your small workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/5ba4abe2-a37b-42c6-a5cd-727aa9c47282.__CR0_0_300_300_PT0_SX300_V1_480x480.jpg?v=1692897879"></div>

</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Efficiency meets elegance.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Unleash your efficiency without sacrificing style or function. Bid farewell to the numeric pad that always took up more room than it deserved.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/FK303QPC_header_1_480x480.jpg?v=1692898101"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Tripling your connectivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But that's not all – we've taken versatility to new heights. With not one, not two, but three USB 2.0 ports, this keyboard effortlessly transforms into your connectivity command center.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/81r3Pg2x5BL._AC_UF894_1000_QL80_480x480.jpg?v=1692898596"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Dimensions: 13.2” x 6.5” x 1.4”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wired (through USB connector)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 2.75 lbs 2.06 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Traditionally-sculpted keytops and the new Quiet Click mechanical switches. For unparalleled comfort, without sacrificing tactile feedback.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Special anti-ghosting circuitry lets our keyboard keep up with fast typing.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Laser-etched keys. Characters are burned into the keys, so they won&#39;t wear off over time.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The absence of numeric pad allows mouse proximity.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Dedicated keys for Volume Up, Volume Down, and Mute.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">3 integrated USB 2.0 ports.</li>
</ul>

seo.description: Unleash typing bliss with Matias Ergo Pro for Win - an ergonomic mini keyboard with mechanical keys for ultimate comfort & limitless freedom!

title: Matias Ergo Pro for Mac, Low Force Edition
descriptionHtml:
The Matias Ergo Pro for Win now in Low Force edition. It carries linear mechanical switches, the same kind you will find in stenotype machines. If you’re a Mac user who types fast and prefers a smooth feel, this Ergo Pro is going to be a great pick.

Unlike other mini keyboards, the Ergo Pro gives more freedom. As this keyboard can be separated into two halves, it’s like you're using a full-sized keyboard. True to the Matias name, this Ergo Pro gives amazing tactile feedback, great comfort, and a quiet typing experience.

Specifications:

Dimensions: 20” x 9” x 2”
Wired or Wireless: Wired (through USB connector)
Weight: 2.75 lbs 4.75 lbs
Color: Black

Features:

Linear mechanical switches designed for low force and linear profile. For a fast, smooth typing experience.
The adjustable split design provides room for typing and better navigation.
Laser-etched keys. Characters are burned into the keys, so they won't wear off over time.
The absence of numeric pad allows mouse proximity.
With leg supports (for tilting and tenting) and removable palm supports.
Dedicated keys for 4 most important keyboard shortcuts: Undo, Cut, Copy, and Paste.
3 integrated USB 2.0 ports.

seo.description: Experience smooth and fast typing with the Matias Ergo Pro for Win in Low Force edition. Linear mechanical switches and innovative split design.

descriptionHtml:
