<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Space-saving stability.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SpaceArm Stubby Single Arm – the perfect solution to set your monitor at a fixed height while adding a touch of style to your workspace. Designed for those who crave stability and versatility, this sleek and compact arm is a game-changer, especially in settings where space is at a premium.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Limitless customization.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the ST01, you have a world of options at your fingertips, allowing you to customize it according to your unique requirements. Choose from a range of mounting options, ensuring that your monitor stays securely in place, giving you peace of mind and a clutter-free desk. Whether you prefer a desk clamp, grommet mount, or wall mount, the ST01 covers you.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_480x480.jpg?v=1684962315" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Color your creativity.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">We believe that your workspace should reflect your individuality. That's why we offer a selection of vibrant colors, so you can personalize your arm to match your style and create an environment that sparks creativity. From classic black to sleek silver, the ST01 adds a dash of personality to any workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/101_cb7d6361-dc36-4475-bc1e-c705cf03072b_480x480.jpg?v=1684963307"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Style meets stability.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Don't compromise on stability, style, or space efficiency. Choose the SpaceArm Stubby Single Arm and literally take your workspace to new heights! Elevate your monitor, elevate your work. Get the ST01 today and experience the perfect blend of functionality and aesthetics.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ST01CC-PLT-Front-View-2_480x480.jpg?v=1685730275"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range (Standard) 8.5” (21.6 cm) without any extender tube</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range Up to 8.2” (20.8 cm); folds to 2.5” (6.4 cm) when not in use</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 230º-360º at two different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through, C-clamp, Large C-clamp, Grommet, SpaceBeam 1 Single Resolve.<br>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Keep single monitors out of the way to increase workflow area.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Non-gas lift mechanism.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change the universal mount for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks the SpaceArm to the hub); adjustable rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop that prevents monitor collisions.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Sustainable space upgrade.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SpaceArm Single Standard Monitor Arm, your eco-friendly solution for a clutter-free, ergonomic workspace! Crafted from recycled aluminum, this sleek, sturdy monitor arm is visually appealing and environmentally conscious.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Perfect posture partner.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to the woes of poorly positioned monitors causing occupational disorders. With the SA01, you can effortlessly find the perfect ergonomic spot for your monitor, ensuring comfort and productivity throughout the day.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-single-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-single-standard-arm-2559556649065_1800x1800.png?v=1559202386" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-single-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-single-standard-arm-2559556649065_1800x1800.png?v=1559202386"></div>

<div class="textBlock">

<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Customized work wonder.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> We understand that every workspace is unique, so we offer a range of customized sets tailored to your specific needs. Whether you're a multitasker craving extra-screen real estate or a minimalist seeking simplicity, we have the perfect setup just for you.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_480x480.jpg?v=1684962315" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_480x480.jpg?v=1684962315"></div>

<p class="paragraph">With the SpaceArm Single Standard Monitor Arm, you'll enjoy a clutter-free desk, enhanced productivity, and a greener future. Join the eco-conscious revolution and experience the perfect blend of functionality and sustainability. Upgrade your workspace today and let the SA01 redefine the way you work!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-single-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-single-standard-arm-2559556092009_1800x1800.png?v=1559202386" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-single-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-single-standard-arm-2559556092009_1800x1800.png?v=1559202386"></div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: (Standard) Up to 18.25” (46.5 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: Up to 20.5” (52.1 cm); folds to 2.5” (6.4 cm) when not in use</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 320º-360º- 360º at 3 different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through, C-clamp, Large C-clamp, Grommet</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA Compatibility: Yes (75-mm x 75-mm, 100-mm x 100-mm, 100-mm x 200-mm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust height +/- 7” from the center up to 18.25”. Height can be added with optional 4”, 6”, and 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. An optional Quick Change universal mount is available for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include: a security screw (locks the monitor to</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">security set screw (locks SA01 to the hub); adjustable rotational knobs at each joint; and a 180-degree rotational stop to prevent monitor collisions.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">With high-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">A flexible and adaptable mounting technology to keep up with the changing times.</li>
</ul>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Rise and thrive.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SP01, the ultimate solution to elevate your monitor game to new heights! Building upon the incredible features of its shorter sibling, the ST01, the SP01 takes monitor positioning to a whole new level.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Reach new heights.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to the limitations of traditional monitor stands and embrace the power of the SpaceArm Stubby Plus Single Arm. This sleek and sturdy arm allows you to securely fix your monitor at the perfect height while providing an impressive horizontal reach. Whether you need to create a dedicated space for a single monitor or if your desk real estate is limited, the SP01 covers you!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/210KE5KuC9L_480x480.jpg?v=1685642485" alt="" data-mce-selected="1" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/210KE5KuC9L_480x480.jpg?v=1685642485"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Customize and conquer.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The SP01 is all about customization and adaptability. With a wide range of arm-to-monitor mounts and arm-to-surface mounts to choose from, you can personalize your setup to suit your unique office needs. From a single-arm configuration to a multi-monitor extravaganza, the SP01 offers endless possibilities.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_480x480.jpg?v=1684962315"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Simplicity unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the SP01, you'll experience the joy of mounting your monitor without compromising your workspace. No more cluttered desks or limited viewing angles! Immerse yourself in a clean, organized environment that boosts your productivity and enhances your overall work experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SA01XPCC-PLT-Back-View-1-1_480x480.jpg?v=1685133625"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: (Standard) 8.5” (21.6 cm) without any extender tube</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: Up to 14.8” (37.6 cm); folds to 2.5” (6.4 cm)<br>when not in use</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 230º-230º- 360º at 3 different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Non-gas lift mechanism. The standard height is fixed at 8.5”. If you need additional height, choose any of the 4”, 6”, or 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extends up to 14.8” horizontally. Occupies only 2.5” in folded position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change universal mount for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SP01 to the hub); adjustable rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop that limits SPO1’s motion and prevents monitor collisions.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3> Redefining workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary SA01XP SpaceArm Extended Single Arm—the ultimate solution for a truly ergonomic workspace. Building upon the exceptional foundation of the basic SA01 arm, this cutting-edge innovation takes flexibility and customization to new heights.<br></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Perfect posture power.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its enhanced horizontal reach and an additional joint of articulation, the SA01XP empowers you to achieve the perfect positioning for your single monitor. Say goodbye to those long hours of compromising your posture and hello to a healthier, more productive work experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SA01XPQCGT_480x480.png?v=1685053558"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Tailored for you.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed with your needs in mind, the SA01XP offers an array of customization options that cater to every office requirement. Whether you're a meticulous multitasker, a creative genius, or a data-driven professional, rest assured that there is a SA01XP setup that suits your unique preferences and workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/101_cb7d6361-dc36-4475-bc1e-c705cf03072b_480x480.jpg?v=1684963307"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless Productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Unleash your productivity potential as you effortlessly glide your monitor to the ideal viewing angle, reducing strain on your neck, shoulders, and eyes. The SA01XP is your personal ergonomic assistant, ensuring you stay comfortable and focused throughout the day.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-single-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-extended-single-arm-2559550095465_1800x1800.png?v=1559202867"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: (Standard) Up to 20” (50.8 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: Up to 27” (68.6 cm); folds to 2.5” (6.4 cm) when not in use</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 230º-230º- 360º-360º at 4 different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through, C-clamp, Large C-clamp, Grommet.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust height +/- 7” from the center up to 20”. Height can be added with optional 4”, 6”, and 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change universal mount for quick switching of monitors</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SpaceArm to hub); adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop to prevent monitor collisions.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

title: Hat Design Works Winston Workstation Desk Converter
descriptionHtml:
Innovative Winston Sit Stand Desk Converter

Convert your working desk now into a Winston sit-stand workstation desk converter, and get the benefits of standing. The Winston Workstation Freestanding Sit-Stand can support one to four monitors and has a push-button mechanism for height-adjustable flexibility.

Plus, standing provides health benefits by preventing diseases associated with sitting too much.

 

Winston Workstation Single Converter Specifications:

  • The Sit Stand Desk Converter has a Vertical range 17” (43.2 cm) - change

Winston Workstation Desk Weight capacity

  • WNST-1- CW: Single supports 7-20 lbs (3.2-9.1 kg)
  • WNST-2- CW: Dual supports 10-26 lbs (4.5-11.8 kg)
  • WNST-3- CW: Triple supports 15-36 lbs (6.8-16.3 kg)
  • WNST-4- FS-M- SBLK: Quad supports 24-40 lbs (10.9-18.1kg)

Winston Sit Stand Workstation Monitor size capacity 

  • WNST-2- CW can mount two monitors up to 30” wide.
  • WNST-3- CW and WNST-4- FS-M- SBLK can mount monitors up to 24” wide.

Winston Workstation Desk Converter Capabilities

  • Monitor view: Portrait or landscape
  • Desk surface dimensions: 30.0” (76.2 cm) W x 17.0” (43.1 cm) D
  • Mounting options: Freestanding, desk clamp, thru-mount
  • VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm (VESA adapters included)
  • Color: Flat White, Silver, Vista Black

Winston Workstation Desk Converter Features:

  • The Monitor stand can support up to four monitors.
  • Around 17” height adjustment range and a locking cylinder to keep both monitor and workstation in place. No need to adjust the parts manually.
  • Quick, easy monitor installation. Just attach, adjust or remove monitors at the face of the beam.
  • A compact work surface suited for limited office areas, yet still provides adequate room for keyboard, mouse, and storage tray. Everything you’ll need is within your reach.
  • Integrated cable management system to keep your working space clutter-free from wires and cables.
  • A variety of mounting configurations, including the freestanding weighted base. Also ideal for glass desks as there is no need for drilling.

Winston Workstation Desk Converter is designed and assembled in the US.


Winston Workstation Build Steps

Winston Workstation STEP 1

Choose Your Monitor Solution: Winston can support one, two, three, or four monitors. If you want an electric version go here

Winston Electric Sit Stand Workstation

 

Winston Workstation STEP 2

Choose Your Work Surface.: Compact work surface 17" depth or standard worksurface 23" depth.

 

Winston Workstation STEP 3

Chose Your Color: Pick your favorite color from white, silver, or black. If you are looking for a mac compatible version go here

Winston Workstation For Mac Monitors

 

Winston Workstation STEP 4

Choose from Optional Accessories Optional accessories include: Clamp Mount, Thru-Desk Mount, Laptop Holder, Imac Stand, and an Anti-Fatigue Mat. Please request a quote for these options.


Winston Workstation Video

The lift-and-lock adjustment smoothly works so you can get the desired height for your desk and monitor. The compact work surface is ideal for small offices yet still has ample space enough to accommodate your keyboard, mouse, and storage tray. The built-in cable organizer ensures your desk remains clutter-free. With the free-standing base, you can just place this workstation anywhere in the office without the need for clamping, drilling, or additional mounting accessories.



Winston Workstations VIEWING ANGLES

Easily adjust your monitors! When using dual monitors position them perfectly to your liking. Don't settle for anything less.


Winston Workstation WORKSURFACE

If you need a large work surface or a smaller one Winston has your back. With a 30" Width worksurface and up to 24" diameter you will have plenty of room for all your things.

 

Winston Workstation Dimensions

WINSTON Workstation VS. THE COMPETITION

There are a lot of choices out there when it comes to sit-stand workstations. Find out why Winston excels versus other popular desktop conversion and retrofit solutions.

 

Winston Workstation Installation

Winston Workstation Resources

Downloads

 

DOWNLOAD INSTALLATION MANUAL

Quick Ship Models ship within in 24-48 hours. All stand ship in 5-7 business days depending on the configuration.

Returns

Please contact Customer Service to request a Return Authorization within 45 days of product receipt. If authorized, return instructions will be provided. Return Authorizations expire 60 days after the issue date. Credit is only issued to products in a resalable condition.

title: Hat Design Works 8326 Vertical Computer Mounting System
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 8326 Vertical Computer Mounting System

Create a working kiosk or a data entry station with the 8326 Vertical Computer Mounting System. The 8326 can elevate and support a wide range of computer systems. It’s ideal for industrial applications or healthcare settings.

There are a variety of options in using 8326 to let you customize, depending on your needs and available equipment. Choose the standard 13” wall track if you’re mounting only a monitor arm. The 19” track can support one CPU holder plus a monitor arm while the popular 31” track can hold a monitor arm, a CPU holder, and a keyboard arm. (Contact us if you got these additional requirements.)

Reduce the mess. Make your working area neat, safe and space-efficient with the 8326 Vertical Computer Mounting System.

 

Features

  • Customizable: Configure with your choice of monitor arm, keyboard arm or CPU holder. Mounting system is available in standard lengths of 19"; call for custom lengths.
  • Aesthetic: Mount contributes to a clean and neat work area.
  • Safe: Mounting system prevents accidents and trip hazards which may damage equipment or harm staff.
  • Integrated: Cable management keeps cables organized and out of view.


 

Specifications

Screen Size

Up to 43"
Color

Flat White, Silver, Vista Black
Mount Configurations

Wall
Warranty

<div class="header">
<h3>Simplicity with strength.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Looking for a basic mounting solution that's more than capable? Look no further than the SpaceArm Direct Tilt Arm - the perfect choice for those who need a high-quality monitor arm without all the bells and whistles.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Customize and secure.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Just because it's basic doesn't mean it's not customizable. With mount-to-monitor and mount-to-surface options make it easy to find the perfect setup for your workspace. You can be sure your monitor is safe and secure no matter how heavy.</p>
</div>
</div>

<p class="paragraph"><span>So why settle for a basic monitor mount when you can have a functional and stylish one? Choose the SpaceArm Direct Tilt Arm and take your workspace to the next level.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/21QavoS6_9L_480x480.jpg?v=1684963931" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/21QavoS6_9L_480x480.jpg?v=1684963931"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: (Standard) Up to 16.25” (41.3 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: 2.5” (6.4 cm) to 15.5” (39.4 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 230º-360º at two different joints<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>

</h3>

</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extends up to 15.5” horizontally. Occupies only 2.5” in the folded position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional: Quick Change–a universal mount for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SpaceArm to hub); touch screen (adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint); 180-degree rotational stop (limiter to the SpaceArm hub, prevents monitor collisions).</li>

title: Hat Design Works Envoy™ Articulating Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Envoy™ Articulating Monitor Arm

Introducing the ultimate solution to your workspace woes! Say goodbye to uncomfortable, cluttered desks and hello to the power of control with our cutting-edge articulating arm.

With just one touch, you can effortlessly adjust your monitor to your desired position, giving you complete control of your comfort. Our sleek cable management system ensures your workspace stays organized and free of clutter, while our easy-to-install mount system makes set up a breeze.

Our articulating arm is designed with balanced tension at each joint, allowing for seamless counterbalance and ultimate flexibility. Whether you need to swivel, tilt, or rotate your monitor from portrait to landscape mode, our arm provides the perfect solution.

Installation is a snap with our quick-install VESA plate, reducing the time and hassle of setting up your workspace. Our articulating arm is the perfect solution for anyone who needs a flexible, responsive, and ergonomic workspace. Reclaim your desktop and take control of your comfort today!

75 & 100mm, quick-release adapter included

10 Years

seo.description: Upgrade your office with Envoy's ergonomic monitor arm featuring one-touch adjustment and cable management. Complements any office environment.

title: Hat Design Works Dual Envoy Dual Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Dual Envoy Dual Monitor Arm

The Dual Envoy™ Dual Monitor Arm is a good mounting choice if you are sporting a dual monitor set-up. This dual monitor arm comes at an affordable price yet still packed with important features. The two monitors can be positioned independently, and the one-touch adjustment allows easy monitor placement to achieve the best viewing angle. A cable organizer routes the cables under the arms so they will be out of your way. The Dual Envoy’s clean design also complements any office environment. All these features combine to give you a comfortable desk space to work with, on top of other ergonomic benefits.

Features

  • Balanced: Tension adjustment at each joint allows for seamless counterbalance.
  • Responsive: One-touch monitor adjustment.
  • Flexible: Swivels, tilts and rotates from portrait to landscape.
  • Quick-Install: Detachable, quick-install VESA plate reduces installation time.

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Power up your productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SpaceArm Sit-Stand Double Arm – the ultimate power duo for your workspace! With its innovative design and unbeatable versatility, this dual monitor arm nested on a single hub elevates your productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash your potential.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to cluttered desks and hello to the seamless organization! The SpaceArm SS02 empowers you to effortlessly suspend two monitors side by side, allowing you to expand your screen real estate and maximize your efficiency. Whether you're a multitasking maestro or a creative genius, this sturdy design ensures your monitors stay securely in place while you confidently conquer your tasks.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-dual-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-sit-stand-double-arm-2567917469801_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202645" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-dual-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-sit-stand-double-arm-2567917469801_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202645"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Your work and your way.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Customization is the name of the game, and the SS02 doesn't disappoint. With the ability to independently position each monitor, you have the freedom to create your perfect ergonomic setup. Tilt, swivel, and rotate your screens to find the ideal viewing angle that suits your unique needs. It's time to bid farewell to uncomfortable neck strains and hello to a personalized, comfortable work experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SpaceArmAxis__32531_b25b2c6e-16ae-4414-81fc-a61efcd5abd9_480x480.jpg?v=1685141914" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SpaceArmAxis__32531_b25b2c6e-16ae-4414-81fc-a61efcd5abd9_480x480.jpg?v=1685141914"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Versatility redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Not only does the SpaceArm SS02 provide exceptional dual monitor support, but it also inherits the unmatched versatility of its predecessor, the SS01. It comes equipped with a wide range of mounting options and configurations, ensuring compatibility with your existing setup. Whether you prefer a desk clamp, grommet mount, or even a wall mount, the SS02 has you covered, giving you the flexibility to adapt to any workspace environment effortlessly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/41qJqNiXLfL_480x480.jpg?v=1685550869" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/41qJqNiXLfL_480x480.jpg?v=1685550869"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: (Standard) Up to 22.17” (56.3 cm) per arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: 2.5” (6.4 cm) to 19.5” (49.5 cm) per arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 230º-360º at two different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through, C-clamp, large C-clamp, Grommet</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Above Desk Mount</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Two sit-stand monitor arms on a single hub</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust height +/- 7” from the center up to 22.17”. Height can be added with optional 4”, 6”, and 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change universal mount for quick switching of monitors</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SS02 to hub); adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop (limiter to the SpaceArm hub, prevents monitor collisions).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Master multitasking mastery.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Enhance your productivity to stellar heights with the incredible SpaceArm Double Standard Arm! Say goodbye to the limitations of single-screen setups and unlock the true power of multitasking. Immerse yourself in a world of efficiency as you effortlessly navigate between tasks, thanks to this sturdy yet flexible arm that puts you in complete control.<br></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Total monitor freedom.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Imagine the freedom of positioning your monitors independently, tailoring them to your unique workflow. With the SA02, customization is the name of the game. Choose from a wide range of mount-to-surface configurations, allowing you to integrate this versatile arm into any workspace setup seamlessly. Whether you prefer a clamp or grommet mount, this arm has got you covered.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SpaceArmAxis__32531_480x480.jpg?v=1685035954"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Boundless adaptability.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The SA02 provides the ultimate in adjustability, but it also boasts impressive specifications to accommodate your every need. With a remarkable depth range of up to 20.5 inches, you'll have ample space to find your perfect viewing distance. The height range of up to 18.25 inches ensures optimal eye-level alignment, reducing strain and promoting ergonomic bliss.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/large_110_sa02_01m_Large_a8dbd76d-d6da-411b-9ddf-86f66f750590_480x480.jpg?v=1685034897" alt="" data-mce-selected="1" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/large_110_sa02_01m_Large_a8dbd76d-d6da-411b-9ddf-86f66f750590_480x480.jpg?v=1685034897"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Heavyweight stability.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The SpaceArm Double Standard Arm is built to handle the toughest challenges. With a remarkable weight capacity of up to 30 pounds per arm, it effortlessly supports even the most substantial monitors. Bid farewell to wobbly stands and unstable setups – this arm offers unrivaled stability, keeping your screens secure and steady.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/spaceco-dual-monitor-arm-vesa-bolt-through-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-double-standard-arm-2569730556009_480x480.webp?v=1685036258"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range (Standard) Up to 18.25” (46.5 cm) per arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range Up to 20.5” (52.1 cm) per arm; folds to 2.5” (6.4 cm) when not in use</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation 320º-360º- 360º at three different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through, C-clamp, large C-clamp, Grommet.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Above Desk Mount VESA Compatibility Yes (75-mm x 75-mm, 100-mm x 100-mm, 100-mm x 200-mm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Two standard monitor arms on a single hub</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust height +/- 7” from the center up to 18.25”. Height can be added with optional 4”, 6”, and 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change universal mount for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SpaceArm to hub); adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop to prevent monitor collisions.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Double your productivity.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary SpaceArm Single Two-Tier Arm – the game-changer for your dual monitor setup! Say goodbye to the conventional side-by-side layout and unlock a whole new world of productivity and style.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate with elegance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Unlike other mounts that limit your options, our SpaceArm Single Two-Tier Arm empowers you to create the ultimate two-tier layout effortlessly. Now you can elevate one monitor over another, adding a touch of elegance and sophistication to your workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-two-tier-arm-vesa-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-single-two-tier-arm-2569876471913_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202267" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-two-tier-arm-vesa-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-single-two-tier-arm-2569876471913_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202267"></div>

</div>

Experience the freedom to design your ideal setup and immerse yourself in a world of enhanced productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/products/spaceco-two-tier-arm-vesa-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-single-two-tier-arm-2569876308073.png?v=1559202267"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: 2.5” (6.4 cm) to 20.5” (52.1 cm) per arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tiered stacking of two standard monitor arms on a single hub</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust each monitor’s height +/- 7” from the center of the hub.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Each arm extends up to 20.5” horizontally. Occupies only 2.5” in a folded position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change universal mount for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SpaceArm to hub); adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop (limiter to the SpaceArm hub, prevents monitor collisions).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Limitless productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SpaceArm Quad Two-Tier Arm - the ultimate solution for your 8-monitor setup! Say goodbye to clutter and hello to seamless productivity. With its sturdy and configurable design, this mount will revolutionize the way you work.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Imagine achieving a neat and organized 4-over-4 layout effortlessly. Thanks to the double hub and four SA02 dual monitor arms, the SpaceArm Quad Two-Tier Arm makes it possible. It's time to take control of your workspace and create the perfect arrangement for maximum efficiency.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-quad-monitor-arm-vesa-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-quad-two-tier-arm-2577123999849_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202402" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-quad-monitor-arm-vesa-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-quad-two-tier-arm-2577123999849_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202402"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But what sets the SA44 apart from the rest? Its reputation for unparalleled quality and configurability is unmatched. You can trust it to effortlessly support monitors weighing up to a whopping 30 lbs, ensuring stability and peace of mind. No more worries about wobbly screens or sagging mounts!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/sa44bt-blk-02_480x480.png?v=1685377733"></div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SpaceArmAxis__32531_b25b2c6e-16ae-4414-81fc-a61efcd5abd9_480x480.jpg?v=1685141914"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range 2.5” (6.4 cm) to 20.5” (52.1 cm) per arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tiered stacking of four double-hub standard monitor arms</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust height +/- 7” from the center of the hub.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Each arm extends up to 20.5” horizontally. Occupies only 2.5” in a folded position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change universal mount for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SpaceArm to hub); adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop to prevent monitor collisions.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Powerhouse Productivity</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SpaceArm Double Two-Tier Arm – your ultimate solution to transform your workspace into a sleek, organized powerhouse! With this ingenious tool, you can effortlessly mount not just one or two but a whopping four monitors above your desk, creating a captivating 2-over-2 monitor layout that will leave everyone in awe.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Desk space liberation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to cramped desk space and endless clutter! The SpaceArm Double Two-Tier Arm is here to revolutionize the way you work. By suspending your monitors side-by-side, attached to a sturdy central pole, you'll reclaim valuable real estate on your desk, allowing you to focus on what truly matters: your productivity and creativity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-quad-monitor-arm-vesa-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-double-two-tier-arm-2577183539305_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202446"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Masterfully crafted adaptability.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted to perfection, the SA22 features two double hubs and four SA01 single monitor arms, offering unparalleled flexibility and adaptability. Whether you're a multitasking guru or a creative genius, this arm system can easily handle it all. Each monitor arm can effortlessly support monitors weighing up to 30 pounds, providing a secure and stable display for all your visual needs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SA22QC-BT-PLTrevised__32046-1_480x480.webp?v=1685043968"></div>

<p class="paragraph">there's more! We understand that every user is unique, which is why we offer you the freedom to choose from three gas struts, each tailored to your preferred weight capacity. With this customizable option, you can fine-tune your setup to match your specific requirements and ensure optimal performance perfectly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/original.416x500_m_480x480.jpg?v=1685044731"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: 2.5” (6.4 cm) to 20.5” (52.1 cm) per arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface: option Bolt-through</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tiered stacking of two double hub standard monitor arms</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust height +/- 7” from the center of the hub.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Each arm extends up to 20.5” horizontally. Occupies only 2.5” in the folded position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick Change universal mount for quick switching of monitors.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SpaceArm to hub); adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop (limiter to the SpaceArm hub, prevents monitor collisions).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>

title: Hat Design Works 9189 Height Adjustable POS Through Counter Mount
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9189 Height Adjustable POS Through Counter Mount

The 9189 Height Adjustable POS Monitor Mount comes in two versions with different height ranges. The 9189-12 offers a vertical range of 7”-12” while the 9189-24 has a longer one at 7”-24”. These mounts also come with handy features: quick height adjustment, durable construction, attractive look, and a built-in cable management system. The mounts are specially designed to pass through a hole in a counter so that cables can be routed out of everyone’s view and harm’s way.

These two mounts have the durability and other qualities which make them suitable for retail use. The two models can be pivoted and tilted for easy viewing and user access, with both functions can be locked into place if desired. The 9189 is ideal for supporting monitors, signature capture devices, and kiosks.

Models

  • 9189-12 7-12" height adjust range
  • 9189-24 7-24" height adjust range
  • 9189-36 7-36" height adjust range


Features

  • Compatible: Countertop mount supports monitors, signature capture devices, kiosks, and more.
  • Adjustable: Tube passes through counter, the monitor mount's height is adjusted via a set screw in the mount.
  • Integrated: Monitor mount features internal cable routing - cables pass through counter, remaining out of view.
  • Durable: POS display mount is made of durable construction and stands up to retail use.
  • Options: Three models to choose from, each featuring a different height adjust range (see available models).


Specifications

Weight Capacity

Up to 25 lbs
Dimensions

Base: Ø 4"
Color

Vista Black
VESA Compatibility

75 & 100mm, adapter included
Warranty

10 Years

title: Hat Design Works 9136-D-FM Dual Monitor Pole Mount
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9136-D-FM Dual Monitor Pole Mount

Introducing the ultimate solution for those who are looking to upgrade their workspace - the 9136-D dual pole monitor mount! This cutting-edge product not only allows you to work in an ergonomic and comfortable way, but it also saves you valuable desk space.

The 9136-D features two monitor arms that move independently, so you can adjust each monitor to your preferred height and angle. Plus, the 28" pole mount provides ample space for your displays, giving you the flexibility to stack two screens one over the other.

Designed with a sleek and low-profile look, the 9136-D dual pole monitor mount adds a touch of elegance to any workspace. Its versatile design also includes a Flexmount for easy installation and customization.

Whether you're a gamer, a designer, or simply someone who wants to optimize their workspace, the 9136-D dual pole monitor mount is the perfect solution for you. So why settle for a cluttered and uncomfortable workspace? Upgrade to the 9136-D and experience the benefits of ergonomic and space-saving design.

title: Hat Design Works 9105 XHD Extra Strength Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9105 XHD Extra Strength Monitor Arm

Introducing the 9105-XHD Extra Strength Monitor Arm, the ultimate solution for heavy-duty monitor lifting! Say goodbye to the hassle of lifting and positioning heavy monitors on your own. With a lifting power of up to a whopping 69 lbs and a thickness greater than 3 inches, this arm can handle even the heaviest of monitors with ease.

Experience the sleek and modern design of this arm that makes your monitor appear to "float" for easy and effortless positioning. Not only does it look amazing, but it's also incredibly durable with heavy-duty steel construction, ensuring that your monitor is safe and secure.

With an integrated cable management system, you can keep your workspace free of messy wires and cables, allowing you to focus on what's important. Plus, the gas cylinder allows for instant lifting, lowering, and rotation of your monitor, making it feel weightless.

But that's not all! The 9105-XHD also includes a spring-assisted monitor tilter mechanism that allows for over 200 degrees of tilting, providing you with the flexibility to position your monitor exactly the way you want it.

And let's not forget about the specially reinforced FLEXmount, which provides a variety of mounting configurations for added convenience.

Upgrade your monitor setup with the 9105-XHD Extra Strength Monitor Arm and enjoy the benefits of effortless monitor positioning and a clutter-free workspace!


Features

  • Durable: The monitor arm is extremely durable, made of heavy-duty steel construction.
  • Integrated: Cable management keeps cables tucked beneath the monitor arm.
  • Robust: The extra strength monitor arm includes special reinforced FLEXmount with desk clamp or through-desk mounting options; call for numerous other monitor mounting options.

Specifications

Screen Size

Up to 32"
Color

Flat White, Silver, Vista Black
Weight Capacity

35.5 – 69.1 lbs
Height Adjustment

15.5"
Extension Range

24"
Tilt

200°
Rotation

360° at three joints
Mount Configurations

Desk Edge, Thru-Desk, Grommet, Side Bolt
VESA Compatibility

100mm x 200mm, 200mm x 200mm or 200mm x 400mm (specify when ordering)
Warranty

10 Years

title: Hat Design Works 7000-8408 Dual Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 7000-8408 Dual Monitor Arm

Be space-efficient, be productive with two monitors. The 7000-8408 Dual Monitor Arm is sturdy yet smooth so positioning your two monitors independently with just one hand is a breeze.

Like its one-arm counterpart, the 7000-8408 also has FLEXmount so that you can mount your monitors in six different ways: desk edge, wall, thru-desk, side bolt, grommet, or reverse wall. Moreover, the integrated cable organizer ensures your wires and cables are out of your desktop and out of your sight.

With a depth adjustment range of up to 24 inches, a height adjustment of up to 16 inches, and the ability to hold monitors up to 25 pounds per arm, the 7000-8408 is your all-in- one ergonomic solution for your dual monitor set-ups.

Features

  • Integrated cable management system to keep your working space clutter-free from wires and cables
  • Instantly raise, lower and rotate your two monitors with one-handed positioning
  • Extend the arm up to 24” but also save space by folding it to occupy 3”
  • Tilt monitor up to 200 degrees without tipping it over

Specifications

Vertical range: 8” (20.3 cm) to 16" (40.6 cm) per arm

Horizontal range: Up to 24" (61 cm) per arm; each arm retracts to about 3"

Weight capacity:

7000-500- 8408: supports monitors 2-13 lbs (0.9-5.9) per arm
7000-800- 8408: supports 7.5-25 lbs monitors (3.4-11.3) per arm

Monitor tilt: 200 degrees

Monitor view: Portrait or landscape

Rotation: 360 degrees at three joints

Mounting options: FLEXmount, Slatwall, wall, thru-desk

VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm

Color: Flat White, Silver, Vista Black

seo.description: Maximize your workspace with the 7000-8408 Dual Monitor Arm. Independently position two monitors with just one hand. Six mount options available.

title: Hat Design Works iLift for Apple Cinema Display & G5 iMac Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Introducing iLift - the ultimate solution for Apple users who are looking for an ergonomic and space-saving monitor mount! With iLift, you can easily transform your workspace into a comfortable and clutter-free environment.

The iLift monitor arm is adaptable and offers six mounting options, including desk clamp, thru-desk, and wall mounting. This means that you can mount your monitor in any way that works best for your workspace. The mount is also effortless to use - it floats your monitor weightlessly and can be adjusted with just one hand. You can adjust the height, pivot, and tilt of your monitor to achieve the perfect viewing angle.

One of the best features of the iLift monitor arm is its integrated cable management system. This means that you can say goodbye to annoying cable clutter on your workspace! The iLift monitor arm keeps your cables organized and out of the way.

For iMac users, the iLift monitor arm provides additional security for your monitor. You no longer have to worry about your monitor tipping over or slipping off your desk. With iLift, your monitor is securely mounted and you can work with peace of mind.

Please note that the iLift monitor arm may require the purchase of a VESA Mount Adapter Kit, but this investment will be worth it for the improved functionality and comfort that iLift provides.

Upgrade your workspace with iLift - the space-saving, adaptable, effortless, integrated, and secure monitor arm solution for Apple users.

title: Hat Design Works 9112-S-FM Articulating Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9112-S-FM Articulating Monitor Arm

Introducing the 9112-S-FM Articulating Monitor Arm - the ultimate solution for maximizing your workspace while improving your posture and comfort! This sleek and stylish monitor arm is designed to mount directly to your desktop, freeing up valuable desk space and creating a clean, clutter-free workspace.

With its innovative articulating design, you can easily adjust the monitor arm vertically along the 14" pole mount, allowing you to find the perfect viewing angle for maximum comfort and productivity. Plus, the single foldable LCD arm means you can easily move your monitor out of the way when you need extra desk space.

The 9112-S-FM Articulating Monitor Arm is also incredibly versatile, with both 75mm and 100mm VESA adapters included, making it compatible with a wide range of monitors. And with the Flex Mount feature, you can easily switch between landscape and portrait mode to suit your needs.

So if you're looking to improve your workspace and take your comfort and productivity to the next level, look no further than the 9112-S-FM Articulating Monitor Arm. It's the perfect addition to any home or office, and is sure to make a lasting impact on your workday.

title: Hat Design Works 9232 Monitor Pole Mount
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9232 Monitor Pole Mount

Mount a flat panel monitor over your desk with the 9232-DC or 9232-THRU monitor pole mount. Both products provide light-duty mounting solutions that will fit office spaces, POS (Point of Sale), kiosks, digital displays, and retail environments. They can support monitors or tablets that weight up to 10 lbs. A built-in cable organizer is also present to keep cables out of the way. The pole can be mounted either with a desk clamp (as 9232-DC) or with a thru-desk mount (as 9232-THRU).

 

Features

  • Integrated cable management system to keep your working space clutter-free from wires and cables 100 degrees of monitor tilt for maximum view.
  • Two mounting options. The 9232-DC includes a desk edge clamp mount while the 9232-THRU goes with a thru-desk mount. (A mount for Slatwall is also available.)

Specifications

Pole size: 14” (35.6 cm)

Weight capacity: Supports monitor or tablet up to 10 lbs (4.5 kg)

Monitor tilt: Up to 100 degrees (75 degree and 25 degrees down)

Mounting options:

9232-DC: Clamp (up to 2” desktop thickness)
9232-THRU: Thru-desk (up to 1.8” of desktop thickness)

VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm (VESA adapters included)

Color: Vista Black

seo.description: 9232-DC and 9232-THRU Monitor Pole Mount for light-duty mounting up to 10 lbs in POS, kiosks, and retail environments. Built-in cable management.

title: Jestik Ultra Slim Adjustable Sit-Stand Workstation
descriptionHtml:
It’s time to elevate your desk to different heights. With Jestik JM-DWS08- 02, you can now have a sit-stand desk that’s simple yet functional.

This standing desk comes fully assembled, so no need to install anything. Put your monitor and computers on the expansive desk surface, and start working instantly. It got a solid base to support the desk along its vertical range. It’s sturdy enough to support up to 22 lbs of total weight. You are given 12 height settings, a welcome feature for users of varying heights. Let’s mention too that standing provides healthy benefits you won’t get from long hours of sitting.

All these qualities combined to make JM-DWS08- 02 a great choice for your standing desk needs.

﻿​

Specifications:

Vertical range: 1.5” (37 mm) to 16” (407 mm)
Weight capacity: Supports up to 22 lbs (10 kg)
Base dimensions: 24.2” (615 mm) L x 18.8” (477 mm) W
Desk surface dimensions: 31.3” (795 mm) L x 21.3” (540 mm) W
Desk surface thickness: 0.59” (15 mm)
Mounting option: Tabletop stand
Color: Black

Features:

 

  • A spring-loaded lifting mechanism, 12-height settings, and two quick-release handles allow smooth, manual height adjustments.
  • Ultra-slim profile to save space and for easy storage.
  • Various parts are crafted from plastic, MDF, steel, and aluminum. MDF board provides high-impact resistance, and steel provides durable quality.
  • Non-skid silicone pads protect desk from scratches. Makes JM-DWS08- 02 ideal for placement on corners.
  • No need to install as the unit comes pre-assembled.

title: Jestik Advanced Flex 2.0 Dual Monitor Arm Clamp and Bolt Through Mount - Gas Assisted Arm, For Two 17"-32" Computer Screens, Holds up to 17.6 lbs.
descriptionHtml:
The Jestik Advanced Flex 2.0 is one exceptionally strong dual monitor arm. Thanks to its hybrid material construction and gas spring mechanism, it can support up to two monitors, each as heavy as 17.6 lbs and as large as 32”. As this arm effortlessly lift both monitors, you don’t have to worry about properly supporting a heavy dual monitor setup. Moreover, this Jestik arm is good not only for flat monitors but also for curved ones. And with a cable management system in place, you can tuck away those wires and cables so they won’t get in the way.

Specifications:

Vertical range: Up to 20” (600 mm)
Pole height: 14.2” (360 mm)
Horizontal range: Up to 18.3" (466 mm)
Monitor capacity: Supports up to 2 monitors, weighing 1-17.6
lbs (1-8 kg) each, as large as 17”-32” (432-813 mm)
Monitor view: Portrait or landscape (360 degrees rotation)
Monitor tilt range: +35 to -35 degrees
Monitor swivel range: +90 to -90 degrees
Rotation: +/-180, +/-135 degrees at two additional joints
Mounting options: Grommet, clamp
VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm
Color: Slate Black, Metallic Gray

Features:

 

  • Integrated cable management system keeps your desk clutter-free from wires and cables.
  • Built-in gas spring counterbalance system smoothly adjusts monitors to comfortable positions. Flat and curved monitors are rendered weightless as the arm do the effortless lifting.
  • Quick install/release VESA plate bracket.
  • Flexible monitor positioning with its range of rotational, tilt, and swivel capabilities.
  • Body is crafted from plastic, steel, and aluminum, with a powder coating surface finish.

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ultimate workspace revolution.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SpaceArm Long Arm, your ultimate solution for mounting your flat monitor with unparalleled comfort and flexibility. Say goodbye to awkward viewing angles and limited space because the SX01 arm is here to revolutionize your workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Customize and adapt.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">What sets the SX01 apart is its remarkable range of customization options, allowing you to tailor it precisely to your office needs. With an array of surface mounting choices, finding the perfect setup becomes a breeze. Whether you prefer a desk clamp or grommet installation, the SX01 arm has got you covered. Embrace the freedom to create your ideal ergonomic workstation effortlessly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_480x480.jpg?v=1684962315" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_480x480.jpg?v=1684962315"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Expand and thrive.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Embrace the spaciousness of a clutter-free desk with the SX01 arm. By securely mounting your monitor at an extra-long distance, you'll gain valuable real estate on your workspace. Say hello to an organized, streamlined environment that fuels your productivity and creativity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SX01QCGT_480x480.png?v=1685120981" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/SX01QCGT_480x480.png?v=1685120981"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Impress and inspire</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the SpaceArm Long Arm, functionality and aesthetics go hand in hand. Its sleek design seamlessly blends into any office decor, enhancing the visual appeal of your workspace. Transform your office into a modern and efficient haven, impressing both clients and colleagues with your attention to detail.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/101_cb7d6361-dc36-4475-bc1e-c705cf03072b_480x480.jpg?v=1684963307" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/101_cb7d6361-dc36-4475-bc1e-c705cf03072b_480x480.jpg?v=1684963307"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: (Standard) Up to 17.5” (44.5 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: Up to 24.5” (62.2 cm); folds to 2.5” (6.4 cm)<br>when not in use</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor tilt: 40 degrees (20 degrees up, 20 degrees down)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation 230º360º-360º at three different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-surface option: Bolt-through, C-clamp, Large C-clamp, Grommet.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjust height +/- 7” from the center up to 17.5”. Height can be added with optional 4”, 6”, 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extra-long reach, up to 24.5” extension from the center of the mount. When not in use, SX01 saves space by folding to just 2.5”.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Default mount-to-monitor mount is the Direct VESA mount plate. Optional Quick</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Change the universal mount for quick switching of monitors.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional mount-to-monitor accessories include a security screw (locks monitor to arm); security set screw (locks SpaceArm to hub); adjustable, rotational knobs at each joint; 180-degree rotational stop (limiter to the SpaceArm hub, prevents monitor collisions).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">High-pressure die-cast aluminum construction and thermo-fused polyester finish.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div class="header">
<h3>Ultimate reach.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you a fan of the incredible features that the SX01 offers but find yourself craving even more reach? Look no further because the SX01XP is here to fulfill your desires! Boasting the longest extension range in the SpaceArm family of single monitor arms, this remarkable creation elevates your comfort and productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to those pesky backaches and neck pains caused by straining to view your screen. With an impressive extension range of 31 inches, the SpaceArm Long Extended Arm ensures that your display is perfectly positioned within your line of sight. No more leaning forward excessively or contorting yourself into uncomfortable positions – your screen will be right where you need it, providing a seamless viewing experience.</p>
</div>
</div>

This ingenious feature allows you to adjust your monitor in any direction to suit your preferred viewing angle and ergonomic needs. Whether you want to tilt, swivel, or rotate it, the SX01XP has got you covered. It adapts to you, ensuring optimal comfort and productivity throughout your workday.</p>

Achieve maximum flexibility and efficiency in your workspace, all thanks to the incredible adaptability of the SX01XP.</p>

</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: (Standard) Up to 19” (48.3 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: 2.5” (6.4 cm) to 31” (78.7 cm)</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor view: 360 degrees; portrait and landscape rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 230º-230º-360º-360º at 4 different joints</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mount-to-monitor option: Direct VESA, Quick Change</li>

</h3>
