title: Hat Design Works 8424 and 8424 NHB Secure POS iPad Enclosure
descriptionHtml:
Innovative’s Secure POS iPad Enclosure is made from heavy-duty steel. With this construction, you’re confident that your Apple iPad is well-secured for self-service or POS (Point of Sale) applications. This product is compatible with all iPad generations, from 1 to 4.

Moreover, you have two models to choose from. The 8424 keeps your device safe and allows access to the home button to anyone. Then there’s the 8424-NHB that blocks the home button entirely. Both holders will work with any mounts or arms from Innovative. You can also directly mount this enclosure into the wall.

 

Features

  • Secure POS iPad enclosure is constructed from durable steel.
  • Keeps your iPad safe and, depending on the model, have different controls on home button access.
  • Compatible with all mounting products of Innovative.
  • Compatible with iPad generations 1, 2, 3 and 4.

 

Specifications

Dimensions: 11.1” (28.2 cm) x 8.6” (21.8 cm) x 0.8” (1.9 cm)

Net weight: 2.75 lbs

Color: Flat White, Pearl White, Silver, Vista Black

seo.description: Keep your iPad safe with Innovative's Secure POS iPad Enclosure, made from heavy-duty steel for maximum security.

title: Hat Design Works 8438 Secure POS iPad Enclosure
descriptionHtml:
Innovative’s 8438 Secure POS iPad POS got stricter with security as it goes with a lock-and-key capability. This feature allows a secure hold of an Apple iPad into any Innovative VESA mount. The 8438 keeps the device safe yet acessible—there’s flexibility if you want the home button blocked or not. All these combined qualities make the 8438 iPad holder a good choice for POS (Point of Sale) or self-service applications. Even more, it works with iPad generations 2, 3 and 4.

Features

  • Quick iPad installation. Design and construction prevent theft and damage to the iPad.
  • Includes lock and key for security.
  • Access to home button is available. There is an option to block that access as well.
  • The enclosure allows access to the audio jack.
  • Integrated cable management system to keep your cables out of sight.
  • Compatible with any Innovative VESA mounts.
  • Compatible with iPad generations 2, 3 and 4.


Specifications

Dimensions: 11.8” (29.9 cm) x 8.0” (20.3 cm)

VESA Compatibility: Yes

Color: Vista Black

title: Hat Design Works 9105-FM Heavy Duty Desktop Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
The 9105-FM Heavy-Duty Desktop Monitor Arm is exceptionally strong and durable, making it the ideal desktop mount for heavy monitors.

You got a choice of four models, with the highest one able to support monitors as heavy as 54 pounds, thanks to the arm’s steel construction. Still, you won’t feel the monitor is bulky at all, as the arm effortlessly do the lifting with a gas cylinder. There is also a spring-assisted monitor tilter for smooth monitor pivoting.

It also comes with FLEXmount, which offers you six mounting options. One good thing with FLEXmount is that changing the mounting from time to time won’t require you to buy additional parts.

The 9105-FM is good not only for large flat monitors but also for data entry workstations, where the arm is powerful enough to support both monitor and keyboard tray.

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Elevate your productivity.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;"><span>Introducing the SpaceArm Stubby Single Arm with Laptop Platform - the ultimate solution for taking your productivity to new heights, quite literally! Are you tired of cluttered desks and the constant fear of accidentally drenching your laptop in a coffee mishap? Say goodbye to these worries and embrace a sleek, space-maximizing design that will revolutionize your work!</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash laptop liberation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The ST01LP is not your ordinary laptop mount; it's a game-changer! Crafted with precision and ingenuity, this innovative device allows you to mount your laptop securely to a monitor arm above your desk. Imagine the freedom of a clutter-free workspace where your laptop hovers gracefully, protected from spills and mishaps. With the ST01LP, you can bid farewell to those nail-biting moments of laptop disaster!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ST01GT-LP-LL_480x480.png?v=1685742698" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp"> Productivity boosted.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">We prioritize your comfort and well-being too. No more hunching over your desk, straining your neck and back while you tackle that mountain of paperwork. The ST01LP brings your laptop to an ergonomically efficient height, so you can easily maintain perfect posture and work. Say hello to increased productivity and goodbye to those persistent aches and pains.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/spaceco-laptop-flatform-bolt-through-4-platinum-spaceco-spacearm-stubby-single-arm-with-laptop-platform-3603428769897_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559178963"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Customize and personalize.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The ST01LP is fully customizable, just like all other SpaceArm products. Tailor it to suit your unique needs and preferences. Choose from various options to create the perfect laptop mount that fits your style and requirements. Whether you want a sleek and minimalist design or a burst of vibrant colors to uplift your workspace, we've got you covered.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_480x480.jpg?v=1684962315"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: 8.5” (21.6 cm) without any extender tube</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: Arm extends to 8.2” (20.8 cm)<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Laptop tray: size 12.75” X 15.5” (32.4-cm x 39.4-cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mounting options: Bolt-through, C-clamp, Large C-clamp, Grommet</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color Arm: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tray: Black</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">360-degree rotation.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Moves front to back, side to side.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Non-gas lift mechanism.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable height +/- 7” from the center of the hub. Optional height extenders include 4”, 6”, and 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Molded steel platform.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">With laptop lock (optional).</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Productivity unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the SpaceArm Stubby Plus Single Arm with Laptop Platform – the ultimate docking solution for your laptop that takes your productivity to new heights! With the combined power of the renowned SP01 monitor arm and a sleek laptop platform, this innovative device creates an instant docking station wherever you go.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">limitless potential.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to cramped workspaces and hello to a world of freedom and flexibility. The Stubby Plus Single Arm ensures you have an extensive horizontal range, allowing you to position your laptop exactly where you need it. No more straining your neck or squinting your eyes due to awkward angles. With the SP01LP, you can effortlessly adjust your laptop to a comfortable height, promoting good posture and preventing those dreaded stiff necks and eye strains.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/download_e95cc9f6-62f0-4745-9ff6-e8c1d1cc5e45_480x480.png?v=1685654410"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="textBlock">

<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless productivity.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed with the modern professional in mind, the SP01LP is the ultimate companion for those who work on the go. Whether you're a digital nomad, a business traveler, or simply someone who likes to be efficient, this docking station is your ticket to a seamless work experience. Set up your workstation in seconds and leave just as quickly once your job is done.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/images_4d2dc9b9-0cc4-4039-9a51-2c750101e80f_480x480.jpg?v=1685655616"></div>

<p class="paragraph">The SpaceArm Stubby Plus Single Arm with Laptop Platform epitomizes style, functionality, and convenience. Its sleek design adds a touch of elegance to any workspace, while its robust construction ensures stability and durability. Crafted to meet the demands of the modern professional, this docking station is a game-changer.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Laptop-Stand-with-Keyboard-1-1-2048x1153_480x480.png?v=1685656340"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Vertical range: 8.5” (21.6 cm) without any extender tube</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Horizontal range: Arm extends to 14.8” (37.6 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Laptop tray size: 12.75” X 15.5” (32.4-cm x 39.4-cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mounting options: Bolt-through, C-clamp, Large C-clamp, Grommet</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA Compatibility: Yes, 75-mm and 100-mm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color Arm: Platinum, White, Black, Champagne</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tray: Black</li>

</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">360-degree rotation.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Moves front to back, side to side.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Non-gas lift mechanism.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable height +/- 7” from the center of hub. Optional height extenders include 4”, 6”, and 8” extender tubes.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Molded steel platform.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">With laptop lock (optional)</li>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Future-proof your productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Upgrade your workspace and embrace the future of productivity with the Humanscale QuickStand Height Adjustable Workstation. Say goodbye to the limitations of a traditional desk and say hello to a seamless standing desk experience without the need for a complete overhaul.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Style meets productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This workstation adds elegance to your desk. Its sleek design brings organization and style to your workspace, elevating your computer monitors and your professional aesthetic. Say goodbye to cluttered cables and hello to a clean, sophisticated setup that will impress colleagues and clients alike.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-monitor-sit-stand-freestanding-base-black-humanscale-quickstand-sit-to-stand-workstation-11011637903465_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202926"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Energize your workday.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Humanscale QuickStand is designed to enhance your efficiency. With its all-in-one desktop solution, you can seamlessly transition from sitting to standing, promoting better posture and reducing the strain on your body. Work comfortably and stay energized throughout the day, as this workstation keeps you at your best.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-monitor-sit-stand-freestanding-base-black-humanscale-quickstand-sit-to-stand-workstation-11011638100073_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202926"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Sleek and space-saving.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Despite its powerful features, the QuickStand maintains a compact design, minimizing its footprint on your desk. Your workspace is valuable, and this workstation respects that. It ensures you have ample room to focus on your projects and tasks, without overwhelming your desk with unnecessary bulk.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-monitor-sit-stand-freestanding-base-black-humanscale-quickstand-sit-to-stand-workstation-11011638001769_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559202926"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Effortlessly attachable to any fixed-height work surface with a dynamic design</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Constant Force Technology enables smooth adjustments to your preferred height.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Reliable and stable with robust construction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The flexible clamp mount offers 6" of horizontal adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Multiple mounting options: clamp mount, grommet/bolt mount, or freestanding base</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seamless integration with your existing workspace through internal cable management</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Pre-installed cable harness and 2 USB outlets for easy plug-and-play functionality</li>
</ul>

</div>
</div>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Game-changing workspace.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Revolutionize your workspace with the Fundamentals AKP01, the ultimate solution for practicality, affordability, and versatility. Designed to seamlessly blend into any contemporary or conventional setting, this remarkable computer desk is a game-changer.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate your typing bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Experience unparalleled comfort as you work, thanks to the included palm cushion that provides a cozy resting spot for your tired hands. And with the Fundamentals keyboard arm, your typing experience reaches new heights of ergonomic excellence. Choose between the 17" or 22" long nylon glide track, tailored to meet your specific requirements.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Fundamentals_AKP01_1_1024x1024_0c564da3-197a-4a4c-8654-fe3f920aaf4e_480x480.webp?v=1689374054" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Fundamentals_AKP01_1_1024x1024_0c564da3-197a-4a4c-8654-fe3f920aaf4e_480x480.webp?v=1689374054"></div>

</div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The AKP01's keyboard arm offers unrivaled adjustability. With a simple turn of a knob, you can effortlessly fine-tune the height and tilt to your desired levels. Enjoy a remarkable tilt range of 25°, from -15° to +10°, ensuring optimal comfort and reducing strain on your wrists.</p>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Fundamentals_AKP01_-_FD-AKP01_1024x1024_6c538816-043a-4616-b1b1-b63081ce1833_480x480.webp?v=1689374645" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Fundamentals_AKP01_-_FD-AKP01_1024x1024_6c538816-043a-4616-b1b1-b63081ce1833_480x480.webp?v=1689374645"></div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Platform: T-molded .625″ melamine construction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Keyboard arm: 173 Fundamentals keyboard arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Keyboard arm tilt: 25° tilt range: -15° +10°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Arm Glide Track: 17”– arm exceeds front of track 1” when stored, 22”– arm fully tucks under the platform</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Arm vertical adjustment: From flush to 6" below work surface</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mouse Tray Orientation: Either left or right; reversible</li>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">360° arm swivel at track</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated Mouse-tray</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Smooth nylon glide track</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Removable memory foam wrist support</li>

title: Workrite Willow Single Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Willow Single Monitor Arm

The Willow Single Monitor Arm is specially designed to support ultra light 1 lb monitors to 14 lb monitors. It is set up with a high performance coil spring and adjustable pivot points to provide maximum stability and for viewing comfort.

The streamlined Willow monitor arm comes with a c-clamp mount, which works great when there is a need to fasten the clamp from above the desk but with limited space under the desk. The arm can extend up to a full 22” from the work surface edge and can fold back completely to maximize the use of your workspace.

title: Workrite Fundamentals 173 Arm
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Fundamentals 173 Arm

Introducing the game-changer for your ultimate workstation setup - the Fundamentals 173 Keyboard Mount! Whether you're a tech enthusiast assembling your dream workstation from scratch or simply giving your trusty work center a much-needed upgrade, this keyboard mount is your ticket to ergonomic bliss and enhanced productivity.

With its ingenious design and practical hardware, the Fundamentals 173 Arm brings a world of convenience to your customized desk. Get ready to experience a whole new level of flexibility and comfort as you effortlessly position and store your keyboard with its seamless 360° swivel capability. Say goodbye to those awkward angles and cramped spaces - this mount allows you to work in the way that suits YOU best.

We understand the importance of a clutter-free workspace, and that's why the Fundamentals 173 Arm boasts a generous 17” long nylon glide track. Plus, the cherry on top - 9.5” and 14.5” of platform storage! This means more room for your mouse, notepads, or anything else you need within arm's reach. No more rummaging around for your essentials; everything stays neatly organized and within your grasp.

But that's not all - this keyboard mount is a breeze to install, saving you precious time and effort. Once it's set up, you'll wonder how you ever managed without it. The durable construction ensures longevity, so you can count on it for years to come. It's not just a keyboard mount; it's an investment in your comfort and efficiency.

So, whether you're a creative guru, a multitasking maestro, or a productivity powerhouse, the Fundamentals 173 Keyboard Mount is your ultimate sidekick. Take control of your workspace, and let the creativity flow as you experience the ease, flexibility, and practicality of this must-have hardware.

Upgrade your workstation today and see the difference for yourself - your wrists, neck, and overall well-being will thank you. Don't miss out on the opportunity to revolutionize the way you work with the Fundamentals 173 Keyboard Mount!

title: Workrite Microsoft Natural Banana Board Platform-UB2181SN
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Microsoft Natural Banana Board Platform

Introducing the revolutionary Banana Board – the ultra-thin platform that takes your workspace to a whole new level of ergonomic bliss! Designed to perfectly complement the sleek contours of your Microsoft® Natural™ and Elite™ keyboards, this is more than just a simple accessory; it's a game-changer for your productivity and comfort.

Say goodbye to cramped wrists and awkward hand positions! With the Banana Board's ingenious design, you can effortlessly switch the ergonomically designed mouse platform from left to right with a single, smooth swing. This means you get the freedom to customize your setup, ensuring your work environment is tailored to your needs and preferences.

But that's not all! We've taken care of all the little details to create the ultimate workspace experience. The Banana Board comes equipped with a removable palm support that cradles your hands in cloud-like comfort, reducing strain and allowing you to work for hours without fatigue.

Never lose track of important documents again – the built-in document holder keeps your references within easy reach, maximizing your efficiency and workflow. And don't worry about messy cables cluttering your desk – our thoughtfully included cable management accessories ensure a tidy and organized workspace, leaving you with a clear mind to focus on what truly matters.

Whether you're a passionate programmer, a tireless writer, or a multitasking guru, the Banana Board will revolutionize the way you work. It's time to take control of your workspace and embrace a new era of productivity and comfort.

Upgrade your setup today with the Banana Board and unlock the full potential of your Microsoft® Natural™ and Elite™ keyboards. Your wrists, hands, and overall well-being will thank you. Elevate your work experience and see the difference for yourself!

 

Specifications

Platform

.25” Phenolic platform

13.25”

  • For Right or Left Handed Users
  • 2.5” Removable memory foam palm support

title: Workrite Pinnacle AD Value Arm
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Pinnacle AD Value Arm

The Pinnacle Ad Value arm is a versatile keyboard mount that can be well-extended above your desk as well as neatly tucked under your desk for storage. It is equipped with a one-touch control and a built-in tilt gauge with ergonomic knob to help you work more comfortably.

The Pinnacle AD Value 3177-17N and 3177-22N specifically comes with a 17” and 22" long nylon glide track with 6” and 11" of platform storage.

title: Workrite Corner Rectangle
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Corner Rectangle

Is your desk getting a bit more crowded by the day and you're needing to get creative with how your work station is set up? Don't fret, we've got you covered.

The Corner Rectangle adapter is a neat piece of accessory which can easily transform corners into usable space. You can simply wedge it at the center of an L-shaped desk. This piece of handy accessory is compatible with all Workrite keyboard arms and can be used with a variety of Workrite platforms.


Specifications

  • Width: 26”
  • Depth: 15”
  • Thickness: 1.5”
  • Color: Black & Gray
  • Workrite Platform:

    188, 488, 2180S, 2181SN, 2100FT, 317RL, 2110D, 2110RL, 2110RLN, 321RL, 180, 187, 487, 385RL, 386RL, 482, 483, 485, 486, 182, 183, 185, 186

<h3>Change made effortless.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing The Conform Articulating Arm - the ultimate solution to your changing workspace needs! With its innovative pin connection system, this versatile arm adapts to your evolving office requirements effortlessly. Whether you need to mount it to a variety of bases, add extra arms, or reconfigure it as your hardware and personnel needs change, The Conform Articulating Arm has got you covered!</p>
</div>

<p class="paragraph">Designed for hassle-free maneuverability, this arm boasts an exceptionally smooth lifting gas spring and precision bushings, ensuring years of maintenance-free performance. title: Workrite Conform Single Static Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Conform Single Static Monitor Arm

The Conform Single Static Monitor Arm is designed to provide vertical resistance for touch screen monitors, laptops & keyboard platforms. It uses the convenient pin connection system to enable the arms to be interchanged. This setup also makes it easy for a variety of bases and accessories to be attached, to adapt to your preferences.

The Conform Single Static Monitor Arm is also very easy to install on any fixed height or adjustable height workcenters. It is TAA compliant, supports over 15,000 cycles and exceeds ANSI/ BIFMA x5.5 requirements.

 

Specifications

Monitor Weight Range

0 - 16 lbs

Forward Reach

24.5"

Monitor Tilt Range

+90° / -45°

Monitor Pivot Range

+ / -90°

Monitor Rotation

+90° / -90°

Stowed Depth

6.5"

Maximum Monitor Height

Pole dependent

Colors

Silver

Warranty

10 years

 

Technical Drawing

Features

  • Interchangeable and expandable pin assembly system that promotes flexibility and adaptability
  • Integrated cable management system that easily routes and conceals cables 
  • Compatibility with Standard VESA (75 mm & 100 mm) mount monitors
  • Space-saving foldable arms that provide more usable work space

title: Workrite Conform Dual Static Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Conform Dual Static Monitor Arm

The Conform Dual Static Monitor Arm is a compact mount for workscenters with limited depths. It is designed to support two monitors in side-by-side arrangements or stacked configurations.

It also uses the revolutionary pin connection system which make it versatile. You have the option to attach it to a range of bases or add accessories to come up with different configurations to suit your office and personnel needs. The Conform Dual Static Monitor Arm is TAA compliant, supports over 15,000 cycles and exceeds ANSI/ BIFMA x5.5 requirements.

Specifications

Monitor Weight Range

0 - 16 lbs monitor on each arm

Forward Reach

4.5" (24” wide monitors)

Monitor Tilt Range

+90° / -45°

Monitor Pivot Range

+ / -90°

+90° / -90°

4.5"

Pole dependent

Silver

10 years

  • Interchangeable and expandable pin assembly system that promotes flexibility and adaptability
  • Integrated cable management system that easily routes and conceals cables 
  • Compatibility with Standard VESA (75 mm & 100 mm) mount monitors
  • Space-saving foldable arms that provide more usable work space

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Power-up your productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Solace 2, your ultimate solution for transforming any workcenter into a powerhouse of productivity and well-being! Engineered to perfection, this innovative marvel is all about flexibility and adaptability, catering to a diverse range of users and applications like never before. Prepare to revolutionize your workspace!</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate your worklife.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Solace 2 ensures that you have full control over your working environment. Say goodbye to discomfort and hello to a custom-tailored setup that promotes optimal posture and overall wellness. Simply adjust the desk to your desired height, and witness the magic unfold.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/workrite-sit-to-stand-workstation-standard-none-workrite-solace-2-sit-to-stand-workstation-3702071689321_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559195341"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Solace 2's articulating arm takes ergonomics to a whole new level. Bid farewell to strained necks and achy backs as this cutting-edge feature effortlessly positions your screens at eye level, allowing you to work comfortably for hours on end. </p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Unchain your productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you tired of being chained to your static desk, longing for a healthier and more invigorating work environment? Look no further! The Solace Single is here to revolutionize your workspace and transform your sedentary routine into a lively and health-conscious experience, all at an incredible value.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Empower your work.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Prepare to bid farewell to prolonged sitting and embrace the benefits of an active workplace. With its ergonomic design and ingenious features, the Solace Single takes your productivity to new heights while caring for your well-being.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/workrite-sit-to-stand-workstation-none-workrite-solace-single-sit-to-stand-workstation-3702397272169_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559195281"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless eye comfort.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Equipped with an integrated monitor mount, this groundbreaking marvel ensures that your screen is always within easy reach. No more straining your neck or squinting to see important details. </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Solace_Environment_-_Single_480x480.webp?v=1686158434"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Custom comfort solutions.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The pivoting arm of the Solace Single grants you the freedom to effortlessly adjust both height and position, empowering you to find your perfect ergonomic sweet spot. </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/solace-single-header-mobile_480x480.jpg?v=1686153995"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Load Capacity: 13-31 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height Range: 18.5"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Arm Pivot at Bas/Monitor: 360°/180°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor Height Range: 6.3"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor Tilt Range/Swivel: +4°/-40°; 90°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Single Monitor Load Range: 6 - 24 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Optional Dual Monitor Load Range: 1 - 10 lbs (each); 22”max width</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Stowed Depth: 23.9” D</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Silver</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Base Options: C-Clamp / Grommet</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Supports up to two monitors</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Includes a monitor quick-release adaptor</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Independent monitor adjustment of up to 6.3"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Made with 55% recycled material and is 99% recyclable</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotating integrated monitor tower and keyboard platform</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Standard VESA (75 mm & 100 mm) mount monitors the compatibility</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Space-saving foldable arms that provide a more usable workspace</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated cable management system that easily routes and conceals cables</li>

title: Workrite S2S Compact System
descriptionHtml:
Workrite S2S Compact System

The S2S Compact System affords a great range of user height adjustability, transforming fixed height workcenters into sit-stand workcenters. Comprised of Pinnacle S2S keyboard arm with nylon glide track coupled with a keyboard-and-mouse platform, it ideal for housing compact keyboard. The removable palm support is easy to move from side to side to accommodate left or right mouse users.

The S2S Compact System meets ANSI/BIFMA X5.5 standards.

 

Specifications

Platform

UltraThin™ .25" solid phenolic

Weight

18 lb (17” track); 20lbs (22” track)

30° Arm Tilt Range

-20° +10°

Vertical Adjustment

from 16" above to 6" below work surface

Track Length

17” nylon; 22” nylon

Platform Storage

17” track - exceeds 3” front of track;

22” track- full storage

Color

Black

Technical Drawing

Features

  • Removable palm support 
  • Lift-n-lock height adjustment 
  • Smooth gliding low profile nylon track 
  • Platform ideal for keyboards less than 6” 
  • Accommodates left and right mouse users

title: Workrite 210-WIDE Angle FootRest
descriptionHtml:
Workrite 210-WIDE Angle FootRest

The Angle Footrest is a great workcenter accessory that provides proper foot support and promotes a healthy work posture. Ergonomically designed, it adapts to your movement, preventing ankle, leg, and back strain and discomfort as you sit and work all day.

Basic in design, the platform automatically rocks upon shift of weight providing continuous foot support.  It also works great in a sit-stand workcenter.

 

Specifications

Platform

Phenolic board

Width

23”

Depth

11”

Base

Heavy gauge steel frame; 3/8" thick

Height Range

3” from the floor

Color

Black

Technical Drawing

 

 

Features

  • Solid base design prevents platform from swinging down forward
  • Durable platform made from plastic composite

title: Workrite Production Footrest-230-WIDE
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Production Footrest

The Production Footrest is a great accessory for any workcenter, including sit-stand desks, that allows for an ergonomic posture as you work all day. It adjusts with your movement, relieving pressure on you ankles, feet, legs, and back. Its anti-slip platform prevents your feet from slipping and provides adequate stability.  

It is height and angle adjustable to accommodate a variety of users as well as enhance seating comfort. It works well in a range of work environments from warehouses to home and corporate offices.

 

Specifications

Platform

Metal

Width

23”

Depth

11”

Height Range

6" to 15" above the floor in ¾" increments

Tilt Range

Tilts 8 degrees forward, 25 degrees back

Color

Black

 

Features

  • Anti-slip surface provides adequate feet traction to keep feet stable
  • Height and angle adjustable to accommodate a variety of users
  • Heavy-duty platform made from metal

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Workstation wonder.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Rite In Line Document Holder is designed to complement work centers with adjustable arms and platform as well as standard desks.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Comfort at work.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">It is a convenient work center accessory that allows documents to be placed parallel to your keyboard to avoid straining your eyes, neck, and back from needing to look at documents sideways.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/images_2_5f677d60-0cd5-4489-8658-865b5ada3b72_480x480.jpg?v=1689721029"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Adaptable ergo stand.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">It is height and angle adjustable for maximum user comfort. It can be used to either hang over the front edge of the work surface or on top of the work surface and comes with fasteners for a more stable installation, and is shipped fully assembled.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Workrite-Ergonomic-Rite-In-Line-document-holder-line-drawing_480x480.jpg?v=1689720072" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Workrite-Ergonomic-Rite-In-Line-document-holder-line-drawing_480x480.jpg?v=1689720072"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Next-level comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Upgrade your workcenter to a new level of productivity and comfort with the Rite In Line Document Holder. Experience the transformation yourself</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/workrite-document-holder-11-workrite-rite-in-line-document-holder-3735356604521_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559195369"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Material: UltraThin composite plastic</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 11" (2550B); 17"(2560)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Depth: 9”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height Range: 5.375"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Range: 42º to 82º</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ridged base plate allows for tilt adjustments and keeps holder stand in place.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Knob on the back of the document holder allows for height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Hook & Loop fasteners secures document holder onto the desk</li>
</ul>

title: Humanscale Monarch Mat
descriptionHtml:
Humanscale Monarch Mat

The Monarch Mat is a beneficial component of an ergonomic workstation. Designed to adapt to sitting and standing positions, it helps your body stay relaxed and makes you feel relieved and refreshed with or without the shoes.

It is a gel-cushioned mat that adapts to your movement and encourages circulation throughout your lower body. It is made from durable materials and has passed up to 30,000 cycles without wear.

 

Chair Compatibility

The mat is designed to seamlessly adapt to sitting and standing positions. Its butterfly design and outer grooves easily allow the chair base to move in and out of the workstation without having to be mounted onto the mat.

 

Durable Design

For ultimate longevity, the Monarch Mat passed a rigorous durability test in which a weighted chair (154 lbs.) rolled back and forth on top of the mat constantly. The mat surpassed expectations, passing up to 30,000 cycles without wear.

 

Thermal Regulation

The mat’s high thermal capacity and temperature regulation allow users to enjoy a refreshing, cool feeling, with or without shoes. This helps the body stay relaxed and tension-free throughout the day.

Specifications

Color

Black and Grey

Product Dimensions

20" H x 29" W x 0.8" D

Product Weight

8 lbs

Materials

Polyurethane/Gel

Warranty

·         All Foot Rockers - 15 Years, 24/7 Warranty

·         Sit/Stand Mat - 3 Years Warranty

Features

  • Provides comfort, support, and pressure relief while sitting and standing
  • Unique design allows the user’s chair to easily roll back and forth
  • Lightweight and portable at 8 lbs
  • Passes rigorous durability tests by withstanding 154 lbs rolled on its surface for up to 30,000 cycles
  • Try without shoes for increased comfort and cooling thermal regulation
  • Underside grip prevents sliding during use

Environmental Story

The Monarch Mat uses non-toxic polyurethane gel without plasticizers - the same sustainable technology found in Humanscale’s gel cushions, palm supports, and armrests. It is non-toxic, odorless, and resists hardening or softening due to temperature or age - increasing the mat’s longevity.

Resources

Downloads

 

DOWNLOAD BROCHURE

Shipping

Mats ship in 2 business days.

Warranty

Sit/Stand Mat - 3 Years Warranty

Returns

All returned and non-damaged refused orders are subject to a 5% restocking fee. Please contact Customer Service to request a Return Authorization within 45 days of product receipt. If authorized, return instructions will be provided. Return Authorizations expire 60 days after the issue date. Credit is only issued to products in a resalable condition.

Product Care

To clean surfaces use mild liquid soap and water. Gently wipe thoroughly with a soft moist cloth to remove dirt and stains. Dry with a dry soft cloth.

<h3>Your typing companion.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer in keyboard technology: The incredible Freestyle Pro! Prepare to elevate your typing experience to unprecedented heights with this award-winning masterpiece.</p>

</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 15.5”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height: 1.25”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Depth: 7.25” front to back</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Keyboard Weight: 2.6 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Shipping Weight: 4 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable linking cable length: 12” – 21.5”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wired; USB connector</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">USB cable length: 6 feet</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Keyboard Layout: Pre-configured for Windows, Mac and Dvorak</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Programmable Buttons: Yes; SmartSet Programming App (Windows and Mac versions are pre-loaded)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Operating Systems: Windows 7-10; Mac OS X v10.6 +; Linux</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Pre-installed with Windows, Mac and Dvorak layouts which do not require to be installed on your computer.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Zero degree slope from front to back to keep your wrists in a neutral position, reducing wrist strain.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Linking cable to allow for adjustment in position and distance to ensure great user comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Low-force and tactile key switches to reduce pressure on your fingertips.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Plug-and-Play and therefore does not require driver installations.</li>
</ul>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize your typing.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ultimate keyboard revolution: The Freestyle2 for PC! Get ready to experience typing like never before with this extraordinary split keyboard. Designed to adapt to your unique needs, it's connected by an adjustable cable, allowing you to position the two parts exactly how you want them.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate typing comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Freestyle2 boasts a stunning low profile that not only looks stylish but also prioritizes your comfort. With its zero-degree slope, this keyboard takes wrist strain reduction to a new level, making long typing sessions a breeze.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/maxresdefault_f8fb6ae9-8c43-44d1-b666-1e160cc37370_480x480.jpg?v=1689096694"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Customize your comfort.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But that's not all that sets the Freestyle2 apart. With the option to purchase it pre-installed with either the VIP3 (KB820PB-us) or V3 (KB830PB-us) accessory, you can take your typing experience to new heights.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/kinesis-keyboard-20-keyboard-only-kinesis-freestyle2-for-pc-3760969187433.jpg?v=1559197048&width=1080"></div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 15 3/8” (KB800PB-us); 20” (KB800PB-us-20)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Max Height: 7 ⅛’’</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Depth: 7 ⅛’’</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Keyboard Weight: 2 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Shipping Weight: 3 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wired or Wireless: Wired; USB connector</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">USB cable length: 6 feet</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Max Height: 15° slope: 2 7/8 ”; at 10° slope: 2 1/8 ”; at 5° slope: 1 1/2”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">With the V3 (AC730-blk) Accessory: One set of right and left V3 lifters</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Max Height: 15° slope: 2 7/8“; at 10° slope: 2 1/8”; at 5° slope: 1 1/2”</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Operating Systems: Windows 7, Windows 8 & Windows 10; Linux</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Zero degree slope from front to back to keep your wrists in a neutral position, reducing wrist strain.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Linking cable to allow for adjustment in position and distance to ensure great user comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Low-force and tactile key switches to reduce pressure on your fingertips.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Plug-and-Play and therefore does not require driver installations.</li>
</ul>

</h3>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back: 20" x 21 " (W x H)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat: 20.5" x 21" (W x D)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height: 19" (at lowest point) 22.5" (at highest point)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cube: 6.7</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 59 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Overall Dimensions: 26.8" x 21" x 38.5-42" (WxDxH)</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Tension Control: Recline rate adapts to weight of users.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Lock: Locks out tilt function.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Adjustment: Sets seat height to desired position relative to floor.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Forward Seat Tilt: Changes angle of seat to enable proper ergonomic posture while using computer keyboard.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Angle Adjustment: Seat angle will lock in any position from front to back</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Arm Height Adjustment: Adjusts arm up or down for proper ergonomic positioning while seated.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Center - Tilt: Chair tilt from a point under the center of the seat allowing user to rack back and forth. Tension adjustable.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back Angle Adjustment: Sets back angle for personalized comfort in reclined position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Waterfall Seat: Front of cushion slopes to reduce pressure on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">2.8" Ratchet Back Height Adjustment: Backrest easily adjusts up or down relative to seat for personalized lumbar region support and comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width Adjustable Arms: Adjusts arms in or out for proper ergonomic positioning.</li>
</ul>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Adjustment: Sets seat height to desired position relative to floor.<br>
</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ultimate comfort redefined.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Prepare to embark on a journey of unparalleled comfort with the 4x4le, the epitome of economical luxury. Designed with your body's needs in mind, this ergonomic chair is here to redefine the way you work, relax, and conquer the day!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Seating freedom unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to rigid seating arrangements and embrace the freedom to find your perfect balance effortlessly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/eurotech-office-chair-eurotech-4x4le-chair-3813377474665_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559201342"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the seat angle lock, the power is in your hands. Lock the seat in any position that suits your mood or task, granting you complete control over your seating experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/images_9137d1f7-773f-4fc7-adb0-50cf48813232_480x480.jpg?v=1687361794"></div>

<p class="paragraph">Indulge your senses with the lavish leather upholstery of the 4x4le. The touch of opulence beneath you sets the tone for an elevated seating experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/images_1_c3db7f4e-3787-4ed6-a471-ca9b31e3d030_480x480.jpg?v=1687361985"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 60 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Width: 29.5"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Depth: 26"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Height: 37" - 43.5"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Range: 18" - 21.5"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Dimensions: 20" width x 19 (x3)" depth</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Backrest Dimensions: 19" width x 20 (x3)" height</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Colors: Black</li>

</h3>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comfortable seat cushion that slopes at the front to lessen stress on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Locks in any position to allow for comfortable seating and ergonomic positioning.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable arms and backrest to provide appropriate ergonomic support.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilts from the center to allow users to rock back and forth.</li>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Relaxation redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary 4x4sl Office Chair, where innovation meets comfort for the ultimate ergonomic experience! Say goodbye to mundane seating and embrace a world of productivity and relaxation</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Custom comfort unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed with your well-being in mind, the 4x4sl office chair takes customization to a whole new level. Its center-tilt feature empowers you to sway effortlessly, granting a delightful range of motion that allows you to find your perfect working position.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/498sl-not-big-enough-1_480x480.jpg?v=1687363437"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Blissful comfort embraced.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Feel the stress melt away as you sink into the plush cushioning, knowing that your body is cradled in optimal comfort.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/498sl-upholstery-1_480x480.jpg?v=1687363687"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Sanctuary of efficiency.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">It's time to transform your workspace into a sanctuary of productivity and well-being. Elevate your work experience with the 4x4sl office chair today and discover the true meaning of blissful efficiency!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/71LliQ1co9L._AC_UF894_1000_QL80_480x480.jpg?v=1687365869"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back: 19" x 20 " (W x H)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat: 20" x 19" (W x D)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height: 18" (at lowest point) 21.5" (at highest point)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cube: 6.00</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 60 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Overall Dimensions: 27" x 21" x 36.5-40" (WxDxH)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Available Colors: Black, Charcoal, Navy</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Tension Control: Recline rate adapts to the weight of users.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Lock: Locks out the tilt function.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Adjustment: Sets seat height to desired position relative to the floor.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Depth Adjustment: Adjusts seat depth relative back</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Forward Seat Tilt: Changes angle of seat to enable proper ergonomic posture while using computer keyboard.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Angle Adjustment: Seat angle will lock in any position from front to back</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Arm Height Adjustment: Adjusts arm up or down for proper ergonomic positioning while seated.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Center Or Swivel - Tilt: Chair tilt from a point under the center of the seat allowing user to rack back and forth. Tension adjustable.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back Angle Adjustment: Sets back angle for personalized comfort in reclined position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Waterfall Seat: Front of cushion slopes to reduce pressure on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">2.8" Ratchet Back Height Adjustment: Backrest easily adjusts up or down relative to seat for personalized lumbar region support and comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width Adjustable Arms: Adjusts arms in or out for proper ergonomic positioning.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergonomic bliss awaits.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the incredible 4XLXL High Back Economical Office Chair, where ergonomic design meets unbeatable comfort! Get ready to elevate your work experience to new heights with this ultimate seating solution.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless flexibility.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Our tilt mechanism allows you to effortlessly lean forward or backward, while the lock feature lets you secure it at any angle, providing you with the flexibility you crave.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Untitled_7a4e411a-cd44-4659-a2b1-347fb74faa7c_480x480.jpg?v=1687369358"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Tailored support guaranteed.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Our 4XLXL chair understands the importance of proper lumbar support. With its tall backrest that can be adjusted to your preferred height, you'll experience consistent and reliable lumbar support throughout the day.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img height="731" width="487" alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/4x4xl_Side_480x480.webp?v=1687369520"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">"Upgrade and transform.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Upgrade your workspace with the remarkable 4XLXL High Back Economical Office Chair today.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/4x4xl_Angle_480x480.webp?v=1687369706" width="430" height="610"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back: 20.5" x 24 " (W x H)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat: 20.5" x 19" (W x D)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height: 18." (at lowest point) 21.7" (at highest point)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cube: 7.4</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 61 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Overall Dimensions: 29" x 26" x 40.5-47" (WxDxH)</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Tension Control: Recline rate adapts to the weight of users.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Lock: Locks out tilt function.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Adjustment: Sets seat height to desired position relative to floor.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Forward Seat Tilt: Changes angle of seat to enable proper ergonomic posture while using computer keyboard.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Angle Adjustment: Seat angle will lock in any position from front to back</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Arm Height Adjustment: Adjusts arm up or down for proper ergonomic positioning while seated.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Center Or Swivel - Tilt: Chair tilt from a point under the center of the seat allowing user to rack back and forth. Tension adjustable.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back Angle Adjustment: Sets back angle for personalized comfort in reclined position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Waterfall Seat: Front of cushion slopes to reduce pressure on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">2.8" Ratchet Back Height Adjustment: Backrest easily adjusts up or down relative to seat for personalized lumbar region support and comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width Adjustable Arms: Adjusts arms in or out for proper ergonomic positioning.</li>
</ul>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Elevate your comfort</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the extraordinary Apollo Drafting Chair, where value, comfort, and quality collide in perfect harmony! This exceptional chair is your ticket to a world of ergonomic bliss and unrivaled support.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Support unmatched.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Meticulously engineered to embrace your every curve and deliver unmatched lumbar support.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/6_Best_Ergonomic_Drafting_Chairs_and_Stools_57c73fe2f66_480x480.jpg?v=1687372515"></div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Embrace pure luxury.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its contoured cushion, your body will be embraced by a cloud-like softness that will make you feel like royalty. Whether you're tackling a demanding project or indulging in creative pursuits, this seat will keep you in the lap of luxury from sunrise to sunset.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/s-l1600_8178670d-d3ef-411f-a590-ff870c2a7ff3_480x480.jpg?v=1687372342"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Crafted for success.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> Elevate your workspace with this remarkable creation, and let it become your trusty companion throughout your workday. Experience the difference that exceptional craftsmanship and thoughtful design can make in your life.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/51JavOm634L._AC_UF350_350_QL80_480x480.jpg?v=1687372800"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 58 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Width: 25"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Depth: 24"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Height: 43.5" - 56"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Range: 23.2" - 32.7"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Dimensions: 20.5" width x 19.3" depth</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Backrest Dimensions: 19.5" width x 20" height</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comfortable seat cushion that slopes at the front to lessen stress on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable arms and backrest to provide appropriate ergonomic support.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Good range of height adjustability to accommodate a range of users.</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Unparalleled comfort.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Apollo Guest Chair, where style meets resilience in perfect harmony! Get ready to indulge in a seating experience like no other. This sleek and durable masterpiece is designed to elevate your comfort and impress even the most discerning eye.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Revolutionize your comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring a mesmerizing mesh backrest that elegantly contours the natural curves of your back, the Apollo Guest Chair offers unrivaled lumbar support. Say goodbye to those long hours of discomfort and hello to a posture-perfect oasis.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/apollo-guest-chair_Front_480x480.webp?v=1687375783"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With fixed-height armrests that effortlessly blend functionality and sophistication, the Apollo Guest Chair ensures your arms are embraced in the lap of ergonomic luxury.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/apollo-guest-chair_Side_600x600_crop_center_920ec5d1-f9ec-4bcc-b5c5-a689531dc563_480x480.webp?v=1687376438"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Sustainability perfected.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Apollo Guest Chair is more than just a remarkable seating solution. It is also a champion of environmental sustainability. With its GreenGuard Indoor Air Quality certification, this chair ensures that your surroundings remain fresh and free from harmful pollutants.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/apollo-guest-chair_Side_480x480.webp?v=1687376888"></div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Height: 36"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight Capacity: 250 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Dimensions: 20.5" width x 19.3" depth</li>
