<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>The ultimate sitting experience.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Apollo High-back Multi-function w/ Seat Slider, where comfort meets versatility in an ergonomic powerhouse! Designed to adapt to your unique needs, this chair is the ultimate companion for long hours at your desk, providing unrivaled support and customizable features to revolutionize your sitting experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Tailored comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its innovative recline rate that adjusts to the weight of each user, the Apollo High-back ensures that every moment spent seated is perfectly balanced and tailored to your body.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EUR-MM95SL-2__59393_480x480.jpg?v=1687379579"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Creative flow unleashed.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether you're brainstorming ideas, crunching numbers, or engrossed in a creative project, this chair ensures your body stays in harmony, promoting focus and productivity like never before.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/apollo-high-back-multi-function-w-seat-slider_Side_480x480.webp?v=1687380144"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp"> Lumbar bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The tall mesh backrest is height adjustable, meaning you can easily align it to the contours of your spine for optimal lumbar support.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/91DwkYXEigL._AC_SY879_480x480.jpg?v=1687380328"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back: 21.7" x 23 " (W x H)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat: 20.5" x 19" (W x D)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height: 18.9" (at lowest point) 22" (at highest point)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cube: 6.9</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 59 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Overall Dimensions: 26" x 24" x 41-44.5" (WxDxH)</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Tension Control: Recline rate adapts to weight of users.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Lock: Locks out tilt function.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Synchro-Tilt: Back reclines in a preset ratio to seat.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Adjustment: Sets seat height to desired position relative to floor.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Forward Seat Tilt: Changes angle of seat to enable proper ergonomic posture while using computer keyboard.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Angle Adjustment: Seat angle will lock in any position from front to back</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Arm Height Adjustment: Adjusts arm up or down for proper ergonomic positioning while seated.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Center-Tilt: Chair tilt from a point under the center of the seat, allowing user to rack back and forth. Tension adjustable.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Back Angle Adjustment: Sets back angle for personalized comfort in reclined position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Waterfall Seat: The front of cushion slopes to reduce pressure on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">2.8" Ratchet Back Height Adjustment: Backrest easily adjusts up or down relative to the seat for personalized lumbar region support and comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width Adjustable Arms: Adjusts arms in or out for proper ergonomic positioning.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="header">
<h3>Personalized comfort.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Apollo High-back with Ratchet Back, the ultimate seating solution for those seeking ergonomic excellence and unparalleled comfort. This remarkable chair combines cutting-edge design with various adjustable features to ensure a personalized experience that caters to your unique needs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Seating bliss in motion.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> Say goodbye to rigid, uncomfortable seating arrangements and say hello to a chair that moves with you, ensuring a blissful seating experience throughout the day.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/eurotech-complete-seating-catalog-2-320_480x480.webp?v=1687382293" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/eurotech-complete-seating-catalog-2-320_480x480.webp?v=1687382293"></div>

<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Customized comfort.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed to accommodate a wide range of body types, the Apollo High-back offers both vertical and horizontal adjustability in its armrests. Say goodbye to one-size-fits-all discomfort and revel in the luxury of a chair that adapts to you.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/apollo-high-back-with-ratchet-back_Front_480x480.webp?v=1687383366"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Revolutionize your seating.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Experience the epitome of comfort, style, and functionality with the Apollo High-back with Ratchet Back. Your perfect seating companion awaits, ready to transform the way you work, create, and conquer your day.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/910rzQE9fxL._AC_UF894_1000_QL80_480x480.jpg?v=1687383576"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 47.5 lbs<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Width: 26"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Depth: 20"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Height: 40" - 46"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Height Range: 18.5” - 22"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Seat Dimensions: 20.5" width x 19" depth</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Backrest Dimensions: 19" width x 25" height</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comfortable seat cushion that slopes at the front to lessen stress on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Locks in any position to allow for comfortable seating and ergonomic positioning.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable arms and backrest to provide appropriate ergonomic support.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilts from the center allow users to rock back and forth.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height adjustable to accommodate a range of users.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Smooth roller casters for effortless mobility.</li>
</ul>

seo.title: Kinesis PD7DXT Ergonomic Precision Mouse for both Right and Left HandIntroducing the DXT 2 Precision Mouse: Unleash Your Inner Precision!  Experience a revolution in mouse design with the DXT 2 Precision Mouse, a game-changer that takes your productivity to soaring heights. Crafted to perfection, this innovative marvel promotes a neutral, more vertical wrist posture, while empowering your hand to work its magic with the utmost precision grip. Prepare to embrace a new era of comfort, control, and efficiency like never before!  Say goodbye to cramped and uncomfortable hand positions that hinder your performance. The DXT 2 Precision Mouse is here to liberate your wrist, allowing it to effortlessly adopt a natural, neutral posture. Bid farewell to those nagging aches and strains as you navigate through tasks with ease, unlocking a whole new level of comfort and well-being. Your wrist will thank you!  What sets the DXT 2 apart from the competition is its groundbreaking ambidextrous design. Yes, you read that right! This compact ergonomic marvel is carefully crafted to cater to both left-handed and right-handed individuals. No more struggling to find the perfect mouse fit or compromising on comfort. Embrace true symmetry and let your hand glide smoothly over the surface, unlocking a symphony of precision movements that you never thought possible.  But it doesn't stop there! The DXT 2 Precision Mouse is engineered with a sole purpose in mind – to amplify your precision game. Every curve, every button, and every scroll has been meticulously designed to harmonize with the movements of your hand, delivering unparalleled control and accuracy. Navigate through intricate spreadsheets, create stunning designs, or conquer the virtual battlefield with absolute finesse. The power to excel is now in your hands!  Embrace the future of mouse technology and witness how the DXT 2 Precision Mouse empowers you to achieve more in less time. It's time to break free from the shackles of conventional mouse designs and embrace the ergonomic revolution. Elevate your performance, unleash your true potential, and let your hand dance across the surface with grace and precision.  Upgrade your mouse experience today with the DXT 2 Precision Mouse. Your hand deserves nothing but the best!

title: Humanscale M/FLEX
descriptionHtml:
The M/Flex multi-monitor arm is the most scalable system on the market. It features nesting integrated brackets which you can easily reconfigure to hold up to six monitors without needing to use any tools. With it, you can position the monitor at an optimal height and distance, allowing you to work in a healthy posture. It also provides an added benefit of making collaboration easier.

The M/Flex multi-monitor arm transforms any standard surface into a dynamic and ergonomic workstation.

 

Specifications:

Monitor Weight Range

Up to six 20 lbs monitor on each arm

Maximum Monitor Height

12”

Reach

Up to 24”

Mount

C-clamp

Color

Silver, Black, White

Warranty

15 Years, 24/7 Warranty

 

Features:

  • Frees up valuable desk space.
  • Flexible arms makes collaboration easier.
  • Base bracket accommodates one monitor up to 20lbs in weight.
  • Nesting integrated brackets that makes installation and reconfiguration easy.

seo.description: Elevate your workstation with M/Flex multi-monitor arm. Scalable system allows for up to six monitors with no tools required. Improve posture & health.

title: Humanscale PARA/FLEX
descriptionHtml:
The Para/Flex multi-monitor display is the most flexible and user-friendly computer support solution for data intense environments. It features crossbar wings that can hold up to four heavy monitors. When not in use, you can easily fold it to hide behind one or two monitors.

It has a hand crank with dual-gear mechanism for easy display height adjustment.

 

Specifications:

Monitor Weight Range

1-200 lbs

Maximum Monitor Height

10”

Reach

Up to 24”

Mount

C-clamp

Color

Silver with gray trim

Warranty

15 Years, 24/7 Warranty

 

Features:

  • Frees up valuable desk space.
  • Designed for quick and easy moves, additions and changes.
  • Configurable to create a flat, linear display or smooth, parabolic display.
  • Nesting integrated brackets that makes installation and reconfiguration easy.
  • Integrated cable management system that easily routes and conceals cables.

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergonomic elegance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Apollo II Multi-Function Mid-Back Office Chair, the epitome of ergonomic excellence combined with a sleek design. Get ready to elevate your work experience to new heights with this remarkable chair that effortlessly blends style and functionality.</p>
</div>

<div class="innerText">

</div>

</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 47.5 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Width: 26.4" 37.4 - 20.9</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Depth: 24.8"<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Height: 37.4” - 20.9”</li>

</h3>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comfortable seat cushion that slopes at the front to lessen stress on the back of the knees.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Locks in any position to allow for comfortable seating and ergonomic positioning.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable arms and backrest to provide appropriate ergonomic support.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilts from the center allow users to rock back and forth.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height adjustable to accommodate a range of users.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Smooth roller casters for effortless mobility.</li>

title: Ergo Desktop Wallaby Elite
descriptionHtml:
Ergo Desktop Wallaby Elite

The Wallaby Elite is a dual monitor sit to stand desk top. It can hold two 10 lbs monitors, held by a VESA bracket, which can be moved vertically on the cross bar. With the VESA mounts, you can tilt, pan and rotate your monitors to suit your viewing preference.

It is designed to maintain the same height distance between monitors and work surface throughout. The monitor mounts have up to 7" adjustment from the work surface, but once locked to your desired height, the monitors and work surface will move in unison.

The Wallaby elite also comes with a solid steel base and a stabilization leg to provide extra support to your desk top when used standing.

 

Specifications

Weight capacity

Supports 2 10 lbs, 25" wide monitors

Monitor Height Range

Up to 7” from work surface

Platform Size

28" W x 24" D

Platform Height Adjustment

16.5" above your desk

Base

Solid steel plate, 17.5" W x 16" D

VESA Compatibility

Standard VESA (75mm & 100mm)

 

Features

  • VESA compatible brackets can hold monitors up to 10 lbs each.
  • Stopping bolt feature locks location of main work surface.
  • Main work surface is adjustable 16.5" above your desk.
  • Main work surface measures 28" wide by 24" deep.

seo.description: Transform your workspace with Wallaby Elite, a dual monitor sit-to-stand desk top. Easily adjust your monitors and maintain perfect height distance.

title: Ergo Desktop Wallaby
descriptionHtml:
Ergo Desktop Wallaby

The Wallaby single monitor desktop will easily transform your workstation from static to dynamic. The work surface is height adjustable designed to maintain the same height distance between monitor and work surface throughout.

While you can adjust the distance between the monitor and the workstation, once locked,the monitor will move simultaneously with with the work surface.

The monitor is held by a VESA bracket which you can tilt, pane and rotate. The solid steel base is very stable. When used standing, use the stabilization leg.

title: Ergo Desktop Wallaby Junior
descriptionHtml:
Ergo Desktop Wallaby Junior

The Wallaby Junior sit-to-stand desk top is smaller than the Wallaby. It can hold a single monitor of upto 12 lbs. Designed to maintain the same height distance between monitor and work surface throughout, it allows for a one-step adjustment when changing to a standing position. You just need to lock your monitor mount to your desired height and it will move simultaneously with the work surface.

Held by a VESA bracket, you can tilt, pane and rotate your monitor for maximum viewing experience The solid steel base is very stable. When used standing, use the stabilization leg.

title: Neutral Posture Stand Up Sit-Stand Keyboard Tray
descriptionHtml:
Description

The Stand Up Sit-Stand Keyboard Tray is an affordable and easy-to-use sit-stand conversion kit is ergonomically designed to lessen muscle fatigue and even prevent Repetitive Strain Injury (RSI) resulting from working all day in front of the computer.

This award-winning workstation solution can boost the height range of any keyboard tray system, allowing users to alternate between sitting down and standing up while working. This means that you get to stretch your legs and arms from time to time while working, improving respiration, reaction alertness and productivity.

 

Specifications


Keyboard Platform

20" W x 11.5" D

Tilt Range

0° to -15°

Vertical Adjustment

From flush to 6" below work surface

Track

6" W x 23" D

Weight

12 lbs

Warranty

Lifetime

 

 

Features

 


  • Additional 2"-11" height adjustment.
  • Compatible with most keyboard tray brands.
  • Infinite range positioning and effortless adjustability.

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 16.25 inches / 41.275 cm</li>

</h3>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Type in pure bliss.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing Welcome to Comfort 2.0, where productivity meets pure bliss! Get ready to immerse yourself in the ultimate typing experience with the revolutionary Goldtouch V2 Adjustable Comfort Keyboard.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless typing mastery.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Feel the difference as you glide your fingers across the keys, effortlessly typing your way to success. This second-generation masterpiece is designed to cater to your individual body and typing style, making work feel like a soothing breeze.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/goldtouchkey-GTN-0099-GLD100-3__89592_480x480.jpg?v=1688067031" alt=""></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Goldtouch V2 Adjustable Comfort Keyboard is here to transform your workspace into a haven of comfort and efficiency. Every keystroke is met gently, reducing strain and minimizing the risk of repetitive strain injuries. No more tense shoulders or aching wrists—just pure typing bliss.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/goldtouchkey-GTN-0099-GLD100-4__22551_480x480.jpg?v=1688066695"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Spill-proof excellence.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Enjoy seamless connectivity with both Mac and PC systems, enabling you to switch between devices effortlessly. The whisper-quiet keys allow you to focus without any distracting clatter, while the spill-resistant design ensures durability and longevity.<br></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/71O18h5624L._AC_UF1000_1000_QL80_480x480.jpg?v=1688069262"></div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">System Requirements: Windows 2000, Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Mac OS 10.4, and newer</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 16.25 inches / 41.275 cm</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height at home row: 1.25 in / 3.175 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 3.3 lb / 1.5 kg</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cable Length: 5 ft 11 inches / 1.8 m</li>

</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Complete Adjustability: With 0°-30° of adjustments on the horizontal and vertical planes, the Comfort Keyboard will straighten your hands, wrists, shoulders, and back, helping to prevent carpal tunnel syndrome and other RSIs.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">A better typing experience: With soft keys, a low activation force and full key travel distance, reduce the risk of “bottoming out” while typing.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Space saving: This compact keyboard will fit nicely into limited spaces, reducing shoulder abduction when reaching for mice and other peripherals.</li>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Portable powerhouse.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the epitome of convenience and style: the remarkable Go!2 Bluetooth Wireless Mobile Keyboard. Uniting the seamless portability of Goldtouch's ergonomic design with cutting-edge Bluetooth technology, this keyboard revolutionizes the on-the-go work experience like never before.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Perfection in portability.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted with meticulous precision, this keyboard boasts full-sized keys that ensure a comfortable typing experience even when you're away from your traditional workstation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="goldtouch-keyboard-goldtouch-go-2-bluetooth-wireless-mobile-keyboard-pc-and-mac-4053906686057_1800x1800.jpg (1003×303)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/goldtouch-keyboard-goldtouch-go-2-bluetooth-wireless-mobile-keyboard-pc-and-mac-4053906686057_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559170861" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/goldtouch-keyboard-goldtouch-go-2-bluetooth-wireless-mobile-keyboard-pc-and-mac-4053906686057_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559170861"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Embrace wireless freedom.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Immerse yourself in a world of wireless freedom as you connect this keyboard to your devices with the latest Bluetooth technology. Say goodbye to messy cables and tangled wires, and embrace the liberating simplicity of a truly wireless connection.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/is201508180465-1_480x480.jpg?v=1687904255" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/is201508180465-1_480x480.jpg?v=1687904255"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Sophisticated ergonomic brilliance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Not only does this keyboard embody ergonomic excellence, but it also emanates elegance in every detail. Its sleek and sophisticated design elevates your workspace, reflecting your commitment to both style and substance.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/3500-3_goldtouch-mobilni-skladaci-klavesnice-bezdratova_480x480.jpg?v=1687904460" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/3500-3_goldtouch-mobilni-skladaci-klavesnice-bezdratova_480x480.jpg?v=1687904460"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">System Requirements: Windows 2000, Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Mac OS 10.4 and newer, iPad 1, 2nd Generation or higher</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Connects via Bluetooth technology.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Please note, this keyboard does not come with a Bluetooth Dongle Adapter. Many newer PC's, Mac's, and laptops have a built-in Bluetooth receiver, and do not require a dongle adapter.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 13.5 inches / 34.29 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Depth (front-to-back): 6 inches / 15.24 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height .9 inches / 2.29 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 1.1 lb / .5 kg</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Folded Width: 7 inches / 17.78 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Folded Depth (front-to-back): 6 inches / 15.24 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Folded Height: 2.5 inches / 6.35 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Key Travel Distance: 2.7 mm, +/-1 mm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Activation Key Force: 40-45g (average)</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Enjoy patented Goldtouch comfort: With our patented lock and lever system, find perfect fit with adjustments from 0º to 30º along the horizontal plane and 0º to 30º along the vertical plane.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No cord catches or tangles: Bluetooth technology will sync this cordless keyboard with all your mobile devices.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Goes where you do: Light, slim, and easy to fold, the Go!2 Bluetooth Wireless Mobile Keyboard is as portable as any mobile device.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Take advantage of driver-free installations: The Goldtouch Go!2 Bluetooth Wireless Mobile Keyboard is compatible with Windows 7, 8, 10, Vista, XP, and 2000, and Mac 10.4 and above. Just pair and play! Additionally, this keyboard has multimedia key support for both Windows and Mac OS.</li>
</ul>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Portable perfection</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the remarkable Goldtouch Go!2 Mobile Keyboard, a true marvel designed for the modern, on-the-move professional. Sleek, slim, and feather-light, this keyboard effortlessly blends portability with unrivaled comfort, making it the ultimate work and travel companion.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Unmatched typing bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">While other travel ergonomic keyboards leave you yearning for more, the Goldtouch Go!2 Mobile Keyboard emerges as a game-changer. Equipped with full-sized keys, this remarkable innovation ensures that your typing experience remains utterly satisfying.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/key_ovation_goldtouch_go2_mobile_keyboard_p5_600x600_67594d48-c248-454d-b12e-0dfa34931e1c_480x480.jpg?v=1687969549"></div>

<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Unparalleled sophistication.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Impeccably crafted with a discerning eye for detail, this keyboard exudes an air of elegance and sophistication. </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/goldtouch-keyboard-goldtouch-go-2-mobile-keyboard-pc-and-mac-4054143008873_1800x1800_0c4152b9-5b89-4f19-ae32-c8139a16d047_480x480.jpg?v=1687970087"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Portable powerhouse.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Goldtouch Go!2 Mobile Keyboard's lightweight construction means you can effortlessly slip it into your bag, barely adding any weight to your on-the-go lifestyle. No more lugging around heavy, clunky keyboards. Embrace the freedom of mobility without compromising on the quality and comfort of your typing experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/GOLDTCH1_480x480.webp?v=1687971133"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">System Requirements: Windows 2000, Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Mac OS 10.4, and newer</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 13.5 inches / 34.29 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Depth (front-to-back): 6 inches / 15.24 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height .9 inches / 2.29 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 1.1 lb / .5 kg</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cable Length: 5 ft 1.5 inches / 1.56 m</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Folded Width: 7 inches / 17.78 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Folded Depth (front-to-back): 6 inches / 15.24 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Folded Height: 2.5 inches / 6.35 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Key Travel Distance: 2.7 mm, +/-1 mm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Activation Key Force: 40-45g(average)</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Find your perfect fit: Adjusts from 0º to 30º along the horizontal and vertical planes, allowing you to find the perfect position that fits your body type.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ergonomic comfort and precision: Features a scissor-switch system for fluid, silent keystrokes with tactile feedback.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Built for convenience: From airplane tray tables to hotel desks, this slim keyboard fits neatly within even the smallest spaces. Additionally, this keyboard folds to a compact size for even greater travel convenience.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Driver-free installations for a wide range of platforms: Compatible with Windows 7, 8, 10, Vista, XP, and 2000, and Mac 10.4 and above. Just plug and play! This keyboard also features multimedia key support for both Windows and Mac OS.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustability: The Goldtouch ergonomic keyboard allows for 0°-30° adjustment on the horizontal plane, combined with 0°-30° adjustment of vertical tenting to help straighten your hands, wrists, shoulders and back</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Soft key touch, low activation force, and full key travel distance provides keying comfort and reduces risk from “bottoming out” when typing.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Compact size allows for use in limited space environments, and reduces shoulder abduction when reaching for mice and other peripherals.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ease of use and intuitive design allow new users to adjust the keyboard to a comfortable typing position without additional accessories or attachments.</li>
</ul>

title: Hat Design Works 7516 Monitor Arm with Handled Brackets
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 7516 Monitor Arm with Handled Brackets

Introducing the revolutionary 7516 monitor arm - the perfect solution for the medical and dental industry! This award-winning product combines the innovative features of our deluxe 7500 monitor mount with a hygienic handled bracket, providing you with a versatile tool that will make your work more efficient and organized.

With the 7516 monitor arm, you can effortlessly control your radial movement with the handle. No more touching the screen and compromising hygiene! The arm also articulates 360 degrees at 3 joints and tilts 200 degrees, allowing maximum flexibility to position your monitor exactly where you need it.

But that's not all - the 7516 monitor arm is also space-saving, folding to occupy just 3.6 inches of space. The integrated cable management routes cables inside the monitor arm to keep your work area neat and organized.

The FLEXmount with six mounting options in one kit makes the 7516 monitor arm adaptable to any workspace. It's also VESA-monitor compatible with 75mm & 100mm, and customizable with an optional 6" extender tube available to raise your monitor.

Say goodbye to the hassle of adjusting your monitor, and upgrade to the 7516 monitor arm for a better, more efficient work experience. Get yours today and experience the ultimate convenience, flexibility, and adaptability!


Models

  • 7516-800 Supports monitors 0.5 - 16.5 lbs
  • 7516-1000 Supports monitors 2.5 - 22.5 lbs

Features

  • Convenience: Use handles to quickly reposition the monitor without touching the screen.
  • Flexible: Arm articulates 360 degrees at 3 joints and tilts 200 degrees, allowing maximum flexibility.
  • Space-saving: Arm can be folded to occupy just 3.6" of space.
  • Adaptable: Includes FLEXmount with six mounting options in one kit.
  • Compatible: VESA-monitor compatible – 75mm & 100mm.
  • Customizable: Optional 6" extender tube available to raise monitor.

Introducing the HDW 7020 under-table monitor mount - the perfect solution for those who want to save space without sacrificing functionality. With its long-reach arm and ergonomic design, this mount is adaptable to users of various heights and allows for effortless and intuitive monitor movement.

Say goodbye to cluttered tabletops and hello to more space for your work essentials. The 7020 mount conveniently mounts from the underside of your table or counter, freeing up valuable table space for other important items. And when you're done using it, the mount easily folds back on itself and stores out of the way, making it a great option for small offices or workspaces.

The 7020 under-table monitor mount also includes an integrated cable management system that keeps cables out of view, giving your workspace a cleaner and more professional look. Plus, its sleek design and sturdy construction make it a reliable and long-lasting addition to your workspace.

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9110-4 Monitor / TV Wall Mount with 4-Inch Extension Arm

The 9110-4 flat panel mount allows you to hang your monitor or flat screen TV on the wall. It helps you save space and at the same time, make your interior look chic and sleek.

The 9110-4 wall mount comes with a 4" extension arm for greater flexibility and range and features adjustable tension at joints. You can tilt and rotate your display for optimum viewing comfort.


 Features

  • Adjustable: This computer monitor and flat screen TV wall mount features adjustable tension at joints – ideal for touch-screen applications.
  • Easy: Easily pivot the monitor from portrait to landscape.
  • Flexible: Monitor can pivot from portrait to landscape.
  • Customizable: Includes 4" extension arm; combine optional extension arms to increase reach.

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Bild Dual Monitor Mount

The Bild® Dual Monitor Mount is a heavy duty mount that accommodates 2 monitors of up to 30 lbs each. Designed to be highly configurable, you can opt to add easy-to-attach extension beams to mount additional monitors.

With its easy to adjust hinges, you can tilt monitors with little effort. It offers three mounting options: desk clamp, thru-desk and rail.

  • Adjustment tools stored in the beam end cap.

title: Hat Design Works Bild 4 Over 4 Monitor Mount
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Bild 4 Over 4 Monitor Mount

Do you find yourself struggling to keep up with multiple monitors on your desk? Introducing the Bild® 4 over 4 multi-monitor stand! This sleek and sturdy stand holds eight 24-inch monitors, allowing you to easily organize your workspace. With two rows of four monitors side-by-side, you'll have plenty of screen real estate to tackle any task.

The best part? Adjusting and replacing monitors has never been easier. No more sliding monitors around or dealing with complicated mounting systems. The Bild® 4 over 4 stand lets you attach, adjust, and remove all at the face of the beam, making it a breeze to customize your setup.

And with a weight capacity of 30 pounds per monitor, this stand is built to last. It even includes VESA adapters to accommodate 75 or 100 mm, so you can rest assured that your monitors will fit perfectly.

Plus, the rail mount includes a 1/420 Drop in Tnut w/ball spring, ensuring a secure fit to most extrusions. Say goodbye to cluttered desks and hello to a more efficient workspace with the Bild® 4 over 4 multi-monitor stand!

descriptionHtml:

Introducing the ultimate solution for your work-from-home or office setup: the 9120 dual monitor mount! Say goodbye to cluttered and cramped desk spaces with this space-saving mount that allows you to easily mount two monitors side by side.

The articulating monitor arms give you the freedom to position each monitor independently, so you can quickly adjust, pivot, and place them exactly where you need them. Whether you're working on a big project or just browsing the web, you can optimize your viewing experience with ease.

Not only does the 9120 dual monitor mount give you complete control over the positioning of your monitors, but it also comes with a 14" pole mount that enables you to set the height at any desired position. So, whether you prefer to work standing up or sitting down, you can adjust the height of your monitors to achieve the perfect viewing angle.

Invest in the 9120 dual monitor mount today and transform your workspace into a comfortable and efficient environment that caters to your every need.

<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the 9109-S Flat Panel Monitor Stand, the ultimate solution for a dynamic and flexible workspace. title: Hat Design Works One Touch Single Freestand - WNSTE-1-270
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works One Touch Single Freestand

 Are you tired of sitting at your desk all day and feeling fatigued and uncomfortable? Say hello to the One Touch electric sit-stand workstation, the perfect solution for a healthier and more productive workday!

With its electric-powered mechanism, the One Touch retrofits your existing desk, making it compatible with any setup. Whether you prefer a freestanding or desk-mounted model, we've got you covered. And with TAA programmable one-touch adjustment, you can easily switch between sitting and standing positions with just the push of a button.

Our workstations are designed with your comfort and ergonomic positioning in mind. The focal depth adjustment allows for independent movement, so you can customize your workstation to fit your body perfectly. And with support for a single display up to 43 inches with VESA 100x100 or 75x75, you'll have plenty of screen real estate to work with.

But that's not all! Our worksurface is 30 inches wide and 28 inches deep, providing ample space for all your essential items. Plus, the included storage tray keeps your desk clutter-free and organized, so you can focus on what really matters - getting your work done!

Upgrade your workspace with the One Touch electric sit-stand workstation and experience the benefits of a healthier, more comfortable workday.

Features

  • Electric Powered: Easily switch positions with just the push of a button.
  • Fast Setup: Installs in less than 20 minutes on an existing desk.
  • Expansive: Monitor mounting is available from one up to six monitors.

title: Atdec Accessory Universal Tablet Holder
descriptionHtml:
The Atdec Universal Tablet Holder improves the ergonomic use of tablets in data analysis, publishing, sales and other environments that benefit from the use of tablet computers in and out of the office. Raising tablet devices off the desk and onto a mount alleviates some of the problems associated with static tablet use by providing an improved viewing height. It's universal design supports any tablet from 7" to 12" (including the Apple iPad range, Samsung and all leading manufacturers**) and it can be attached to any Atdec monitor mount with a 100x100mm VESA mounting hole pattern.

Tablet size generally refers to diagonal display sizing and should only be taken as a guide. The spring loaded hook supports any device with a minimum width or height of 5.5" and a maximum of 10" - based on these figures some smaller tablets and phablets may only be supported when clamped on the long edge of the device (portrait mode) and some larger devices may only be supported when clamped along the short edge (landscape). <div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Secure and space-saving.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Humanscale's CPU600 is a great asset to a workstation that optimizes ergonomic functionality. It features an under-desk mount that allows you to safely secure your CPU under your desk, leaving you ample space to work on it. </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Accessible and efficient.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The CPU600 features an under-desk mount with a 360-degree swivel mount for easy access to cables and ports while also protecting the unit from dirt and other workplace hazards.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/17_humanscale_cpu_600_4_480x480.jpg?v=1688420919" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Built to endure.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Made of durable materials, including steel and aluminum, the CPU600 was built to last. Its strength allows it to accommodate CPUs weighing up to 50 pounds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/17_humanscale_cpu_600_2_7b4c9a9d-9d14-42bc-89f5-885710f7c8e6_480x480.jpg?v=1688421122"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate and Protect.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">It also suspends the unit above the floor, protecting it from dirt and other workplace hazards.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/17_humanscale_cpu_600_1_3146d027-cb9b-4676-895b-74ae11a48b76_480x480.jpg?v=1688421420"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjusts to fit CPUs 3.5" to 9" wide and 12' to 20" tall</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Designed to support CPUs weighing up to 50lbs easily</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Slides smoothly on nylon glides in 16" track</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotates a full 360° for complete access to cables and ports</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Fast and simple tool-free installation via Quick Lock Technology</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Effortless work wellness.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Flexispot ClassicRiser is a series best selling range of height-adjustable sit-to-stand desktops. It allows you to maintain a healthy position while working, making the transition between sitting and standing work modes effortless. Compact and ideal for compact offices</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The ClassicRiser has a deeper desktop surface area to accommodate your monitor, laptop, tablet, and documents. The 35" (M2) supports 30" single monitors and 24" dual monitors, while the 47" (M3) supports up to 30" dual monitors. The 41" is designed to fit in corners and can hold 30" single monitors and dual monitors up to 27". Each has a separate, removable platform for your keyboard and mouse.</p>
</div>
</div>

</h3>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wide and ergonomic removable keyboard platform.</li>

<h3>Rise in Style.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Flexispot CompactRiser is a range of height-adjustable sit-to-stand desktops. It comes in 2 sizes, both with wide and deep surfaces to accommodate your devices, documents, and more, but slim enough to fit in corner workstations. The keyboard tray is ergonomically designed and allows you to work comfortably without putting too much stress on your shoulders and neck.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">

<p class="paragraph">The CompactRiser is ideal for settings with limited spaces and transitions between sitting and standing work modes with ease and comfort. The M5 has a 27" work surface and supports a single monitor up to 27", while the M5M has a 32” work surface and can support up to two 24” monitors.</p>
</div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Available in two size options.</li>

<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Flexispot AlcoveRiser height adjustable desktop range is ergonomically designed to transform your traditional desk into an active sit-to-stand workstation. It is designed with a smart “X” structure and a gas spring hovering system for smooth and even support. <div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Double your efficiency.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ultimate solution for maximizing your workspace and boosting your productivity – The Flexispot Gas Spring Dual Monitor Desk Mount! Designed to hold two monitors with ease, this sleek and sturdy mount will revolutionize the way you work.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless screen control.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its advanced gas spring hovering system, the arms of this mount move with fluid precision, making it effortless to adjust your monitors to the perfect height and angle. No more awkward reaching or craning your neck – this mount does the heavy lifting for you.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/flexispot-monitor-mount-flexispot-gas-spring-dual-monitor-desk-mount-10-27-f7d-6955503583337_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559171460"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash monitor freedom.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But what really sets the Flexispot Gas Spring Dual Monitor Desk Mount apart is its incredible flexibility. The arms can be rotated independently, giving you complete control over the orientation and degree of each monitor. Want one screen in landscape mode and the other in portrait? No problem! Want to position them back to back for a presentation or collaboration session? Easy peasy!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/flexispot-monitor-mount-flexispot-gas-spring-dual-monitor-desk-mount-10-27-f7d-6955503812713_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559171460"></div>
</div>

<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Simplify your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Plus, the mount's streamlined design keeps your desk clutter-free, so you can focus on what really matters – your work. So why settle for a standard monitor setup when you can have the flexibility and convenience of the Flexispot Gas Spring Dual Monitor Desk Mount? Upgrade your workspace today!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/flexispot-monitor-mount-flexispot-gas-spring-dual-monitor-desk-mount-10-27-f7d-6955504009321_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559171460"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight Capacity: 3.3-11 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Product Weight: 13.67 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Screen Size Range: 10"-27"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Maximum Height (Vertical): 15.5''</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Maximum Extension (Horizontal): 20.1''</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Swivel: ±90°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation Range: ±180°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt Range: -85-15°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Material: Aircraft-grade aluminum and professional quality plastic</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk Thickness: Clamp: 0.98"-4.72"; Grommet: 0.98"-4.72" (Size of the hole:1/3 inch-2.75 inch)</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Easy to install.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Independently pivoting arms.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Landscape to portrait monitor display rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Durable hardware that allows for clamp or grommet installation.</li>

title: CHIEF KX Low-Profile Dual Monitor Arm, Column Desk Mount, Black
descriptionHtml:
Chief’s premium Kontour™ KX Series Monitor Arms provide the most complete range of motion available, due to our exclusive FleXlink design. KX Series mounts with FleXlink optimize the depth of dual-, triple- and quad-monitor installs for shallow depth desktops while still providing full range of motion for screen sharing with colleagues.

This series includes Chief's patented Centris™ Extreme Tilt technology for effortless fingertip monitor positioning. Kontour™ monitor mounts float your displays in the optimal ergonomic position above your work surface to create a more productive and comfortable work environment.

 

Key Features

  • FleXlink provides full range of motion while optimizing depth of dual-, triple- and quad-monitor mounts for shallow-depth desktops
  • Best-in-class weight capacity range of 5 to 25 lbs. (2.3 – 11.3 kg) makes specification simple
    • No need to pay more for that "heavy duty" arm to support your Apple monitor or All-in-One!
  • Sleek, solidly-constructed forged aluminum arms in subtle silver, black and white finishes
  • Enhanced patented Centris™ Extreme Tilt provides +75°, -10° of effortless tilt, for optimal viewing comfort whether sitting or standing
  • Enhanced column interface enables easy upgrades from single- to dual- or triple-monitor installations without impacting the existing installation, future-proofing your investment
  • 20" (508 mm) of total height adjustment range
    • 13" (330 mm) of dynamic height adjustment using smooth motion gas-spring technology
    • Additional 7" (178 mm) of manual height adjustment on the column
  • Enhanced 3-step installation and quick-release monitor interface for easy mounting and maintenance, with included tool storage in the base
  • Easily clamps to edge of desk, through standard grommet hole, or through bolt hole with included kit
  • Tool-free cable management covers for a clean, professional look
  • With high levels of recycled content & a highly-recyclable design, Chief Kontour™ monitor arms may contribute to valuable LEED-CI, -NC, and -EB credits!

<div class="header">

<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Das Keyboard X50Q is the world’s first Smart Crossover (Work/Gaming) Keyboard. The ultimate crossover keyboard for professionals who like to game. The X50Q displays important notifications directly on the keyboard keys.</p>

<h3 class="titleComp">Mastered for excellence.</h3>

</div>

<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/das-keyboard-keyboard-das-keyboard-x50q-world-s-first-smart-mechanical-keyboard-for-work-gaming-rgb-soft-tactile-7429245632617_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559173921"></div>

</h3>

</div>
</div>

<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Thought to action.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Faster, more accurate typing, much brighter RGB lighting and unsurpassed 100 million keystrokes. Type at the speed of thought, instinctively moving words directly from your brain to your computer.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/71jp9LMrqtL_480x480.jpg?v=1686585687"></div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Pre-Built Q Applets:Twitch, Game Deals, GitHub, Jira, Asana, Trello CPU, RAM, Gmail, etc.</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Das German Engineering: Durable build quality to instill confidence and precision</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Detachable Ergonomic Soft Touch Wrist Rest & WASD keycaps included</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Crafted for perfection.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Das Keyboard, 4 Professional for Mac mechanical keyboard experience, is like no other. From the initial idea to every fine detail when crafting this machine, The experience We deliver to customers is what drives our team. </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Sensory typing bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The combination of tactile feel, psycho-acoustic experience and incredible craftsmanship all deliver an unmatched typing experience that only Das Keyboard 4 offers. With a Das Keyboard 4 for Mac, you'll Type faster and longer.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/N-key-rollover_480x480.webp?v=1686261804" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/N-key-rollover_480x480.webp?v=1686261804"></div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Das Keyboard, 4 Professional for Mac mechanical keyboard, is specifically designed for maximum Mac compatibility. In addition to standard Command and Alt/Option keys, Das Keyboard 4 Professional for Mac offers quick, convenient access to a number of other Mac specific key functions. It's made of the highest-quality materials and robust construction you can feel.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/das-keyboard-4-for-mac-on-computer_480x480.png?v=1686326629" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/das-keyboard-4-for-mac-on-computer_480x480.png?v=1686326629"></div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>

<p class="paragraph">Das Keyboard uses best-in-class, Cherry MX mechanical key switches that provide tactile and audio feedback so accurate it allows you to execute every keystroke with lightning-fast precision.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/das-keyboard-keyboard-das-keyboard-4-professional-for-mac-cherry-mx-blue-mechanical-keyboard-clicky-7433260859497_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559189944"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Equipped with Soft Tactile Cherry MX Brown switches</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Dedicated media controls with an oversized volume knob</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mac OS-specific key functions</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Two-port USB 3.0 SuperSpeed hub</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Anodized aluminum top panel</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">UV hard coat-protected key caps to prevent fading</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">NKRO over USB for faster typing and programming</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Instant sleep button to save energy</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extra long 6.5 ft (201 cm) USB cable</li>
</ul>

<div class="header">
<h3>Crafted for perfection.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Das Keyboard, 4 Professional for Mac mechanical keyboard experience, is like no other. From the initial idea to every fine detail when crafting this machine, The experience We deliver to customers is what drives our team. </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Sensory typing bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The combination of tactile feel, psycho-acoustic experience and incredible craftsmanship all deliver an unmatched typing experience that only Das Keyboard 4 offers. With a Das Keyboard 4 for Mac, you'll Type faster and longer.</p>
</div>

It's made of the highest-quality materials and robust construction you can feel.</p>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/das-keyboard-keyboard-das-keyboard-4-professional-for-mac-cherry-mx-blue-mechanical-keyboard-clicky-7433260859497_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559189944"></div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mac OS specific key functions</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Two-port USB 3.0 SuperSpeed hub</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Anodized aluminium top panel</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">UV hard coat-protected key caps to prevent fading</li>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Heavyweight freedom.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the M10 - the monster of all monitor arms! With its incredible ability to hold up to a whopping 48 pounds, this single monitor arm is a true game-changer. Say goodbye to cluttered desks and hello to a more spacious and streamlined workspace!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Power and elegance combined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But it's not just about brute strength - the M10 also boasts a sleek and sophisticated design that's sure to complement any office aesthetic.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-single-monitor-arm-s-silver-with-gray-trim-cm-two-piece-clamp-mount-with-base-humanscale-m10-heavy-duty-monitor-arm-holds-up-to-48lbs-10985242689641_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559176468" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-single-monitor-arm-s-silver-with-gray-trim-cm-two-piece-clamp-mount-with-base-humanscale-m10-heavy-duty-monitor-arm-holds-up-to-48lbs-10985242689641_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559176468"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless control.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">And with its innovative Weight-Compensating spring and Smart stop functionality, you'll have total control over your monitor's positioning, making it the ultimate tool for a flexible and dynamic work environment.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-single-monitor-arm-s-silver-with-gray-trim-cm-two-piece-clamp-mount-with-base-humanscale-m10-heavy-duty-monitor-arm-holds-up-to-48lbs-10985242624105_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559176468" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-single-monitor-arm-s-silver-with-gray-trim-cm-two-piece-clamp-mount-with-base-humanscale-m10-heavy-duty-monitor-arm-holds-up-to-48lbs-10985242624105_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559176468"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Amplify <span data-mce-fragment="1">Productivity</span>.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Elevate your work experience with the Humanscale M10 - the perfect blend of form and function. Get ready to unleash your productivity potential like never before!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/workrite-single-monitor-arm-none-none-workrite-conform-heavy-duty-articulating-monitor-arm-3691354620009_480x480.jpg?v=1684181598" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/workrite-single-monitor-arm-none-none-workrite-conform-heavy-duty-articulating-monitor-arm-3691354620009_480x480.jpg?v=1684181598"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sleek, Safe Design: M10’s Smart Stop feature allows the user to stop each joint anywhere along its rotation to prevent monitor or arm overhand on the desk edges. In addition, a built-in Counterbalance Indicator lets the installer counterbalance the monitor weight without a monitor.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ease-of-Use and Agility: With innovative features like its Compensator Mechanism and Self-Lubricating Precision Bearings, M10 allows users to effortlessly adjust their monitor(s) to their optimal ergonomic position while also providing top-to-bottom cable management.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated Technology: M10 is compatible with Humanscale’s revolutionary docking station, M/Connect 2, to eliminate desktop cables and provide a more streamlined workspace. It is also compatible with M/Power – a USB Type-A and Type-C charging station that offers convenient, high-speed charging for personal devices.</li>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__1mpoO">
<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize your Workspace.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph">Introducing the Humanscale M2.1, the revolutionary monitor arm that takes your workspace to the next level of elegance and functionality. With its sleek and beautiful design, this monitor arm can hold up to 15.5 pounds, making it the perfect addition to your workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Maximize your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to cluttered and cramped desk space as the M2.1 raises your monitor up and out of the way, creating more room for you to work and breathe. The Weight-Compensating spring and Smart stop functionality ensure that your monitor stays securely in place, allowing you to adjust it easily.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-monitor-arm-s-silver-with-gray-trim-cm-two-piece-clamp-mount-with-base-humanscale-m2-1-single-monitor-arm-10985715105897_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559179082"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Work comfortably and efficiently.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Not only does the M2.1 enhance your workspace's appearance, but it also makes it more flexible in an ever-changing environment. With this monitor arm, you have the freedom to work comfortably and efficiently, no matter how your workspace evolves.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.humanscale.com/userFiles/images/monitorarms/m2.1/m21_learnpage_2.jpg"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Elegant and functional.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Experience the perfect combination of elegance and functionality with the Humanscale M2.1. It's time to take your workspace to the next level!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.humanscale.com/userFiles/images/monitorarms/m2.1/m21_hero_w.jpg"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;">With innovative features like its Compensator Mechanism and Self-Lubricating Precision Bearings, M2.1 allows users to effortlessly adjust their monitor(s) to their optimal ergonomic position while providing top-to-bottom cable management.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">M2.1’s Smart Stop feature allows the user to stop each joint anywhere along its rotation to prevent monitor or arm overhand on the desk edges. In addition, a built-in Counterbalance Indicator lets the installer counterbalance the monitor weight without a monitor.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">M2.1 is designed to keep desktops efficient and clutter-free now and in the future. Features include an Accessory Bracket, which supports document holders, headphone holders, whiteboards, or whatever wire-shaped accessory you may require at your workspace.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Elevate with elegance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the new Humanscale M8.1 monitor arm - the ultimate solution to elevate your workspace and add a touch of elegance to your desk. This revolutionary monitor arm is designed to hold up to 15.5 pounds, making it the perfect choice for various monitor configurations.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring a patented Weight-Compensating spring and Smart stop functionality, the M8.1 allows you to effortlessly adjust your monitor's height and tilt, giving you complete control over your workspace. Whether you need to raise your monitor up and out of the way or create more desk space, the M8.1 has got you covered.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/humanscale-monitor-arm-w-polished-aluminum-with-white-trim-two-piece-clamp-mount-with-base-t-standard-monitor-tilt-humanscale-m8-1-heavy-duty-single-or-dual-monitor-arm-10986319249513_1800x1800.jpg?v=1559181482"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Style meets functionality.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But that's not all - the M8.1 is also a feast for the eyes, with its sleek and beautiful design that will instantly upgrade any workspace. With the M8.1, you'll never have to sacrifice style for functionality.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/17_humanscale_m8_monitor_arm_edit8_480x480.jpg?v=1684187235"></div>

<div class="container">

<h3 class="titleComp">Flexibility redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">And with its ability to support single monitors from 6 to 28 pounds or dual monitors up to 12 pounds each with optional crossbar support, the M8.1 is the perfect choice for a variety of setups. Make your workspace flexible and dynamic with the Humanscale M8.1 monitor arm - the epitome of elegance and functionality.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/HS_Monitor_Arm_480x480.webp?v=1684187410"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Customer Support: M8.1 supports a better working posture, creates more usable desktop space and helps maintain a clutter-free environment. It offers quick, simple installation and industry-leading flexibility thanks to Quick Release joints that instantly snap together for a secure and robust fit.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sleek, Safe Design: M8.1’s Smart Stop feature allows users to stop each joint anywhere along its rotation to prevent monitor or arm overhand on the desk edges. In addition, a built-in Counterbalance Indicator lets the installer counterbalance the monitor weight without a monitor.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Unprecedented Flexibility: M8.1 is designed to keep desktops efficient and clutter-free now and in the future. Features include an Accessory Bracket, which supports document holders, headphone holders, whiteboards or whatever wire-shaped accessory you may require at your workspace.</li>

descriptionHtml:
Humanscale 900 Tray

An ergonomically designed keyboard is essential for every workstation. Ergonomists agree that the healthiest typing posture is one that allows the wrists to maintain a neutral or slightly pronated posture – straight or bent at a slightly downward angle. For that reason, Humanscale designers created our under-desk keyboard trays, which allow the keyboard to be ergonomically positioned anywhere from 0 degrees to a -15 degree angle.

 

Keyboard Support

In many ways, keyboard support is the heart of an ergonomic workstation. As a reach and vision drive posture, our keyboard tray allows the user to sit in a healthy, neutral posture by bringing the keyboard and mouse to the user in an ergonomic position.

 

Well Designed

A well-designed keyboard tray offers protection from carpal tunnel syndrome, neck and back pain, and other musculoskeletal issues.

 

Postural Benefits

These postural benefits can’t be achieved by just using a keyboard on a height-adjustable work surface.

After many years of designing the perfect ergonomic keyboard were made. The design offers protection from carpal tunnel syndrome, back pain, neck strain, and other musculature issues.

Mouse Platform

The Clip mouse allows the user to change positions of the mousing platform to support their most ergonomic position. With lateral, depth, and tilting adjustments the 900 keyboard tray can be positioned correctly where the user truly needs it. It also supports left-handed and right-handed users.

High clip mouse platforms are models 90 and 91 and support two positions. The first is parallel and to the left or right of the keyboard. The next position is 1.5" above the keyboard tray.

The clip mouse features add at least 4" to a max of 10" to the left or right-hand side of the keyboard tray.

title: Humanscale 5G System With 900 Board and Clip Mouse
descriptionHtml:
Humanscale 5G System 900 Board and Clip Mouse

The Humanscale 5G System 900 Board and Clip Mouse allow the users to bring the keyboard and mouse to the user in an ergonomic Neutral Reach Zone. Rather than just putting your hands on the desk.

 

Many Options

The Humanscale Keyboard System changes the way you work. You can easily choose from a mechanism that will suit your needs for your workstation.

 

Award-Winning

This keyboard tray system comes with Humanscale’s 5G award-winning that combines easy dial-a-tilt and height adjustability with the strongest, most stable arm on the market. Humanscale's under-desk keyboard trays come in many different configurations, including left/right customization, to support any user need.

 

Works with Most Desks

The 5G System 900 Board and Clip Mouse allow you to configure your track size to fit any desk from 11” track all the way to a 27” track. Most standard desks accept the 22” track length. You also have the options to choose from your palm support which allows for a more comfortable work experience

 

Features and Specifications

Features

  • Intuitive height adjustment that requires no locks, levers, or controls
  • Dial-a-tilt positioning allows you to type at the angle most comfortable for you
  • Ultra-thin profile to provide maximum knee clearance
  • Superior design to provide maximum strength and stability yet extremely lightweight
  • Raised tilt mechanism to protect the keyboard from collisions with the edge of the desk

Specifications

  • Tilt adjustment range: 0° to -15°
  • Exceeds BIFMA standards
  • Made primarily of powder-coated steel
  • 15 years warranty

Sustainability

A selection of sustainability highlights for keyboard systems:

  • Recycled content: up to 19% post-consumer
  • Made predominantly of steel, which is highly recyclable

<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Float is a revolutionary standing office desk that brings effortless operation to traditional sit-stand products. Ease of use is at the heart of Float, as it seamlessly adjusts between sitting and standing postures without interrupting workflow. With a minimal aesthetic, Float complements traditional offices and home workspaces.</p>
