<p class="paragraph">Float’s unique technology allows it to adjust up or down while accommodating changing weight loads. This innovative counterbalance mechanism also makes the table simple to adjust, so the user can always find the ideal height for health and comfort.</p>
</div>

descriptionHtml:
Humanscale 5G System 900 Board and Swivel Mouse

The Humanscale 5G System 900 Board and Swivel Mouse allow the users to bring the keyboard and mouse to the user in an ergonomic Neutral Reach Zone. Rather than just putting your hands on the desk.

 

Many Options

The Humanscale Keyboard System changes the way you work. You can easily choose from a mechanism that will suit your needs for your workstation.

 

Award-Winning

This keyboard tray system comes with Humanscale’s 5G award-winning that combines easy dial-a-tilt and height adjustability with the strongest, most stable arm on the market. Humanscale's under-desk keyboard trays come in many different configurations, including left/right customization, to support any user need.

 

Works with Most Desk

The 5G System 900 Board and Swivel Mouse allow you to configure your track size to fit any desk from 11” track all the way to a 27” track. Most standard desks accept the 22” track length. You also have the options to choose from your palm support which allows for a more comfortable work experience

 

Features and Specifications

Features

  • Intuitive height adjustment that requires no locks, levers, or controls
  • Dial-a-tilt positioning allows you to type at the angle most comfortable for you
  • Ultra-thin profile to provide maximum knee clearance
  • Superior design to provide maximum strength and stability yet extremely lightweight
  • Raised tilt mechanism to protect the keyboard from collisions with the edge of the desk

Specifications

  • Tilt adjustment range: 0° to -15°
  • Exceeds BIFMA standards
  • Made primarily of powder-coated steel
  • 15 years warranty

Sustainability

A selection of sustainability highlights for keyboard systems:

  • Recycled content: up to 19% post-consumer
  • Made predominantly of steel, which is highly recyclable

5G Arm, Board Size, And Clip Mouse

Resources

Downloads

 

DOWNLOAD BROCHURE

DOWNLOAD INSTALLATION MANUAL

Shipping

All keyboard systems ship in 1-2 weeks.

Warranty

Keyboard Trays - 15 Years, 24/7 Warranty
Palm Rests & Mouse Pads - 5 Years, 24/7 Warranty

Returns

All returned non-damaged or refused products are subject to a 5% restocking fee. Please contact Customer Service to request a Return Authorization within 45 days of product receipt. If authorized, return instructions will be provided. Return Authorizations expire 60 days after the issue date. Credit is only issued to products in a resalable condition.

Product Care

To clean surfaces use mild liquid soap and water. Gently wipe thoroughly with a soft moist cloth to remove dirt and stains. Dry gently with a dry soft cloth.

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mounting Options: Desk Clamp attaches to surface edge .4" to 2.4" (10 to 60 mm) thick; Grommet Mount attaches through surface holes .31" to 2" (8 to 50 mm) wide and up to 3" (76 mm) thick</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Note: If installed on WorkFit-T or WorkFit-TL, the maximum allowable monitor weight is reduced to 14 lbs (6.4 kg). A separately ordered Grommet Mount (98-017) is required for attachment.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight Capacity: 7 to 25 lbs (3.2 to 11.3 kg). With monitors greater than 20 lbs (9.1 kg) in weight, the vertical range of motion may be reduced up to 4.5" (11 cm) for a total height range of 8.5" (22 cm)</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Instant Transformation: LX installs entirely from above the desk surface and requires very few adjustments during setup, greatly reducing installation time compared to the competition</li>

Choose from white, silver, or black finishes and complement them with optional customization inserts to create a look that fits your workspace.</li>

Humanscale 6G System 900 Board and High Clip Mouse

The Humanscale 6G System 900 Board and High Clip Mouse allow the users to bring the keyboard and mouse to the user in an ergonomic Neutral Reach Zone. Rather than just putting your hands on the desk.


Many Options

The Humanscale Keyboard System changes the way you work. You can easily choose from a mechanism that will suit your needs for your workstation.

 

Award-Winning

Works with Most Desks

The 6G System 900 Board and High Clip Mouse allow you to configure your track size to fit any desk from 11” track all the way to a 27” track. Most standard desks accept the 22” track length. Features and Specifications

  • Raised tilt mechanism to protect the keyboard from collisions with the edge of the desk

  • The clip mouse is the only mouse platform that adjusts in three dimensions to enhance comfort.
  • It can be custom positioned using height, depth, lateral, and tilt adjustability.
  • Place it on either side of the keyboard for right- or left-handed use.

  • Made primarily of powder-coated steel

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Elegant ergonomic excellence.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Diffrient Smart chair, named after its designer, award-winning industrial designer Niels Diffrient is sleek and minimalist. It has a unique linear aesthetic and utilizes a novel tri-panel backrest, providing exceptional support to the lower spine.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Intuitive recline mastery.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring Humanscale’s weight-sensitive, mechanism-free recline, Smart automatically adjusts to the body weight of each sitter to provide perfect recline support. Using the laws of physics, all the users must sit, and the chair will provide the correct amount of tension for their shape.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/446231_17819_XL_480x480.jpg?v=1688576180" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/446231_17819_XL_480x480.jpg?v=1688576180"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Sleek versatile comfort.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Free of manual controls, Diffrient Smart has a striking, sleek aesthetic, and its U-shaped back makes it the perfect fit for any high-design environment. With linear lines in the backrest and a strong mesh for maximum support, it’s the ideal task chair for the modern, active workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Humanscale-Diffrient-Smart-Plus-Ergonomic-Mesh-Back-Office-Chair_1_480x480.jpg?v=1688576483"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless ergonomic bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Eliminating the need for complicated adjustments and external lumbar devices, Diffrient Smart uses Form-Sensing Mesh technology for easy, ongoing comfort.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/diffrient-smart-3-500x500_480x480.jpg?v=1688577369"></div>

</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>

descriptionHtml:
Humanscale eFLOAT

eFloat brings effortless operation to sit/stand desks. Users can easily find the ideal height for health and comfort at the press of a button. Available with a low-profile analog touchpad, or a digital memory touchpad that can store up to four custom positions, eFloat’s electric drive system is fast-moving, allows for noise-free height adjustment, and has a built-in safety sensor. To enhance all-day comfort while sitting or standing, ergonomic tools can be easily mounted onto eFloat thanks to a uniquely expandable frame and stabilizer bar. Accommodating multiple desktop sizes and shapes, eFloat enhances the user experience and seamlessly integrates into any office or home environment.

 

Safe and Spacious

eFloat arrives with a built-in safety sensor, a smart feature that stops the table from bumping into objects. The sensor will halt the table at the appropriate height for standing and seated use — and seated users can take advantage of the generous under-desk space provided for legs, knees, and feet.

 

Clean Lines

Accommodating multiple desktop sizes and shapes, eFloat boasts a clean and modern aesthetic that was designed to seamlessly blend into any home or office environment.

 

A Healthier Choice

The latest research says it’s important to strike a balance between sitting and standing throughout the day. eFloat gives users the ability to move more on their terms.

Features and Specifications

  • Electric drive system is fast-moving and allows for noise-free height adjustment
  • Smart feature that stops the table from bumping into objects halting the table at the appropriate height for standing and seated use
  • Uniquely expandable frame and stabilizer bar that accommodates multiple desktop sizes and shapes
  • 24" and 30" tops from 40 - 72" wide
  • White or silver epoxy-painted bases built primarily of steel and aluminum
  • 20" of vertical movement
  • Work surface adjusts from 26” to 46” measured from floor to underside
  • Supports 220 lbs including the weight of the work surface
  • Controller dimensions 7.3” x 3.9”
  • Optional Humanscale sit-stand adjustable keyboard
  • Sturdy construction meets BIFMA requirements for both load and capacity
  • Table top is 36% post-consumer recyclable and 7% pre-consumer
  • Float base is 65% post-consumer recyclable and 18% pre-consumer
  • Made in the USA

title: Humanscale Neatlinks
descriptionHtml:
Humanscale Neatlinks

Ideal for cubicles, training and conference rooms, trading environments, and private or open-plan offices, the award-winning NeatLinks cable management system makes the tangled clutter of cables, power strips, and ballasts a thing of the past. NeatLinks promotes a more organized workspace and gets wires off the floor to keep under-desk areas hazard-free and easy to clean.

Our NeatLinks system was designed to house and route cables, power strips, and ballasts to improve access to and protection of technology used in modern workspaces. NeatLinks are designed for quick, easy installation in any direction and to almost any plane.

 

Customize Your Space

NeatLinks channels can be installed in countless configurations to accommodate each user and unique work environment. For optimal use, power strips and ballasts should be stored in large-diameter (3.6”) channels and cables routed through small-diameter (2.6”) channels.

 

Easy Installation

Using just two screws or mounting tape, NeatLinks can be installed in countless configurations to accommodate each user and unique work environment. NeatLinks can support up to 8 lbs. of equipment.

 

Out of Sight

With a sleek, unobtrusive design, NeatLinks organizes cables while remaining discreet under desks. The textured surface hides fingerprints, while curved, finger-friendly angles at the ends of each channel ease routing and allow visual access.

title: Humanscale Nova Task Light
descriptionHtml:
HUMANSCALE NOVA TASK LIGHT

Designed to complement any work surface and enhance any workstyle, the new Nova task light offers endless adaptability in a striking, sculptural form. The custom lens and LED array create a uniform pool of glare-free light that can be adjusted exactly to each user's preference. Energy Star-certified to benefit people and the planet, Nova is a lighting solution for today and the future.

Nova’s counterbalance arms rotate up to 180 degrees, offering exceptional customization and ergonomic benefits; they also allow the fixture’s body and head to be effortlessly adjusted with one hand. ‘Forever Hinges’ ensure the arm stays in place without slippage or bounce, keeping the light focused precisely where you want it to be.


Energy Smart

Nova features not only the highest efficiency LED chip on the market, requiring a mere 7 watts to deliver a powerful 440 lumens of light, but also an occupancy sensor that automatically shuts off the fixture when no one is present. Energy Star-certified, it contributes to LEED, WELL, and Living Building Challenge certifications.

 

Exceptional Light Quality

Nova keeps things easy on the eyes, producing a bright, glare-free light that faithfully renders colors and casts a single shadow across a surface. The fixture singlehandedly provides the recommended amount of desk illumination, negating the need for additional — and more costly — light sources.

 

Sustainable Durability

Nova’s LEDs are guaranteed to last at least 50,000 hours, with the fixture backed by an industry-leading 10-year, 24/7 warranty. True to Humanscale’s healthy materials mission, Nova is built without harmful Red-List chemicals.

descriptionHtml:
Humanscale NeatTech

NeatTech is an innovative cable management solution that complements our award-winning height-adjustable table Float, as well as other workstations. NeatTech stores power strips and cables neatly and safely off the floor to protect technology and restore order to the workplace.

A lightweight mesh basket to store power strips and cables, NeatTech features unique Velcro ties to secure wayward cables and offers easy access once installed.

 

Lightweight, Heavy Duty

The mesh design means NeatTech is lightweight but incredibly durable. NeatTech can support a total weight of 10 lbs and comes with a 15-year warranty.

 

Simple Install

NeatTech comes with a simple installation template provided on its packaging for quick and easy installation to any workspace.

 

Fit for You

NeatTech was designed for Humanscale’s award-winning height-adjustable Float table, but works just as well with other workstations. NeatTech comes in three sizes: mini (24" long x 4.5" deep x 4" wide) small (38” long x 4.5” deep x 4” wide) and large (48” long x 4.5” deep x 4” wide).

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergonomic evolution begins.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the VerticalMouse 4 (Right handed mouse) by Evoluent, the revolutionary mouse designed to transform your computing experience with unparalleled comfort and enhanced functionality. Say goodbye to forearm twisting and hello to a new level of ergonomic bliss!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Sculpted for comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted with the utmost care, this mouse boasts a thoughtfully sculpted shape that prioritizes your comfort above all else. No more contorted fingers or strained wrists! The VerticalMouse 4 lets your hand rest in its natural, relaxed position, ensuring a pain-free and healthy computing experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/evoluent-mouse-evoluent-vm4r-verticalmouse-4-right-hand-ergonomic-mouse-with-wired-usb-connection-regular-size-11300122656873_1800x1800.jpg?v=1560282110" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/evoluent-mouse-evoluent-vm4r-verticalmouse-4-right-hand-ergonomic-mouse-with-wired-usb-connection-regular-size-11300122656873_1800x1800.jpg?v=1560282110"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless digital mastery.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Navigating your digital world has never been easier, thanks to the easy-to-reach programmable buttons. With a simple touch, you can effortlessly control your device without any finger acrobatics.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ad3d755a-8d15-4c13-a088-a6abae26e461.__CR0_0_970_600_PT0_SX970_V1_480x480.jpg?v=1687802959" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ad3d755a-8d15-4c13-a088-a6abae26e461.__CR0_0_970_600_PT0_SX970_V1_480x480.jpg?v=1687802959"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Speed at your fingertips.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Adjusting the pointer speed has never been more convenient. With the top-mounted LEDs shining through the chrome thumb rest, you can effortlessly select the perfect pointer speed for your needs. Whether you prefer the extra low (XL), low (LO), medium (MD), or high (HI) setting, the choice is at your fingertips – without even releasing your grip from the mouse.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/d27b25e0-f486-442e-9986-037d227449b0_1.f2525cc5d9d86751e1a65241b6b9bfbe_480x480.jpg?v=1687803270" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/d27b25e0-f486-442e-9986-037d227449b0_1.f2525cc5d9d86751e1a65241b6b9bfbe_480x480.jpg?v=1687803270"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">PREVENTS WRIST DISCOMFORT - Evoluent's ergonomic VM4R VerticalMouse 4 gently supports your right hand in an upright neutral position. The patented shape prevents you from twisting your forearm like you usually do with an ordinary mouse.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">PROGRAM YOUR MOUSE TO YOUR NEEDS - Install the Evoluent Mouse Manager onto your computer to configure the VerticalMouse buttons. Not only can you change their function, but you can also set how the buttons work within different programs.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">ADJUST MOUSE-SPEED FROM LOW TO HIGH - You can adjust the pointer speed from low to high with the optical sensor controls on the side of the mouse. There is no need to release the grip for speed adjustment.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">OFFERS OPTIMUM COMFORT - The VerticalMouse 4 has a broader lip along the bottom edge that prevents the pinky finger from rubbing the desk. The thumb has been reshaped from earlier version to provide more comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">WIDE RANGE OF COMPATIBILITY - USB wired, and is compatible with Windows XP, 7, 8 and 10, Mac and Linux Systems.</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>

title: Evoluent Pillow Tablet Stand - CV1
descriptionHtml:
Evoluent Pillow Tablet Stand 

Introducing the ultimate solution to your device-holding woes - the Evoluent Pillow Tablet Stand! With its comfortable and adjustable design, this stand is perfect for those who want to relax and read, browse or watch without feeling the strain in their hands and arms.

No more awkward angles or neck pain, the Pillow Tablet Stand positions your device at the perfect angle for optimal viewing. Plus, its soft, padded surface provides the perfect cushion for your arm and wrist, making it even more comfortable to use.

Don't worry about compatibility either! The stand accommodates devices up to 0.45" thick, including those with cases. And if you prefer your device "bare", simply use the magnetic insert to secure it in place.

The lower edge of the stand features rubber grips to ensure your device stays put without obstructing the screen. And when you're not using it, simply flip it over to reveal a decorative pillow that blends seamlessly with your décor.

Whether you're lounging on the couch or propped up in bed, the Evoluent Pillow Tablet Stand is the perfect companion for all your device-holding needs. So sit back, relax, and let this versatile stand do all the heavy lifting for you.

 

Specifications

Thickness Up to 0.45 inch or 12 mm
Weight 2 lbs
Dimensions L x W x H = 17 x 16 x 6 inches

 

Features

  • Supports Most Devices: The Pillow Tablet Stand will accept devices up to 0.45" in thickness, meaning it can handle most tablets and phones, even when in cases. A magnetic insert quickly converts the stand for use with thinner "bare" devices.
  • Easily Moved: The Pillow Tablet Stand is lightweight, making it effortless to move between locations or in order to change position.
  • Universal Application: Unlike more traditional "stands" that require a firm, flat surface in order to function, the pillow base works superbly on a lap or other uneven surfaces because it can contour to match the surface profiles. And like traditional tablet stands it can also work equally well on flat surfaces, making it suitable for couch, kitchen, or desk use.
  • Comfortable: The pillow stand is light enough that it is hardly noticeable.
  • Convenient: Because the underside of the stand looks like any other throw pillow it can be kept readily available without affecting the appearance of a room. Just flip the pillow over and the tablet holder is ready for use.

seo.description: Say goodbye to hand fatigue and neck strain! The Evoluent Pillow Tablet Stand provides comfort and convenience for your devices, wherever you relax.

<div class="header">
<h3>Ergonomic excellence.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Evoluent R3K Reduced Reach Right-Hand Keyboard, the ultimate solution for achieving a harmonious balance in your work routine! Say goodbye to the strain and discomfort caused by imbalanced mouse usage, and welcome a new era of ergonomic efficiency.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Reinventing work comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed with meticulous attention to detail, the Evoluent R3K revolutionizes how you interact with your computer. By intelligently redistributing the load between the left and right sides of your upper body, this remarkable keyboard reduces stress on your shoulder muscles, offering a respite from the pains of prolonged mouse usage.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evoluent-keyboard-evoluent-reduced-reach-right-hand-keyboard-r3k-11347629178985_1800x1800_0df8d8eb-4bef-40f4-837a-7ea1862e4742_480x480.jpg?v=1687543914" alt=""></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Left-handed numeric bliss.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Imagine the convenience of having the number pad effortlessly positioned on the left side of your keyboard. With the Evoluent Reduced Reach Right-Hand Keyboard, you can effortlessly input numbers with your left hand while your right hand remains free to navigate the digital realm with precision and ease.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/evoluent-keyboard-evoluent-reduced-reach-right-hand-keyboard-r3k-11347629473897_1800x1800.jpg?v=1561064111"></div>

</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><span>System Requirements: the Evoluent Reduced Reach Right-Hand Keyboard is fully compatible with Windows XP, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10<br data-mce-fragment="1">(The top row of shortcut keys only works in Windows. No driver download necessary).<br data-mce-fragment="1">The Evoluent Reduced Reach Right-Hand Keyboard is also compatible with Unix and Linux systems (with the exception of the hotkeys on the top row)</span></li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><span>Dimensions:Width: 15.9 inches (40.3 cm), Depth: 6.7 inches (17.1 cm), Height: 0.8 inches (2.0 cm)</span></li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><span>Weight: 24.8 oz (704 g)</span></li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><span>Connectivity: Wired USB</span></li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><span>Cable Length: 5 ft 6 inches (1.68 m)</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Unique Keypad Location - The Evoluent Keyboard's numeric keypad is uniquely on the left side to let you put your right-handed mouse much closer to your keyboard, greatly reducing your reach to the mouse for a more relaxed arm position.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Works the Way You Do - Quickly locate the Enter, Del, Page Up, Page Down, arrows, and other keys in the numeric keypad on the left. These often-used keys are also duplicated on the right side of the Evoluent keyboard.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">One-Touch Shortcut Keys - Enjoy one-touch access to the Web, E-mail, cut, copy, paste, volume control, sleep, shut down, and other functions with the Evoluent keyboard's dedicated Windows shortcut keys.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tactile Bumps - Used on often-pressed keys such as Ctrl, Del, Home, Page Down, and the down arrow to aid operation by touch.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Scissor Keys - High-quality scissor key mechanisms have crisp action and no key cap wobble.</li>
</ul>

Freestyle Edge Split Gaming Keyboard

By Kinesis Gaming

The Freestyle Edge is the first split mechanical keyboard designed specifically for gaming. It was engineered with input from hardcore gamers to meet the strictest standards for quality and design. An adjustable 20" braided cable links the key modules to give you unparalleled freedom to customize your rig. There is no wrong way to set up the Freestyle Edge, just dial in your favorite configuration for the ultimate desktop freedom. Funded on Kickstarter!

Specifications

  • Move the right half out of the way and bring your mouse in close for one-handed play to maximize comfort, control, and performance. Separate the modules to shoulder-width for an ergonomic typing posture.
  • Genuine Mechanical Switches (click)
  • Fully Programmable with the Smart Set Programming Engine: 9 Custom Layouts with Dual Layers, Powerful Macros, Quick Remaps, 8 Game Keys, & No-Install Programming App for Windows & Mac
  • Adjustable Blue Backlighting: 9 Brightness Levels and Breathe Mode for soothing pulses of light
  • Detachable Palm Supports, Braided Cables, 4MB Onboard Memory, NKRO, 1MS Response Time & Much More

Lift Kit and V3 Pro for adjustable tenting. Cushioned Palm Pads. XL Desk Mat.

  • Blue LED Backlighting for low-light gaming
  • Up to 20" of separation for unlimited configurations
  • Fully Programmable with the SmartSet Engine
  • Windows 7/8/10, Mac OS X, Linux, & Chrome
  • 1MS Response Time, NKRO Mode, Game Mode, Anti-Ghosting, 4MB Onboard Storage
  • USB Wired (Single Port)
  • US ANSI tenkeyless tournament layout

Freestyle Edge Mechanical Keyboard Features

Cherry MX Mechanical Switches

Cherry switches are the gold standard for gaming and the choice of pro gamers across the world. Super-fast actuation and unmatched durability, rated for 50 million key strokes.

20" Split Configuration

Play one-handed, rotate easily for optimal key coverage or to squeeze in at a LAN, or put separate the modules completely and put your mouse or stream mic in the middle for the maximum comfort and control.

SmartSet Programming Engine

Program the Edge without installing any clunky software or special drivers on your computer. 9 customizable layouts and on-the-fly remaps and macros. Programming App for Windows and Mac.

Blue Backlighting

RGB lighting looks cool, but does it boost your performance? Choose from 9 brightness levels, Breathe mode, or Pitch Black.

4MB of Onboard Storage


All your custom settings are saved to keyboard so you can take your game on the road.

NKRO Mode & Game Mode


Toggle on NKRO and Game Mode and take advantage of 1MS reponse time and Anti-Ghosting for the ultimate gaming experience.


Braided Cables


Braided cables look and feel great, and offer amazing durability.

Game Bank

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revive, move and thrive.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Say goodbye to the perils of prolonged sitting and embrace a new era of well-being and efficiency in your business. Research has unequivocally shown the dangers of extended sitting, revealing that mere outside activity is insufficient to counter its harmful effects. In fact, it takes three times the recommended daily physical activity to eliminate the increased risk of death associated with sitting for long hours. The alarming truth is that sedentary inaction is closely linked to obesity, diabetes, heart disease, back pain, certain cancers, and even a shorter life expectancy.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate and energize.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Don't let your workforce succumb to these health risks! Combat stress, fatigue, and negativity by elevating your employees' moods and well-being. Repetitive Strain Injuries (RSIs), like Carpal Tunnel Syndrome and back pain, have become as prevalent in the workplace as new technology, constituting a staggering 60% of all reported work injuries. In this age of technological advancement, it's high time our workstations adapt to the demands of the modern office. It's time to embrace the EasyLift Desk—an adjustable standing desk converter designed to take your business to new heights of health and productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Goldtouch-Lifestyle-64-cropped-600x403_480x480.jpg?v=1686067957"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With an impressive 40 steps of vertical lift and a counterforce of up to 27 lbs (12kg), the EasyLift Desk is the pinnacle of sit/stand desk solutions worldwide.</p>

<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Goldtouch-KOV-ELP-B-EasyLift-Adjustable-Standing-Desk-Converter_2_480x480.jpg?v=1686068988"></div>

The adjustable sliding keyboard tray allows users to keep their elbows close to their sides, effortlessly maintaining the ideal ergonomic distance from their computer screen—a mere arm's length.</p>

title: Stratis Height Adjustable Desk Executive
descriptionHtml:
You don’t need a corner office to enjoy the best. But you might need a corner desk. The Stratis Executive takes stand-up desks to a whole new level. Built of the same stylish, tough materials as our Premium model, the Executive features recessed controls, an increased load capacity of 330lbs and a convenient surface grommet for complete wire management. So you can truly run the table. Available in 11 designer finishes with left and right options, this sleek desk system can bring a healthy dose of style to any office.

 

 

Features
  • Black legs
  • Height range 24½“ - 50”
  • Recessed controls
  • 1” thick, 48” x 60”, 48” x 72”
  • L-shaped, left & right
  • Grommet hole
  • 11 color options
    • Icicle
    • Aged porcelain
    • Folkstone grey
    • Norway
    • Sable
    • Cocoa pecan
    • Ganache
    • Warm honey
    • Cider
    • Tunisia stone
    • Ivory Biscayne
Specifications
  • Lifting range 24½“ - 50”
  • Frame adjust 43¾“ - 63"
  • Load capacity 330lbs
  • Full load speed 1in/s
  • Input voltage: AC 90V~230V

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revamp your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Say goodbye to neck and back pain from constantly craning your neck to see your computer or tablet screen. With the Dynafly Monitor Arm, you can effortlessly adjust your display's height, focal distance, and tilt angle to fit your needs and preferences.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Sturdy monitor solution.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This cutting-edge monitor arm can handle a wide range of screen weights, so you can rest assured that it will provide a sturdy and reliable display solution. Whether you're using a lightweight tablet or a heavy-duty computer monitor, Dynafly has got you covered.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/dynafly-adjustable-monitor-arm_480x480.jpg?v=1683757455"></div>

<p class="paragraph">Not only is the Dynafly Monitor Arm incredibly functional, but it also looks sleek and modern on any desk. It's slim profile and clean design will seamlessly integrate into any office decor, elevating your workspace's overall look and feel.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/goldtouch-monitor-arm-dynafly-single-or-dual-monitor-arm-holds-up-to-33-lbs-13064185970793_1800x1800.jpg?v=1571132578"></div>

<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/goldtouch-monitor-arm-dynafly-single-or-dual-monitor-arm-holds-up-to-33-lbs-13064186036329_1800x1800.jpg?v=1571132578"></div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">LDC/TV Size: 27" or Smaller</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Max Load Capacity: 33 lbs. (15kg)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Pan: 150° Degrees</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rotation: 360°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt: +90°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Swivel: +/- 40°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA: 75x75mm 100x100mm</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Unsurpassed screen weight range 5.5 lbs - 33 lbs.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The tension controller provides easy monitor balance adjustment.</li>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Effortless elevation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Revolutionize your work experience with the remarkable Goldtouch USB Comfort Mouse, a game-changer in ergonomic design. Say goodbye to discomfort and welcome a new level of productivity as you immerse yourself in a weightless environment that perfectly mirrors the contours of your hand.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Arm bliss unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> Its ingenious design effortlessly supports your arm's natural position, granting you unparalleled comfort during long work hours.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Goldtouch_KOV_GTM_R_Right_Handed_USB_Ergonomic_Mouse_4_480x480.jpg?v=1688062898"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Precise ergo navigator.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed to promote optimal wrist alignment, this mouse is a beacon of ergonomic excellence, taking care of your well-being as you navigate through your tasks with precision.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/kov-gtm-r-front_480x480.webp?v=1688063166"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Comfort and control.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The future of ergonomic design and elevate your work experience with the Goldtouch USB Comfort Mouse. It's time to reclaim your comfort, revolutionize your workflow, and achieve unparalleled productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/6c69ee0d-d870-4ab5-8075-8f4d582752c9._SR300_300_480x480.jpg?v=1688063462"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Goldtouch USB Comfort Mouse features 1000 DPI optical resolution.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The USB 2.0 cable length is 5'4" / 1.63 m</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">System Requirements: Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Mac OS X 10.4 and later, Linux, UNIX</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Length: 4.5 inches / 11.43 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 3.125 inches / 7.94 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height: 2 inches (5.08 cm) at the thumb, 1 inch (2.54 cm) at the small finger</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 5.7 ounces / .16 kg</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No more muscle fatigue: The Comfort Mouse moves your wrist into an ideal 24 degree angle, eliminating the discomfort caused by wrist pronation. A thumb cushion encourages a more comfortable grip.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Over-sized buttons: Your fingers can easily click without overly bending the interphalangeal joints, reducing arthritic discomfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Driver Free Installation: Easy to use Plug-and-Play technology. Compatible with Windows 2000, XP, Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, and Mac OS 10.4 and newer.</li>
</ul>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize and redefine.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ultimate game-changer in the realm of productivity: the Goldtouch USB Comfort Mouse! Revolutionize the way you work by embracing unparalleled comfort and seamless ease like never before.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Weightless comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its ingenious design, this remarkable mouse effortlessly mimics the contours of your hand, creating a weightless sensation that will have you wondering if you're even holding anything at all! It's like working in a cozy cloud of ergonomic bliss.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/31jvgINZ0YL_83acefdd-2d23-436a-9e3e-16be195f5f4b_480x480.jpg?v=1688059303" alt=""></div>

<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Work without weariness.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Goldtouch USB Comfort Mouse takes the concept of ergonomic perfection to new heights. Alleviating pressure on your tendons and joints ensures you can work tirelessly for hours without feeling the familiar ache or fatigue.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/kov-gtm-l-front_480x480.webp?v=1688060048"></div>

<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Your productivity partner.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether editing intricate graphics, poring over spreadsheets, or browsing the web, this mouse will be your trusty companion, empowering you to achieve more than ever before.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/comfort-mouse-top_027fd18b-93ca-46ed-99bc-24bcfed21bcf_480x480.webp?v=1688060780"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Goldtouch USB Comfort Mouse features 1000 DPI optical resolution.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The USB 2.0 cable length is 5’4” / 1.63 m</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">System Requirements: Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Mac OS X 10.4 and later, Linux, UNIX</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Length: 4.5 inches / 11.43 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 3.125 inches / 7.94 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height: 2 inches (5.08 cm) at the thumb, 1 inch (2.54 cm) at the small finger</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 5.7 ounces / .16 kg</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No more muscle fatigue: The Comfort Mouse moves your wrist into an ideal 24 degree angle, eliminating the discomfort caused by wrist pronation. A thumb cushion encourages more comfortable gripping.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Over-sized buttons: Your fingers can easily click without overly bending the interphalangeal joints, reducing arthritic discomfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Plug-and-play technology: There are no drivers to install. Compatible with Windows 2000, XP, Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, and Mac OS 10.4 and newer.</li>
</ul>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize your comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer in ergonomic design: the Bluetooth Comfort Mouse! Are you tired of the discomfort and strain of prolonged computer use? Well, it's time to upgrade your comfort and revolutionize the way you work!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Cloud-like comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This extraordinary mouse is a true engineering marvel designed with your well-being in mind. It's like holding a cloud in your hand, as its weightless environment mimics the natural contours of your palm, providing unparalleled comfort.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/31O2cQTsqHL._AC_UF350_350_QL80_480x480.jpg?v=1687901607"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Angled bliss for wrist.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The secret behind its extraordinary comfort lies in its unique shape. Crafted to perfection, this ergonomic wonder keeps your wrist at a natural 24-degree angle, alleviating pressure on tendons and joints.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/61uS31bqlfL._CR2_0_851_480_SR684_386_480x480.jpg?v=1687898237"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Wireless freedom unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its seamless Bluetooth connectivity, you can say farewell to tangled wires and enjoy the freedom of wireless control. Effortlessly connect to your device and experience smooth, uninterrupted navigation like never before.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/images_f6f1d94d-9283-4d6b-a222-96ab9c32e94d_480x480.jpg?v=1687902106"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Goldtouch Wireless Bluetooth Computer Mouse features 1000 DPI optical resolution.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Bluetooth - supports internal and external Bluetooth adapters.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">2 AAA batteries included.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">System Requirements: Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10, Mac OS X 10.4 and later</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Length: 4.5 inches / 11.43 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 3.125 inches / 7.94 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height: 2 inches (5.08 cm) at the thumb, 1 inch (2.54 cm) at the small finger</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 5.0 ounces / .14 kg</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">More comfort than ever before: The Comfort Mouse moves your wrist into an ideal 24 degree angle, eliminating the discomfort caused by wrist pronation. An oversized thumb cushion will help you grip the mouse without overstretching, no matter what size your fingers are.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Helps prevent RSIs: With proper ergonomic comfort, you’ll reduce the risk of developing carpal tunnel syndrome and other repetitive strain injuries.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Bluetooth technology: Just pair the mouse with your Mac or PC and you’ll be ready to mouse, wherever you are.</li>
</ul>

<div class="header">
<h3>Comfort and convenience.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Goldtouch Bluetooth Wireless Comfort Mouse – where comfort meets wireless convenience, revolutionizing your mousing experience like never before! Say goodbye to discomfort and hello to seamless productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash your freedom.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">No more tangled cords or restrictive movements! With its advanced wireless technology, this mouse liberates you from the confines of traditional mousing. Pair it effortlessly with your Mac or PC, and voila! You're ready to conquer any task with precision and grace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/goldtouch-mouse-goldtouch-bluetooth-comfort-mouse-dongle-adapter-right-handed-only-kov-gtm-btd-13106796396649_1800x1800.jpg?v=1571131982"></div>

</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/61uS31bqlfL._CR2_0_851_480_SR684_386_480x480.jpg?v=1687898237"></div>

</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/key_ovation_goldtouch_ergonomic_mouse_p1_800x800_6ec0521a-8cf7-4b43-b801-940fa9591067_480x480.jpg?v=1687898705"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Goldtouch Wireless Bluetooth Computer Mouse features a 1000 DPI optical resolution.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Bluetooth - supports internal and external Bluetooth adapters.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">2 AAA batteries included.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Length: 4.5 inches / 11.43 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 3.125 inches / 7.94 cm</li>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cutting-edge comfort: Designed to mirror your hand in a weightless environment, the Comfort Mouse gently tilts your wrist to an ideal 24-degree angle to alleviate pressure on tendons and joints.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Better gripping: Oversized buttons and a thumb grip reduce awkward finger bending and stretching.<br>
</li>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize your comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Goldtouch Semi-Vertical Mouse, the ultimate blend of ergonomic brilliance and intuitive design. Say goodbye to the limitations of traditional mice and embrace a whole new level of comfort and efficiency!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Perfect fit and comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted with care, this remarkable mouse features a perfectly calculated slope of 66 degrees, striking the perfect balance between a conventional ergonomic mouse and a vertical marvel. It's the Goldilocks of mice, ensuring you have the ideal fit for your hand and the utmost comfort during long hours of work or play.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/twit3_480x480.jpg?v=1687988701"></div>

<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Gravity-powered precision.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Unlike its vertical counterparts, our Semi-Vertical Mouse leverages the force of gravity to make every click a breeze. With this innovative mouse, you'll effortlessly navigate through tasks without sacrificing comfort or precision.<br></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Goldtouch_KOV-GSV-RM_Semi-Vertical_Wired_Mouse_Right-Handed_2_f3b924b2-0fb6-4db7-a75a-9702ecc23fba_480x480.jpg?v=1687989256"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Maximum productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"><span>By reducing muscle strain and unnecessary pinching, the Goldtouch Semi-Vertical Mouse paves the way for improved productivity and enhanced well-being. It's like having a personal assistant that understands your body's needs, supporting you every step of the way.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/s-l1600_1ee790ad-991d-4dc2-96b6-7c2dfa0e8ab3_480x480.jpg?v=1687989521"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Goldtouch Wired Semi-Vertical Mouse features 1000, 1500, 2000, and 2500 DPI optical resolution.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Wired Cable length is 6' 3.8125" / 1.93 m</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Windows 10, Windows 8, Windows 7, Windows Vista, Windows 2000, Windows XP, Mac, Linux</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Length: 4.3125 inches (6.375 inches with flange attachment) / 10.95 cm (16.19 cm with flange attachment)<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 3.125 inches (4 inches with flange attachment) / 7.94 cm (10.16 cm with flange attachment)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height: 3.25 inches / 8.26 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 4.5 ounces (6 ounces with flange attachment) / .13 kg (.17 kg with flange attachment)</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sizing: Users with hands up to 7.5" can comfortably use this mouse. If the attachment flange accessory is added, users with hands up to 8" can comfortably use this mouse.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal Slope: 66-degree slope creates optimal comfort and hand/wrist positioning.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Flange Accessory: Detachable Ergo-grip flange keeps the palm off the desk's surface.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comfortable Feel: Anti-slip texture grip and rubberized coating provide maximum comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Forward/Back Keys: Page forward or Page back with convenient thumb keys.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable Weights: Four detachable 5g block weights for customized weighting.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Plug & Play: Insert the USB cable into an open USB port and begin mousing.</li>
</ul>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergo-perfection unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary Goldtouch Semi-Vertical Mouse, where form meets function most ingeniously! Harnessing the power of gravity means you'll experience reduced thumb-to-finger movement, sparing you from unnecessary strain and ensuring a smoother, more natural workflow.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Style meets comfort bliss.</h3>

</div>

</div>
</div>

</div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Goldtouch Wireless Semi-Vertical Mouse features 800, 1200, and 1600 DPI optical resolution.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: Windows 10, Windows 8, Windows 7, Windows Vista, Windows 2000, Windows XP, Mac, Linux<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Length: 4.3125 inches (6.375 inches with flange attachment) / 10.95 cm (16.19 cm with flange attachment)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Width: 3.125 inches (4 inches with flange attachment) / 7.94 cm (10.16 cm with flange attachment)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height: 3.25 inches / 8.26 cm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight: 4.5 ounces (6 ounces with flange attachment) / .13 kg (.17 kg with flange attachment)</li>

</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sizing: Users with hands up to 7.5" can comfortably use this mouse. If the attachment flange accessory is added, users with hands up to 8" can comfortably use this mouse.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal Slope: 66 degree slope creates optimal comfort and hand/wrist positioning.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Flange Accessory: Detachable Ergo-grip flange keeps palm off the surface of the desk.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comfortable Feel: Anti-slip texture grip and rubberized coating provide maximum comfort.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Forward/Back Keys: Page forward or Page back with convenient thumb keys.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable Weights: Four detachable 5g block weights for customized weighting.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Plug & Play: Wireless USB 2.4 Ghz receiver allows for quick setup</li>

title: Goldtouch Dynafly Adjustable Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Goldtouch Dynafly Adjustable Monitor Arm

Introducing the Dynafly Monitor Arm – the ultimate solution for the modern office worker who demands the very best in display technology. Say goodbye to cramped workspaces and hello to a world of enhanced productivity with this sleek and stylish monitor arm.

Boasting a wide range of adjustment options, the Dynafly Monitor Arm offers seamless and effortless adjustment for height, focal distance, and tilt angle. Whether you're working on a computer or tablet device, you'll be able to achieve the perfect viewing angle with ease.

No matter the size of your display, the Dynafly Monitor Arm can handle it all. With a weight capacity of up to 33 lbs (15 kgs), you can be confident that your device will be securely supported at all times. Plus, the arm's sturdy construction means you can enjoy a rock-solid display without any wobbling or shaking.

With its sleek and modern design, the Dynafly Monitor Arm is the perfect addition to any workspace. Whether you're looking to free up desk space or simply want to enhance your productivity, this arm is the perfect choice. So why wait? Upgrade your workspace today with the Dynafly Monitor Arm and take your productivity to the next level!

 

SPECIFICATIONS 

  • LDC/TV Size: 27" or Smaller
  • Max Load Capacity: 33 lbs. (15kg)
  • Pan: 150° Degrees
  • Rotation: 360°
  • Tilt: +90°
  • Swivel: +/- 40°
  • VESA: 75x75mm 100x100mm
  • Quick Release: Yes
  • Lock: Optional Anti-Theft Kit

FEATURES

  • High-capacity construction and modern aesthetic design.
  • Unsurpassed screen weight range 5.5 lbs - 33 lbs.
  • Tension controller provides easy monitor balance adjustment.
  • Includes quick release and anti-theft system.
  • 180 degree screen turning capability.
  • Integrated cable management system.

seo.description: Increase your viewing display with the Dynafly Monitor Arm, offering a range of monitor adjustment options and a broad range of compatibility.

title: Goldtouch Dynafly Dual Adjustable Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
The Dynafly Dual Monitor Arm allows today's computer users to easily mount their computer monitors for convenient comfortable viewing. The Dynafly Monitor Arm offers a broad range of monitor adjustment and includes seamless adjustments for height, focal distance, and tilt angle. The Dynafly Dual arm can accommodate two monitor screens with weights ranging between 5.5 lbs (2.5 kgs) and 33 lbs (15 kgs)

 

FEATURES:

  • High-capacity construction and modern aesthetic design.
  • Unsurpassed screen weight range 5.5 lbs - 33 lbs.
  • Tension controller provides easy monitor balance adjustment.
  • Includes quick release and anti-theft system.
  • 180 degree screen turning capability.
  • Integrated cable management system.

 

SPECIFICATIONS AND SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:

  • LDC/TV Size: 2 Monitors 27" or Smaller
  • Max Load Capacity: 33 lbs. (15kg) per monitor
  • Pan: 150° Degrees
  • Rotation: 360°
  • Tilt: +90°
  • Swivel: +/- 40°
  • VESA: 75x75mm 100x100mm
  • Quick Release: Yes
  • Lock: Optional Anti-Theft Kit

seo.description: Transform your workspace with the Dynafly Dual Monitor Arm. Easily mount two monitors for convenient, comfortable viewing with seamless adjustments.

title: Jestik HE Vertical Mouse Large Above 185mm, Rechargeable, Right Handed, Wireless 500-2500 DPI, Plus Micro Fiber
descriptionHtml: The right-handed HE Mouse Large Wireless has a vertical grip which provides a neutral, relaxed position of the hand and wrist. You move from the forearm instead of your wrist, which prevents RSI. The mouse fits comfortably in your hand, and supports your wrist and fingers. R-Go Tools was founded in 2010 by ergonomic consultancy firm R-Go Solutions and is known for its ergonomic expertise. The products are characterised by the unique combination of ergonomics, affordability, durability, and design. R-Go Tools' mission is to ensure that a healthy workspace is the clear choice for computer users.

title: Stratis Height Adjustable Desk Premium
descriptionHtml:
Is your office ready to go ergo? The Stratis Premium stand-up desk is a startup-friendly solution. Its adjustable frame, convenient recessed controls and ultra-quiet lift motors make it easy to set your desk height for maximum comfort. Available in a range of sizes with a 265lbs load capacity, the desktop is constructed of 3D rigid Thermofoil that’s extra durable and easy to clean. Choose between standard rectangle or ergonomic V. Need to define your workspace further? Matching acoustic wall dividers are available upon request.

 

Features

  • Black, silver & white legs
  • Height range 24½“ - 50”
  • Recessed controls
  • 1” thick, 30” x 48”, 30” x 60”, 24” x 60” rectangle
  • 1” thick, 30” x 60” ergonomic
  • Grommet hole
  • 11 color options
    • Icicle
    • Aged porcelain
    • Folkstone grey
    • Norway
    • Sable
    • Cocoa pecan
    • Ganache
    • Warm honey
    • Cider
    • Tunisia stone
    • Ivory Biscayne

Specifications

  • Lifting range 24½“ - 50”
  • Frame adjust 43½" - 63"
  • Load capacity 264lbs
  • Full load speed 1in/s
  • input voltage: AC 90V~230V
  • Output voltage: DC 24V
  • Duty cycle: Max. 10%

  • 24" x 60" Rectangle

   

  • 30" x 48" Rectangle

  

  • 30" x 60" Rectangle

  • 30" x 60" Ergonomic

<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Goldtouch Laptop and Tablet Stands, where innovation meets comfort for the ultimate computing experience! Say goodbye to neck strain and hello to a world of ergonomic bliss.</p>

<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The ultimate solution for effortless number crunching and data entry is the Goldtouch Mac USB Numeric Keypad in sleek black! Whether you're a laptop user seeking the convenience of a full keypad or simply on the lookout for a more comfortable and ergonomic way to tackle calculations, this innovative accessory has got you covered.</p>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">System Requirements: The Goldtouch Numeric Keypad supports Mac systems only. Mac systems do not require a Numlock Key to operate. Because these keypads do not have Numlock keys these keypads will not work on non-Mac devices. Mac Operating System 10.4 and newer.</li>

</h3>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Transform your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ESI Ergo Slat Wall Mount - the ultimate solution for a sleek and adjustable monitor display! Say goodbye to neck strain and eye fatigue with this innovative mount that can extend your monitor up to 10.47 inches and tilt up to +30/-25 degrees. And with the ability to rotate a full 180 degrees, you can easily switch from landscape to portrait mode with just a flick of the wrist.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless mounting.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Not only is the ESI Ergo Slat Wall Mount highly functional, but it's also incredibly easy to use. Designed to fit slat/rail widths from .75" to 2.75", this mount comes equipped with a universal slat wall mounting bracket, making installation a breeze. And with a weight capacity ranging from 6.5 to 17.6 lbs, you can be sure that your monitor is securely mounted and won't budge.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/MA-ESI-EDGE-SLAT-4_480x480.jpg?v=1683751398"></div>

<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Customize your workspace.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The ESI Ergo Slat Wall Mount also offers a total height adjustment capability of 11.81 inches, allowing you to find the perfect viewing angle for any task. And with integrated cable management, you can say goodbye to messy cords and hello to a clean and organized workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/unnamed_1_480x480.png?v=1683751441"></div>

<p class="paragraph"><span>Crafted with a sleek silver finish, the ESI Ergo Slat Wall Mount is highly functional and looks great in any workspace. Upgrade your monitor display and take your productivity to the next level with the ESI Ergo Slat Wall Mount - the ultimate combination of style and functionality.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EDGE-SLAT_800w_500h_480x480.png?v=1683751643"></div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for slat wall applications: 0.8"–2.8" wide</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">12.0" height adjustment range</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">13.0" arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">3.0" arm retraction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">+90°/-25° monitor tilt</li>

<h3>Dynamic ergonomic freedom.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ESI Edge Series Wall Mount Single Monitor Arm - the ultimate solution for your ergonomic needs! With its finger-touch dynamic height adjustment, you can easily find the perfect viewing angle for your monitor without breaking a sweat. Designed specifically for wall mount applications, this monitor arm boasts an impressive 12.0" height adjustment range and a 23.5" arm extension, giving you the freedom to customize your workspace to your liking.</p>
</div>
</div>

And with a weight capacity of 6.5 lbs. to 17.6 lbs., this monitor arm can support a wide range of monitors.</p>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Simplicity redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer in ergonomic monitor stands: Beneath the sleek and understated exterior of Eppa lies a powerhouse of functionality. Prepare to be captivated by its minimal design, but don't let its simplicity fool you - this beauty is packed with features that will revolutionize your workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Personalized perfection.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With an impressive 11-inch dynamic height adjustment range, it puts you in complete control of your monitor's positioning. Say goodbye to uncomfortable neck strains and hello to customizable comfort tailored just for you.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EPPA-SLV-Image004_480x480.jpg?v=1686691648" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Heavyweight versatility.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Eppa effortlessly supports monitors weighing up to a staggering 17.6 pounds, making it a heavyweight champion for accommodating various monitor sizes. Whether you're working with a compact display or a massive screen, Eppa ensures a seamless experience with minimal effort required.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/96832_eppa_singlemonitorarm_white_specs_480x480.jpg?v=1686692519" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Limitless adaptability.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> Eppa breaks the barriers with its retractable design, compacting to a mere 4 inches in depth when you need to maximize your workspace. When it's time to expand your horizons, this dynamic stand extends up to 21 inches, providing you with a comfortable viewing distance no matter the size of your workstation. It's time to embrace the flexibility you've been longing for.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/96832_eppa_singlemonitorarm_white_elevate_480x480.jpg?v=1686692030" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Finger touch dynamic height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for worksurfaces: 36.0" deep or less</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">11.10" height adjustment range: 5.23"–16.33" (low/high)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">21.14" arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">3.32" arm retraction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">±90o monitor tilt</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">±360o VESA rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">2.2lb.–17.6lb. weight capacity</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA 75mm/100mm quick mount</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp and grommet mount included</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Empower your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Fellowes Evolve Series Single Short, the ultimate solution for your workspace revolution! This sleek and dynamic monitor arm is here to transform your working experience like never before. With its manual height adjustment feature, you have complete control over finding the perfect ergonomic position for your monitor. Say goodbye to uncomfortable slouching and hello to productivity!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Versatile strength.</h3>

</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EVOLVE_Monitor_Arm_Features_e72a0a36-01fd-4ceb-9815-206fbc8c5321_480x480.jpg?v=1686782814"></div>
</div>

<div class="innerText">

<p class="paragraph">To make your life even easier, we've thoughtfully included a desk clamp and grommet mount with your purchase. Whether you prefer to attach it to the edge of your desk or utilize the grommet hole, the choice is yours! </div>
</div>

<h3>Revolutionize your setup.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The Fellowes EVOLVE1-F is here to revolutionize your work setup like never before. With its sleek design and cutting-edge features, this monitor arm perfectly blends style and functionality.</p>

With a recommended worksurface depth of 24.0" to 30.0", this arm is tailor-made to fit your unique workspace needs.</p>
</div>

</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Productivity elevated.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary Fellowes Evolve1-FM, the ultimate companion for your dynamic workspace! With its sleek design and cutting-edge features, this monitor arm takes your productivity to new heights.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Flexibility redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring finger-touch dynamic height adjustment, the Evolve1-FM effortlessly adapts to your preferred viewing position. Whether you're working on a corner desk or a spacious workstation ranging from 24.0" to 36.0" deep, this versatile arm is your perfect fit.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ESI-Ergo-MonitorArm_480x480.jpg?v=1686767768"></div>

</h3>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ESI-Ergo-MonitorArmTilt_480x480.jpg?v=1686696380"></div>

</div>

<div class="container">

</div>
</div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">

title: Chief K3F310B Kontour K3 Triple Monitor Stand up to two 30" or 3 27" Screens
descriptionHtml:
Flexibility meets form and function with the Kontour K3 Series of elegantly designed static array mounts from Chief. The K3F310, with its extendable array arms, can accommodate up to two 30"+ monitors. With included center monitor head, it can even accommodate up to three 27" monitors.

The K3F310 provides an aesthetic & stable solution for designers, call centers, security desks, IT, health care, control rooms, and other multiple monitor settings.

  • Telescoping Arm rails add 8" (20.3 cm) per Arm of lateral adjustment for larger monitors
  • Centris™ heads can easily be moved from the telescoping rails to the array arms for nearly unlimited lateral adjustment, so aligning monitors horizontally is a breeze
  • Patented Centris™ technology in heads provides smooth, fingertip tilt of 12° in all directions
  • Center column heads feature 10° of vertical tilt
  • Independent height adjustment of each Arm and each Center Head along the column provides easy fine-tuning of vertical screen alignment
  • Array arms can be adjusted from flat up to a 15° angle toward the user for optimization of viewing angles
  • Easy Installation Features:
  • The product comes pre-assembled for fast & easy installation!
  • The teardrop hole pattern simplifies monitor mounting
  • VESA 75 x 75 mm and 100 x 100 mm compatible
  • Tool-free integrated cable management

Chief warrants its products to be free of defects in material and workmanship for 10 years. All warranties are in effect beginning the date the product was invoiced by Chief. Electrical mechanisms (such as lift products) have a 1-year limited warranty. All warranties are in effect for the original purchaser only. Chief disclaims liability for any modifications, improper installation, and/or installations over the specified weight capacity. Chief also disclaims liability for any modifications made to electrical mechanisms, improper installation, incorrect voltage connection, and/or installations over the stated weight capacity. All Electrical Mechanisms are intended for indoor use only and failure to comply will void the warranty.

Returns

Please contact Customer Service to request a Return Authorization within 45 days of product receipt. If authorized, return instructions will be provided. Return Authorizations expire 60 days after the issue date. Credit is only issued to products in a resalable condition.
