<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Space-saving workstation wonder.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph">Introducing the ESI Ergo Edge Dual Monitor Arms - the ultimate productivity hack for anyone looking to elevate their workspace to the next level. Say goodbye to cluttered desks and hello to increased efficiency with these space-saving monitor arms.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Work smart and see clearly.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With flexible arms that move with you, the ESI Ergo Edge Dual Monitor Arms allow you to work smarter, not harder. Thanks to the adjustability of these monitor arms, you'll have a clearer sight line, making it easier to focus on the task at hand.</p>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/maxresdefault_74c87624-ee6f-4d7f-abd6-59d8a31395da_480x480.jpg?v=1683752254"></div>

<div class="innerText">

<p class="paragraph">Don't let a cramped workspace hold you back - the ESI Ergo Edge Dual Monitor Arms are here to take your productivity to new heights. Upgrade your desk today and experience the benefits of a well-organized and optimized workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/unnamed_2_480x480.png?v=1683752314"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">

<li style="text-align: left;">±90° monitor tilt</li>

<li style="text-align: left;">6.5 lbs.–17.6 lbs. weight capacity (per arm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">VESA quick release</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">180° lock-out feature</li>

<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the stylish and versatile ESI Edge Combined Dual Heavy-Duty Monitor Arm - the ultimate solution for maximizing your workspace productivity! <div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer in monitor arms: the sleek and sophisticated Fellowes Edge Dual Horizontal Slider Monitor Arm! Designed with the savvy consumer in mind, this value-engineered marvel is set to revolutionize your workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless collaboration.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to the limitations of rigid monitor setups and embrace the freedom of multiple adjustment points. With the Edge Dual Horizontal Slider Monitor Arm, you'll experience the ultimate convenience of sharing information. Collaborate effortlessly, pivot with ease, and find your perfect viewing angle, all at the flick of a wrist.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/esi-monitor-arms-silver-esi-edge2-ms-13283217047657_1800x1800.jpg?v=1571848238"></div>

<div class="textBlock">

<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Sophistication redefined.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This monitor arm's slim design is the epitome of modern aesthetics. It effortlessly complements the sleek lines and contemporary appeal of the latest monitors, elevating your workstation to a whole new level of sophistication.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/esi-monitor-arms-silver-esi-edge2-ms-13283217014889_1800x1800.png?v=1571848238"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Efficiency meets style.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Edge Dual Horizontal Slider Monitor Arm is your ticket to reclaiming precious desk real estate. Ideal for shallow work surfaces less than 24" deep, it effortlessly tucks away, retracting to a mere 3.5" from the wall. Embrace efficiency without compromising on style.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/esi-monitor-arms-silver-esi-edge2-ms-13283217113193_1800x1800.jpg?v=1571848238"></div>

</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Finger touch dynamic height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for worksurfaces: 30.0" deep or less</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">10.58" height adjustment range: 3.76"–14.34" (low/high)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">15.41" arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">5.74" arm retraction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">+80o/-60o monitor tilt</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">±90o VESA rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">4.4lb.–15.4lb. Weight capacity (per arm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA 75mm/100mm quick release</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">180o lock-out feature</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp and grommet mount included</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Productivity unleashed.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Unleash the full potential of your productivity with the Fellowes Evolve Series Dual, the ultimate companion for your dynamic work environment. This remarkable monitor arm has cutting-edge features that will elevate your work experience to new heights.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Customize and elevate.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Experience unmatched versatility with its manual height adjustment, allowing you to find the perfect viewing position tailored to your needs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evolve2-f-_800w_500h_480x480.png?v=1686781931" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evolve2-f-_800w_500h_480x480.png?v=1686781931"></div>

</h3>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evolve2-f-_800w_500h22_480x480.jpg?v=1686782563" alt=""></div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">+90º/-25º tilt</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">0.0 lbs.–20.0 lbs. weight capacity (per arm)</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA quick release</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp and grommet mount included</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">28.0" max. Monitor width (bezel measured left to right)</li>

Designed to enhance your work experience and elevate your productivity, this cutting-edge monitor arm is a game-changer in the world of office ergonomics.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">

<p class="paragraph">With its intuitive finger touch dynamic height adjustment, the Evolve Series Dual effortlessly caters to your preferred working style. </div>
</div>

</div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">180° lock-out feature</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp and grommet mount included</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">32.0" max. Monitor width (bezel measured left to right)</li>

seo.description: Revolutionize your workspace with the Fellowes Evolve Series Dual! Elevate your monitors, productivity, and success. Order now!

title: Fellowes Evolve Series Dual Motion Monitor Arm
descriptionHtml:
Revolutionize and elevate.

Introducing the Fellowes Evolve Series Dual: Revolutionize your workspace with the ultimate ergonomic companion! Designed to elevate your productivity and comfort, this dynamic height-adjustable monitor arm brings a touch of sophistication to any desk.

Adjust perfectly.

Featuring innovative finger-touch technology, achieving the perfect viewing angle has never been easier. With a mere swipe of your finger, you can effortlessly adjust your monitors' height, tilt, and rotation, ensuring optimal positioning for your individual needs.


Maximize and optimize.

With its recommended compatibility for worksurfaces 24.0" deep, the Fellowes Evolve Series Dual fits seamlessly into any workspace layout, maximizing your desk real estate. Its impressive 16.3" arm extension allows you to extend your screens closer to you when needed, while the convenient 4.0" arm retraction feature saves precious space when not in use.


Quick and hassle-free.

Say goodbye to the hassle of tedious installation with the VESA quick-release feature. Mounting and dismounting your monitors has never been quicker or more convenient.


Specifications

  • Finger touch dynamic height adjustment
  • Recommended for worksurfaces 24.0" deep
  • 16.3" arm extension
  • 4.0" arm retraction
  • +90º/-25º tilt

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Heighten your productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Fellowes Evolve Series Dual - the ultimate companion for your dynamic workspace! With its innovative finger-touch dynamic height adjustment, this monitor arm brings a whole new level of convenience and comfort to your daily tasks.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Stability redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Fellowes Evolve Series Dual is built to support your monitors securely, with a weight capacity of 4.4 lbs. to 15.4 lbs. per arm. Say goodbye to wobbly screens and hello to stability and peace of mind. Its 18.0" pole height provides ample clearance for a comfortable viewing experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EVOLVE2-MS_480x480.png?v=1686859740"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring a VESA quick-release mechanism, swapping monitors has never been easier. Whether you need to switch screens or adjust their position, the Fellowes Evolve Series Dual offers unparalleled convenience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EVOLVE_Monitor_Arm_Features_e72a0a36-01fd-4ceb-9815-206fbc8c5321_480x480.jpg?v=1686782814"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Excellence unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed with excellence in mind, the Fellowes Evolve Series Dual boasts a patented slider design for exclusive Fellowes use, guaranteeing superior performance and durability.</p>
</div>
</div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Finger touch dynamic height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for worksurfaces 24.0"–30.0" deep</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">16.3" arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">6.5" arm retraction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">+80°/-60° monitor tilt</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">±90° VESA rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">4.4 lbs.–15.4 lbs. weight capacity (per arm)</li>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Dynamic elevation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Fellowes Kata Series Dual Monitor Arm – your ultimate companion for an elevated and dynamic work experience! With its innovative finger-touch dynamic height adjustment, this sleek and modern monitor arm effortlessly adapts to your needs, allowing you to achieve the perfect viewing angle with a single touch.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless mounting.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring a VESA 75mm/100mm quick-release mechanism, the Fellowes Kata Series Dual Monitor Arm allows you to effortlessly mount and dismount your monitors, saving you precious time and effort. Say goodbye to tedious installations and hello to seamless adjustability!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Kata_Tool2_800w_500h_1800x1800.jpg?v=1571934983"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Secure and hassle-free.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Rest assured that the Fellowes Kata Series Dual Monitor Arm includes a sturdy desk clamp, ensuring a secure and hassle-free installation on your workstation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/download_96949321-0c06-4383-bbc0-f8b17f8268b8_480x480.jpg?v=1687293657"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Excellence that exceeds</h3>
<p class="paragraph">When it comes to quality and standards, this monitor arm truly excels. It meets the BIFMA x5.5 guidelines, guaranteeing durability, safety, and performance. Invest in a product that enhances your productivity and exceeds industry standards.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Kata_Dual_Clamp_Angled_800w_500h_1800x1800.jpg?v=1571934983"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Finger touch dynamic height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for worksurfaces 36.0" deep or less</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">4.0 lb.–20.0 lb. weight capacity (per arm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA 75mm/100mm quick release</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">180º lock-out feature</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp included</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Meets BIFMA x5.5</li>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Unleash productivity.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you ready to revolutionize your work environment? Look no further than the remarkable Fellowes Evolve Series Triple! Designed with cutting-edge features and uncompromising quality, this monitor arm system is set to transform the way you work.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Extend possibilities.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This arm system offers unparalleled flexibility and adaptability, boasting an impressive 28.8" outside arm extension and a 6.0" center arm extension.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evolve3-ff-_800w_500h_69318305-4e4a-45a9-98ea-46bafe304ad1_480x480.png?v=1686864438" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Mount with ease.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Thanks to the VESA quick mount feature, setting up your monitors has never been easier. Simply attach your monitors with ease and enjoy a secure and stable setup.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EVOLVE_Monitor_Arm_Features_e72a0a36-01fd-4ceb-9815-206fbc8c5321_480x480.jpg?v=1686782814" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Mount your way.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">We understand the importance of versatility, so we include both a desk clamp and a grommet mount, allowing you to choose the ideal mounting option for your workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EVOLVE_Monitor_Arm_Features_480x480_24f5ef4d-2e7e-4be6-88e7-a1e08d622d54_480x480.jpg?v=1686864973"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Manual height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for worksurfaces 24.0” deep or less</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">28.8” outside arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">6.0” center arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">4.0” retraction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">+90º/-25º tilt</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">±90° VESA rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">0.0 lbs.–20.0 lbs. weight capacity (per arm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">4.4 lbs.–15.4 lbs. weight capacity (per outside arm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">18.0” pole height</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA quick mount</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">180º lock-out feature</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp and grommet mount included</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">21.5” max. monitor width: (bezel measured left to right)</li>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Jaw-dropping adjustability awaits.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Say goodbye to uncomfortable positions and hello to seamless adjustability with the Fellowes Evolve Series Triple! Designed to revolutionize your work experience, this innovative monitor arm offers various features that will make your jaw drop.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Fingertip magic.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">We have an incredible finger touch dynamic height adjustment. With just a gentle touch, you can effortlessly raise or lower your monitors to find that perfect eye level.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ESI-Ergo-MonitorArm_480x480.jpg?v=1686767768" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless angles.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Fellowes Evolve Series Triple offers an impressive range of monitor adjustments. With a +80º/-60° monitor tilt (slider mount) or +90°/-25° monitor tilt (standard mount), you can effortlessly find the perfect viewing angle that suits your preference.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ESI-Ergo-MonitorArmTilt_480x480.jpg?v=1686696380" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Strength you can trust.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Safety and stability are paramount, and the Evolve Series Triple delivers. With a weight capacity of 4.4 lbs.–17.6 lbs. on the outer arms and 20.0 lbs. on the middle arm, it can handle a variety of monitors, ensuring your screens are secure and supported.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EVOLVE3-FMS_480x480.png?v=1686867179" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Finger touch dynamic height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for worksurfaces 24.0"–30.0" deep</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">28.8" outside arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">6.0" center arm extension</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">6.5" arm retraction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">+80º/-60° monitor tilt(slider mount) +90°/-25° monitor tilt (standard mount)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">±90° VESA rotation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">4.4 lbs.–17.6 lbs. weight capacity (outer arms)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">20.0 lbs. weight capacity (middle arm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">18.0” pole height</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA quick mount</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">180º lock-out feature</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp and grommet mount included</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">24.5" max. Monitor width: (bezel measured left to right)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Exceeds BIFMA x5.5 requirements</li>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergo revolution begins.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you tired of a static work environment that restricts your productivity? Say goodbye to the limitations of traditional monitor setups and embrace the revolutionary Fellowes Evolve Series Quad! This cutting-edge monitor arm system is designed to enhance your workflow, providing you with a dynamic and ergonomic experience like no other.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Touch and elevate.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring finger-touch dynamic height adjustment, the Evolve Series Quad puts you in control of your workstation. Effortlessly customize the height to suit your preferences, ensuring optimal comfort and reducing strain on your neck and shoulders.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ESI-Ergo-MonitorArm_480x480.jpg?v=1686767768" alt=""></div>

</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Angle mastery.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Optimizing your viewing experience and maximizing your available workspace. With a remarkable +90º/-25º monitor tilt and a ±90º VESA rotation, achieving the perfect angle is a breeze.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ESI-Ergo-MonitorArmTilt_480x480.jpg?v=1686696380"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Mount with confidence.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Safety and stability are paramount, and the Evolve Series Quad has got you covered with a weight capacity of 6.5 lbs.–17.6 lbs. per arm. You can securely mount even larger monitors without compromising stability.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/evolve4-fm-_800w_500h_480x480.png?v=1686946584"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Finger touch dynamic height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Recommended for worksurfaces 36.0" deep or corner applications</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">VESA 75mm/100mm quick release</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">180º lock-out feature</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Desk clamp and grommet mount included</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">49.11" max. monitor width (bezel measured left to right) Note: monitor height/weight might limit size</li>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>

<h3>Elevate your productivity.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you tired of the same old static monitor setup that hampers your productivity and strains your neck? descriptionHtml:
Introducing the KTP320 - the ultimate answer for graphic designers, broadcasters, and multi-screen enthusiasts seeking a sturdy, free-standing solution to showcase their creativity. Designed to accommodate up to 27" screens, this powerhouse monitor mount is the perfect blend of style and functionality.

Built to last, the KTP320 provides a rock-solid foundation for your multiple flat panel displays, ensuring that your screens stay secure and stable. Say goodbye to wobbling and slippage - this mount holds your monitors in place with ease, so you can focus on what matters most: your work.

With its sleek and modern design, the KTP320 adds a touch of sophistication to any workspace. Whether you're working from a studio, office, or home, this mount seamlessly integrates into your environment, enhancing the look and feel of your setup.

So if you're looking for a high-quality, versatile, and durable solution to showcase your multiple monitors, look no further than the KTP320. Upgrade your setup today and experience the difference that a rock-solid, free-standing mount can make!

Specifications

  • Independent adjustment of each screen for proper ergonomic alignment
  • Centris Technology provides smooth, fingertip tilt in all directions
  • The teardrop hole pattern makes mounting the screens quick and easy
  • Heavy-duty, solid steel base and oversize pole for unmatched stability
  • Integrated cable management
  • VESA 75 x 75 mm and 100 x 100 mm compatible

Features:

  • Independent adjustment of each screen for proper ergonomic alignment
  • Centris Technology provides smooth, fingertip tilt in all directions

title: Ergotech Freedom Desk, Height Adjustable Standing Desk - 30" Wide
descriptionHtml:
Ergotech Freedom Desk, Height Adjustable Standing Desk - 30" Wide

The Freedom Desk is an ultra easy sit-stand solution designed with a spacious upper display surface and lower keyboard and mouse tray. It features a gas-assisted lift mechanism that lets you switch easily between sitting and standing in just a few seconds. It also holds up to 35 lbs, while staying steady and solid at any height. It ships fully assembled and ready-to-use – just put it right on top of your current desk, and you’re ready to work.

 

Specifications

  • Unit Weight Capacity: Up to 35 lbs
  • Desk Height Adjustment Range: 5.4" - 18.4" high
  • Desktop Dimensions: 30.0" wide x 24.4" deep
  • Overall Dimensions: 30.0" wide x 29.7” deep x 5.4" - 18.4" high
  • Desktop Thickness: 0.6"
  • Warranty: 5 years

 

Features

  • Lower work surface provides a comfortable and functional workspace
  • Single-handle design puts effortless operation at your fingertips
  • Gas-assisted lifting mechanism allows you to raise and lower easily in just a few seconds
  • Extremely solid base ensures a sturdy and stable work surface at any height
  • Ships fully assembled, no installation required
  • Upper work surface has a 0.5” grommet hole for adding a monitor arm and a reinforced edge to add a clamp mount monitor arm
  • Colors: Black, White

descriptionHtml:

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Streamline your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The ultimate solution for anyone seeking a seamless and versatile monitor setup the Ergotech's Dual Monitor Horizontal Desk Stand! This innovative stand is the perfect blend of form and function, combining lightweight durability with effortless adjustability to create a one-of-a-kind user experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Tool-free monitor setup.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Gone are the days of tedious installation and complex hardware - Ergotech's Desk Stand requires no mounting or clamping, making it the easiest and most accessible solution on the market. With a simple and intuitive design, you'll be able to install and remove your monitors in mere moments, without the need for any additional tools.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotech_100-D16-B02_Dual_LCD_Monitor_Horizontal_Desk_Stand_lg_1539801511_1800x1800.jpg?v=1572986334"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Seamless monitor flexibility.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Once your monitors are mounted, the real magic begins. The pivots on Ergotech's Desk Stand provide unparalleled ease of movement, allowing for effortless monitor positioning with left/right/up/down movement, as well as the ability to view your monitors in either landscape or portrait mode. </p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/files/914W_HCEMnL._AC_SL1500_1800x1800.jpg?v=1683308625"></div>

</div>

Ergotech Triple Monitor Desk Stand w/Telescoping Wings

Only Ergotech monitor desk stands come standard with a lifetime warranty, assuring you that we believe in our product and stand behind it 100%.  Available in a range of mounting options, all Ergotech monitor desk stands are made of steel and aluminum construction and come equipped with our patented Quick Release Pivots for easy, instant setup and adjustment.

The 100 series desk stands are made to be expandable, allowing you to expand up to 6 monitors with just a few extra parts!

 

Specifications

  • Monitor Weight Capacity: 0 lbs - 25 lbs per monitor
  • Monitor Size: Three, up to 27" wide monitors
  • VESA Compatibility: 75X75 and 100X100
  • Tilt: Up 20 degrees, Down 10 degrees
  • Rotation: 180 degrees
  • Warranty: Lifetime
  • Color: Black

Includes

  • (1) Standard 75/100 mm VESA® pivot
  • (2) Quick Release 75/100 mm VESA® Adjustable Pivots
  • (2) 25" horizontal bars with wings
  • (1) 18" wide x 16" deep HD base


Features

  • Ergotech monitor desk stands are made of steel and aluminum construction.
  • Ergotech's patented Quick Release Pivots for easy, instant setup and adjustment.

View larger

 

Holds Up to Three, 27" Monitors

The available Telescoping Wings give you 5 extra inches extension on each side of the arm, allowing you to mount up to three 27-inch monitors on the triple monitor stand.

Low Profile

The heavy-duty desk stand is low profile, allowing you to save desktop space while enjoying the use of up to three monitors.

Customize Your View

The Height Adjustable Pivots allow you to perfectly tile monitors across and choose your own custom viewing angles and allow for tilt +20/-10 degrees and tilt left/right 25 degrees.

title: Ergotech OmniLink™ 1-Link-OMLK-B1-00
descriptionHtml:
Ergotech OmniLink™ 1-Link

OmniLink™, an innovative wall mount with extension capabilities, allows you to hang your flat panel directly on the wall to save maximum space. The available 4" and 8.5" extension links allow for an increased extension up to 14.6". OmniLink allows both pivot and tilt, for even greater flexibility and range.


Specifications

• Supports a monitor up to 45lbs
• Includes 75X75/100X100 VESA adapter
• Extends 4" from wall
• Compatible with VESA® displays
• Both portrait and landscape viewing
• Tilt: UP 30° / DOWN: 30°
• One-handed easy monitor repositioning
• 10 Year Warranty
• TAA Compliant

<h3>Workspace liberation begins.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you tired of cluttered desks and limited screen mobility? Say goodbye to the constraints of traditional monitor setups and embrace the freedom of The Freedom Arm®! With its sleek design and effortless installation, this stylish articulating monitor arm will revolutionize your workspace, allowing you to reclaim valuable desk space and unlock the true potential of your monitor.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Boundless flexibility.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Experience the true versatility your monitor deserves as it moves freely around your workspace, adapting to your every need. With 360-degree rotation, 190-degree panning, a tilt-up of 90 degrees, and a tilt-down of 45 degrees, you'll have complete control over your monitor's position, ensuring the perfect viewing angle every time.</p>

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Freedom Dual Arm Light Weight

The Freedom Arm® is a stylish articulating monitor arm that easily mounts to any standard desk (or wall) allowing you to free up valuable desk space. Give your monitor the versatility it needs & deserves to move freely around your workspace!

The Freedom Arm® Dual easily mounts to any standard desk, creating a clutter-free workspace and giving you the ability to fully customize your monitor placement with the touch of your finger. Research proves that dual monitors configurations increase productivity and accuracy among workers. Stop taking the time to switch between windows and increase your viewing space with the Freedom Arm® dual and work more efficiently.

Specifications

  • Includes articulating arm + desk clamp + 8" pole
  • Integrated Cable Management System
  • Monitor Weight Capacity: 4.5lbs - 12lbs per monitor
  • Monitor Size: Up to 27"
  • VESA Compatibility: 75mm & 100mm
  • Apple iMac® Compatibility: Contact Us
  • Height Adjustment: 14"
  • Extension Range: 23.4"
  • Tilt:  +90º / -45º
  • Pan: 180º
  • Rotation: 300º
  • Max Desk Thickness: 2.5"
  • Warranty: 3 years
  • Color: Silver, Metal Gray

<h3>Double the productivity.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the R-Go Zepher C2 Twin Monitor Arm - the ultimate ergonomic and sustainable solution for boosting your productivity and comfort while working with two monitors.</p>

<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Tailored for your comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This modular and circular arm boasts an innovative design that allows you to independently adjust the height, depth, and angle of both monitors. This means you can customize your setup to your exact preferences, ensuring maximum comfort and efficiency throughout the day.</p>
</div>

<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/3_800x_e165a1f1-1215-4d4a-b014-260a4acaa506_480x480.webp?v=1684278266" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/3_800x_e165a1f1-1215-4d4a-b014-260a4acaa506_480x480.webp?v=1684278266"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Not only does the R-Go Zepher C2 Twin Monitor Arm enhance your work experience, but it also helps reduce your carbon footprint. Its sustainable construction and durable materials ensure that you'll be enjoying this product for years to come.</p>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergonomic game-changer.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the R-Go Riser Duo, the ultimate game-changer in the world of ergonomic accessories! This remarkable innovation combines the convenience of a tablet stand with the functionality of a laptop stand, giving you the power to elevate your productivity like never before.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Hands-free freedom.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the R-Go Riser Duo, you have the freedom to choose how you work. Need a hands-free solution for your tablet? No problem! Simply adjust the stand and let it securely cradle your device while you effortlessly browse, read, or watch videos.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EN-RGORIDUOBL-15-768x768_480x480.jpg?v=1689280207"></div>

<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Transform and adapt.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">When it's time to switch gears and tackle your laptop tasks, the R-Go Riser Duo seamlessly transforms into a sturdy laptop stand. With four different height options, you can easily find the perfect viewing angle and typing position that suits your comfort preferences.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EN-RGORIDUOBL-2-AGR-768x768_480x480.jpg?v=1689280580"></div>

<p class="paragraph">Its sleek and lightweight design allows you to effortlessly carry it wherever you go, whether it's to the office, a coffee shop, or even while lounging on the couch.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/EN-RGORIDUOBL-16-768x768_480x480.jpg?v=1689280784"></div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Product material: Aluminium</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Colour: Black</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Serie: R-Go Riser</li>

<h3>Reach new heights.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the R-Go Riser Laptop Stand – the ultimate ergonomic companion for your laptop that will take your productivity and comfort to new heights! descriptionHtml:
The Ella Future of Monitor Arms

Thoughtfully designed to make a statement in any workplace. Precisely engineered for the ultimate in performance. Introducing Ella the next-generation monitor arm from Innovative.

Unique Form, Unmistakable Performance

Ella’s elegant design has been expertly engineered to deliver unparalleled performance across the arm’s entire range of motion.

Instant Transformation

Ella installs entirely from above the desk surface and requires very few adjustments during setup, greatly reducing installation time compared to the competition

See the Big Picture

With support for a single monitor up to 43-inch screen size or two monitors with a 30-inch screen size, Ella allows you to work the way you want without sacrificing style

Aesthetic Adaptability

Whether you want to fit in or stand out, Ella can match your style. Choose from standard finishes of white, silver, or black and complement them with optional customizable inserts to create a look that
fits your workspace.

title: HealthPostures 4000 Rocking Footrest
descriptionHtml:
HealthPostures 4000 Rocking Footrests

Putting a footrest under your desk can help improve your posture. The HealthPostures 4000 Rocking Footrest is a unique rocking footrest for desks that features an incremented rocking action to promote circulation & muscle stimulation by encouraging leg movement. This foot rocker is easy-to-adjust, just apply foot pressure to change position. This under desk foot rocker has a smaller footprint so it takes up less floor space. With anti-skid feet.

The HealthPostures 4000 rocking footrest is finished in black and is made in the USA.

SPECIFICATIONS

  • Width: 17 1/2″
  • Height: 3 1/2″
  • Depth: 11 1/2″
  • Made: USA
  • Color: Black
  • Warranty: 30-day guarantee

FEATURES

  • Features an incremented rocking action to promote circulation & muscle stimulation by encouraging leg movement.
  • Can help improve your posture
  • Unique rocking foot rest for desks
  • Easy-to-adjust, just apply foot pressure to change position.
  • Has a smaller footprint so it takes up less floor space.
  • Anti-skid feet

descriptionHtml:
The Health Postures 6360 TaskMate Go Laptop sit-stand desk is a sleek, cost effective way to enjoy a healthy energetic work-style.

The task mate go laptop assisted lift standing desk with laptop holder and monitor mount is purposefully designed to combine the essential ergonomic features needed to maintain a comfortable, healthy position while remaining sleek and extremely affordable. You can effortlessly move from a sitting position to a standing position improving productivity and comfort and have the freedom to move whenever you like.

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Mobility redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the TaskMate EZ Work Surface – revolutionizing ergonomics in the industrial realm! Say goodbye to uncomfortable workstations and hello to mobility and comfort like never before. This height adjustable work desk is the ultimate solution for tackling tasks with ease, whether you're assembling parts or delicately restoring a precious project.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless ergo bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the TaskMate EZ ergonomic work surface, work becomes a breeze. Experience a world of comfort as you effortlessly transition from a seated position to standing, thanks to its simple manual adjustment feature. No more straining or discomfort – just pure ergonomic bliss!</p>
</div>
</div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Powered by human energy alone, the TaskMate EZ requires no electricity, making it an ideal choice for any setting or location. Imagine the freedom to work efficiently and comfortably wherever you need to, without the constraints of power outlets or cords.<br></p>
</div>
</div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Dimensions: 25"H x 19"W x 5"D</li>

</h3>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The most cost-effective sit-stand workstation on the market, saving money is EZ!</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Worktop adjusts quickly for EZ Comfort and ergonomics</li>

title: Workrite Conform STS (Sit to Stand) Articulating Monitor Arm-CONF-STS-WOPB-S
descriptionHtml:
Workrite Conform STS (Sit to Stand) Articulating Monitor Arm

When mounted on 14” heavy duty pole base, Conform Sit-to-Stand Articulation Arm can be adjusted to ergonomically support 100% of men’s and women’s standing heights. Increased reach makes arm ideal for deep worksurfaces and corner applications. Designed for easy installation, components ship pre-assembled and are simple to configure. Engineered and tested to exceed requirements of American National Standards Institute (ANSI)/Business and Institutional Furniture Manufacturers Association (BIFMA) x5.5. Trade Agreements Act (TAA) Compliant, backed by a 10 year warranty.

 

Specifications

  • Supports: 5–17 lb
  • Maximum reach: 27.2"
  • Stowed depth: 5.25"
  • Vertical range: 18.2"
  • Integrated wire management: Yes
  • VESA Mount compatible: Yes (75 mm & 100 mm)
  • Interchangeable parts: Yes
  • Supports dual-arm applications
  • Includes optional pivot limiter which prevents arm from rotation more than 180°

 

Features

  • Enhance performance through ergonomic comfort
  • Smooth lifting, maintenance-free gas spring (supports 5–17 lb monitors)
  • Expandable, interchangeable components ensure future adaptability
  • Designed for fast, easy installation
  • Easily route and conceal cables through the integrated wire managers
  • Quickly folds down to provide users with maximum desk space
  • Discrete silver color and design blends into office environments

title: Chief Impact On-Wall Kiosk - Portrait 46" LW Series
descriptionHtml:
The Impact™ On-Wall Kiosk brings new flexibility to the digital signage enclosure market while maintaining a sleek aesthetic to complement a variety of environments. A depth-adjustable exterior frame allows for a variety of displays to be used. Reversible hinges help to avoid installation and service obstructions, and the exclusive design keeps the display mounted to the frame when opened, providing unparalleled service and maintenance access.

 

 

Key Features

  • Depth-adjustable exterior frame supports a wide range of displays
  • A wall protrusion of 4" (101mm) or less can be obtained by using flat panels less than 2.75" (70mm) in depth
  • Integrated wall reveal compensates for uneven walls to keep the frame plumb and provides passive cooling
  • Exclusive design keeps the display mounted to the frame when opened for unparalleled service and maintenance access
  • Reversible hinges to avoid obstructions for installation and service
  • Engagement latch can be secured with tamperproof hardware
  • Multiple storage options available
  • Middle Atlantic’s Lever LockTM technology is integrated to avoid cutting into walls
  • Another Lever Lock can be added
  • Large empty center backing enables use with in-wall boxes
  • Compatible with PAC525 and PAC526 series in-wall boxes, including power options

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Seamless signage evolution.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary Impact™ On-Wall Kiosk, a game-changer in the world of digital signage enclosures! Combining cutting-edge flexibility with an irresistible sleek aesthetic, this kiosk is designed to effortlessly blend into any environment, captivating your audience like never before.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Limitless display innovation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Unleashing the power of versatility, our depth-adjustable exterior frame opens up a world of possibilities. Say goodbye to limitations as you explore various display options, allowing you to customize and showcase your content with unmatched freedom.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/frgveavislnb_480x480.webp?v=1686256073"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless maintenance access.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Our exclusive design keeps the display securely mounted to the frame when opened, granting unparalleled access for service and maintenance. It's like having a backstage pass to hassle-free operations.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/LW46UBP_2_7dd7560f-839a-45f9-8c66-4d8d4edf14da_1800x1800.jpg?v=1585169399" alt="LW46UBP_2_7dd7560f-839a-45f9-8c66-4d8d4edf14da_1800x1800.jpg (800×800)"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Captivate your audience.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the Impact™ On-Wall Kiosk, your digital signage dreams become a reality. Let your imagination run wild, captivate your audience, and transform any space into a captivating visual experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/LW46UBP_7_ad709f34-4ad8-44e4-8f8f-dc2c77cbb90b_1800x1800.jpg?v=1585169399" data-mce-selected="1"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Depth-adjustable exterior frame supports a wide range of displays.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">A wall protrusion of 4" (101mm) or less can be obtained by using flat panels less than 2.75" (70mm) in depth.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated wall reveal compensates for uneven walls to keep the frame plumb and provides passive cooling.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Exclusive design keeps the display mounted to the frame when opened for unparalleled service and maintenance access.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Reversible hinges to avoid obstructions for installation and service</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Engagement latch can be secured with tamperproof hardware</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Multiple storage options are available</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Middle Atlantic’s Lever LockTM technology is integrated to avoid cutting into walls.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Another Lever Lock can be added</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Large empty center backing enables use with in-wall boxes</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Compatible with PAC525 and PAC526 series in-wall boxes, including power options</li>
</ul>

seo.description: Unleash limitless possibilities with The Impact™ On-Wall Kiosk – the ultimate digital signage enclosure, combining flexibility and sleek aesthetics.

title: Chief Impact On-Wall Kiosk - Portrait 49" LW Series
descriptionHtml:
The Impact™ On-Wall Kiosk brings new flexibility to the digital signage enclosure market while maintaining a sleek aesthetic to complement a variety of environments. A depth-adjustable exterior frame allows for a variety of displays to be used. Reversible hinges help to avoid installation and service obstructions, and the exclusive design keeps the display mounted to the frame when opened, providing unparalleled service and maintenance access.

 

 

Key Features

  • Depth-adjustable exterior frame supports a wide range of displays
  • A wall protrusion of 4" (101mm) or less can be obtained by using flat panels less than 2.75" (70mm) in depth
  • Integrated wall reveal compensates for uneven walls to keep the frame plumb and provides passive cooling
  • Exclusive design keeps the display mounted to the frame when opened for unparalleled service and maintenance access
  • Reversible hinges to avoid obstructions for installation and service
  • Engagement latch can be secured with tamperproof hardware
  • Multiple storage options available
  • Middle Atlantic’s Lever LockTM technology is integrated to avoid cutting into walls
  • Another Lever Lock can be added
  • Large empty center backing enables use with in-wall boxes
  • Compatible with PAC525 and PAC526 series in-wall boxes, including power options

title: Chief ConnexSys™ Video Wall Landscape Mounting System with Rails LVS Video Wall System Series
descriptionHtml:
Chief's ConnexSys Video Wall Mounting System solves common video wall challenges of speed, alignment, serviceability and rigidity. The ConnexSys Video Wall Mounting System provides the ability to level each row once by using strut channel to connect multiple mounts together with a simple-to-install system that can handle the largest requirements

The LVS1U ConnexSys Video Wall system landscape mount ships with rails for each mount.

 

Technical Specifications

 

Features

Speed

  • Hang units on a single strut channel for quick row leveling
  • No need for horizontal spacers
  • Vertical measurement is simply the height of the display to the next rail
  • Compatible with most 1-5/8" sizes of channel strut
  • Reduces installation time - especially for XL and recessed configurations
  • Tool-free ClickConnect latching secures displays
  • PowerZone provides 6 points of adjustment in one easy-to-access location at the top of the mount

 

Alignment

  • PowerZone Adjustments
  • Height adjustment ±1" on each interface
  • Tilt adjustment at single pivot point, protects displays from twisting
  • Depth can be set between 4" and 7.4" from the wall, providing a range of "home positions" ideal for recessed installations
  • Both sides adjust independently, compensating for imperfections in the wall
  • Walls can be out of alignment by up to 2" (horizontally)
  • 3 levels of lateral adjustment
  • Mount left/right along rail
  • Interface left/right along mount
  • Lock in lateral guide for fine-tune adjustment using turn knobs, protecting screens from potential collisions

 

Serviceability

  • RapidDraw Display Release
  • Cord release system gently and remotely pops any screen out for easy access and can be extended 13.4" for service
  • Protects displays by not requiring an aggressive push to release/pop-out
  • Releases only on demand, preventing accidental pop-outs
  • The 10' (304.8 cm) cord can be set up to pull for release from any 90 degree angle
  • Kickstand provides 20 degrees of bottom tilt access

 

Rigidity

  • Rigid frame keeps displays where you set them, even after extending for service
  • Adjustable home depth position locks screens in place to maintain alignment despite accidental bumps/pushes

 

Miscellaneous

  • Security - pad lock ¼" shank diameter
  • Safety tested
  • Universal interface
  • Each mount comes out of the box with adjustments set in the exact same position

seo.description: Transform your flat panel installation experience with Chief's Fusion tilt wall mount. Enjoy flexible adjustments, easy cable management & top-notch security.

title: Chief Large Fusion Micro-Adjustable Tilt Wall Mount Fusion Wall-Tilt Series
descriptionHtml:
Chief's Fusion tilt wall mounts were developed based on installer feedback and direct observations of installers in the field. Favorite Fusion features include Centerless shift, Centris tilt, ControlZone leveling adjustment and ClickConnect Latching.  

Benefits included increased stability, fast installation, easy cable management and security. 

The installer-inspired Fusion tilt mount solves top flat panel installation problems, offering flexible adjustments for large displays with a low-profile display mounting solution.

 

 

Technical Specifications

Features

  • Integrated teardrop design speeds up wall plate installation by allowing pre-installation of the bolts to the wall
  • ControlZone Leveling for post-installation fine tuning of height and leveling
  • Centerless Shift provides up to 17.4" (441 mm) of post-installation lateral shift for limitless centering
  • Centris low-profile tilt uses the center of gravity to balance the screen while maintaining a low profile
  • Set screws keep the mount rigid, stable and secure throughout the life of the installation
  • ClickConnect offers an audible click when the screen safely engages with the mount
  • Built-in cable stand provides easy access under the screen
  • A full line of accessories can be installed with the mount and the entire unit can be adjusted together
  • Multiple installation options for various stud distances
  • Exclusive nesting spacers can be stacked to achieve any depth
  • Quick-Store Cords use magnets to easily store and access pull cords
  • Improved cable management with new end caps
  • Integrated Security
  • Ships with a custom hardware kit that can be hung from mount rails if installing in stages
  • Easy Open box with less waste to throw away

 

Specifications:

    UL Listed, OSHPD Approved
  • Color
    Black

    42 - 86"

    16" - 32" (406 mm - 813 mm)

    200 lbs (90.7 kg)
  • Orientation
    Landscape

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionary mounting marvels.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">The ultimate solution for flat panel installation problems is Chief's Fusion tilt wall mounts. Developed based on direct observations and feedback from installers in the field, these mounts have been specifically designed to address common issues and make your life easier.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Solid stability.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring Centerless shift technology, Centris tilt, control zone leveling adjustment, and ClickConnect Latching, the Fusion mounts provide a level of flexibility and precision that is unrivaled in the market. This means increased stability and security for your display, ensuring that it stays exactly where you want it when you want it.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/XTM1U_D5_480x480.png?v=1684425028" alt="" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/XTM1U_D5_480x480.png?v=1684425028"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Simplicity redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But that's not all - the Fusion mounts also offer fast installation and easy cable management, so you can spend less time fiddling with cables and more time enjoying your display. And with a low-profile mounting solution, your display will look sleek and stylish without taking up too much space.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/MTM1U_Large_11452651-da8c-4ada-a1df-074cf8da6f5e_1800x1800.jpg?v=1585346188"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Mount with confidence.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether you're installing a large display in your home or at your place of business, the Fusion tilt mount has got you covered. So why wait? Upgrade your display installation experience with Chief's Fusion tilt wall mounts today!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/msm1u_480x480.webp?v=1684427538"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Certifications: UL Listed, OSHPD Approved</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Lateral Shift1: 2.9" (327 mm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Manual Height Adjustment: 1" (25 mm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Minimum Depth: 2" (51 mm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mounting Pattern Compatibility (Universal Versions): 100 x 100 mm - 650 x 400 mm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Number Of Monitors: 1</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Overall Dimensions (H x W x D): 17 x 25.75 x 2" (432 x 654 x 51 mm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Shipping Weight: 19.31 lbs (8.76 kg)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Solution Type: Universal</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt: +2°, -12°</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Typical Screen Sizes: 32 - 65"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wall Stud Compatibility In: 16" - 24" (406 mm - 610 mm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Weight Capacity: 125 lbs (56.7 kg)</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated teardrop design speeds up wall plate installation by allowing pre-installation of the bolts to the wall.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">ControlZone Leveling for post-installation fine-tuning of height and leveling</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Centerless Shift provides up to 12.9" (327 mm) of post-installation lateral shift for limitless centering.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Centris low-profile tilt uses the center of gravity to balance the screen while maintaining a low profile.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Set screws keep the mount rigid, stable and secure throughout the life of the installation.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">ClickConnect offers an audible click when the screen safely engages with the mount.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Built-in cable stand provides easy access under the screen</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">A full line of accessories can be installed with the mount and the entire unit can be adjusted together</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Multiple installation options for various stud distances</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Exclusive nesting spacers can be stacked to achieve any depth</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Quick-Store Cords use magnets to store and access pull cords easily</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Improved cable management with new end caps</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated Security</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ships with a custom hardware kit that can be hung from mount rails if installed in stages</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Easy Open box with less waste to throw away</li>
</ul>

seo.description: Transform your flat panel installation game with Chief's Fusion tilt wall mounts. Installer-inspired and packed with features for a perfect display every time.

title: Chief Large Fusion Tilt Wall Mount Fusion Wall-Tilt Series
descriptionHtml:
Chief's Fusion tilt wall mounts were developed based on installer feedback and direct observations of installers in the field. Favorite Fusion features include Centerless shift, Centris tilt and ClickConnect Latching.  

Benefits included increased stability, fast installation, easy cable management and security. 

The installer-inspired Fusion tilt mount solves top flat panel installation problems, offering flexible adjustments for large displays with a low-profile display mounting solution.

 

 

Technical Specifications

 

 

Features

  • Integrated teardrop design speeds up wall plate installation by allowing pre-installation of the bolts to the wall
  • Centerless Shift provides up to 17.5" (445 mm) of post-installation lateral shift - 8.75" (222 mm) left/right of uprights - for limitless centering
  • Centris low-profile tilt uses the center of gravity to balance the screen while maintaining a low profile
  • Set screws keep the mount rigid, stable and secure throughout the life of the installation
  • ClickConnect offers an audible click when the screen safely engages with the mount
  • Built-in cable stand provides easy access under the screen
  • A full line of accessories can be installed with the mount and the entire unit can be adjusted together
  • Multiple installation options for various stud distances
  • Exclusive nesting spacers can be stacked to achieve any depth
  • Quick-Store Cords use magnets to easily store and access pull cords
  • Improved cable management with new end caps
  • Integrated Security
  • Ships with a custom hardware kit that can be hung from mount rails if installing in stages
  • Easy Open box with less waste to throw away

 

Specifications:

  • Certifications
    UL Listed, OSHPD Approved, TÜV Certified
  • Color
    Black
  • Lateral Shift
    17.4" (441 mm)
  • Minimum Depth
    2" (51 mm)
  • Mounting Pattern Compatibility (Universal Versions)
    100 x 100 - 879 x 500 mm
  • Number Of Monitors
    1

    16.5 x 34.75 x 2" (419 x 883 x 51 mm)

    18.34 lbs (8.32 kg)
  • Solution Type
    Universal

    +2°, -12°
  • Typical Screen Sizes
    42 - 86"
  • Wall Stud Compatibility In
    16" - 32" (406 mm - 813 mm)
  • Weight Capacity
    200 lbs (90.7 kg)

title: Chief FUSION™ Large Flat Panel Ceiling Mount LCM Single Display Series
tags: Large Single Flat Panel Ceiling Mount
descriptionHtml:
Chiefs FUSION™ Flat Panel Ceiling Mounts are installer inspired and offer perfect TV positioning and flexible adjustments for large flat panel screens. Great for digital signage installations.
  • Ceiling  Plate and extension column are required and must be ordered separately
  • Compatible with traditional 1.5" NPT and new CPA pinned ceiling plates and column systems
  • See ceiling plates and extension columns (Adjustable and Fixed) for 1.5" NPT compatibility
  • See CPA ceiling plates and CPA columns for pin connection compatibility

 

 

Technical Specifications

 

 

Features

  • REPEATABILITY
    • Continuous tilt ranges with four set locking points to eliminate guess work when adjusting multiple screens.
  • ACCESSIBILITY
    • Simple on/off connection for ease of installation and service.

<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary Solace Desktop HD – your ticket to a seamless sit-stand experience that's both quick and easy on the pocket! <div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revolutionize your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Freedom Lift Sit-Stand Workstation, your ultimate gateway to a healthier and more productive work experience! Say goodbye to sedentary habits and embrace the freedom of movement with this remarkable standing desk converter.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Seated to soaring heights.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">In a mere matter of seconds, our innovative gas spring arm system effortlessly elevates your existing workstation, seamlessly transitioning you from a seated position to an invigorating standing stance. Feel the instant surge of energy as you rise above the confines of your chair, ready to conquer the day with renewed vitality.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/1_306cba10-e6ab-4abc-8a0b-246f59047790_480x480.jpg?v=1685988899"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed with your convenience in mind, this workstation is a breeze to operate. With its user-friendly mechanism, adjusting the height becomes a fluid and effortless motion, allowing you to find the perfect ergonomic sweet spot for maximum comfort and productivity. It's time to bid farewell to those long hours of sitting and embrace the health benefits of alternating between sitting and standing throughout the day.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/4_c5751de9-fbdf-4f99-9fc9-292e07825d10_480x480.jpg?v=1685988736"></div>

Plus, its sleek and modern design seamlessly integrates into any workspace, adding a touch of sophistication to your surroundings.</p>

</div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Monitor Options: Single or Dual Monitor</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Available Work Surface Sizes: 26.2" Keyboard Tray</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mounting Options: Desk Clamp</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Silver</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Profound performance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the new Kinesis Freestyle Pro mechanical, programmable ergonomic keyboard. The Freestyle Pro keyboard offers the same advanced ergonomic features as the popular Kinesis Freestyle2, but with the additional benefits of full on-board programmability using our patented SmartSet engine and low-force, tactile Cherry MX brown mechanical key switches.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Comfort redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> Attach the optional V3 Pro or VIP3 Pro tenting accessories (sold separately) to elevate the thumb side of the wrist to reduce painful forearm pronation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/813b6259-a578-4591-9175-189b41ac2ccf._CR0_0_5184_3207_PT0_SX970_480x480.jpg?v=1689178782" alt=""></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Shoulder-wide typing bliss.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Out of the box, the Freestyle Pro supports up to 12 inches of separation which is more than enough to achieve shoulder-width typing for most individuals. If you need a little bit more room, access the cable compartment for an additional 8 inches of stored cable for an extra wide split to accommodate broad shoulders.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/c2Z8Lha8Sd2f._UX300_TTW_480x480.jpg?v=1689179986"></div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Whispering key perfection.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Freestyle Pro (KB900-RDQ model) utilizes the newest Cherry MX Quiet Red stem mechanical key switches which have a linear feel, low activation force, and sound-dampening components to make them quieter than conventional mechanical switches.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/4a49535b-708f-4ee4-87e6-64e60fd1c732._CR0_0_626_626_PT0_SX300_480x480.jpg?v=1689180828"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">AWARD-WINNING SPLIT DESIGN: Advanced ergonomics for all body types and preferences via adjustable split, splay, and tent (tenting accessories sold separately). New cable storage compartment supports up to 20" of separation when you need it.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">GENUINE CHERRY MECHANICAL SWITCHES FOR PREMIUM TYPING FEEL AND PERFORMANCE WITH LESS NOISE: Cherry MX "Silent" red mechanical switches feature a low activation force, linear feel and are rated for 50M key presses for unmatched durability.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">FULL ONBOARD PROGRAMMABILITY WITH THE DRIVERLESS SMARTSET ENGINE: 9 custom layouts, 8 office hotkeys, on-the-fly macro recording, one-touch key remapping, pre-configured Mac and Dvorak layouts, settings saved to keyboards 4MB flash memory, and the SmartSet App GUI for Windows & Mac.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">PLUG-AND-PLAY WITH ALL MAJOR OPERATING SYSTEMS: Windows 7-10, Mac OS X, Linux, Chrome.</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Chair Width: 26.5” Arms / 21” Armless</li>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Effortless Recline: Liberty’s intelligent mechanism-free recline uses the laws of physics and the sitter’s weight to automatically provide the perfect amount of support through the full range of recline. Without manual controls to adjust, the user can change postures effortlessly throughout the day.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Custom Fit: Liberty’s mesh back is formed by combining three panels of non-stretch mesh material in the same way a tailor combines multiple pieces of fabric to create a shirt.
