<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Minimalist ergo elegance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Featuring the same Form-Sensing Mesh backrest as the Liberty Task chair, Niels Diffrient’s Liberty Side provides custom ergonomic support for each user while showcasing minimalist charm. Lightweight, recyclable, and long-lasting components also make this chair as eco-friendly as it is stylish.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Modern sophistication.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Liberty Side chair offers body-fitting comfort and lumbar support. This contemporary, multipurpose chair uses revolutionary Form-Sensing Mesh Technology and a pivoting backrest to provide complete support during a gentle recline.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/222_480x480.jpg?v=1686943073"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Versatile comfort.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Designed to complement the Liberty task chair, the Liberty Side is a beautiful and versatile chair that encourages the same balanced movement throughout the day.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/humanscale_liberty_side_chair_edit4_480x480.jpg?v=1686943308"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Certified excellence.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Liberty Side is Living Product Certified, meeting the most rigorous sustainable manufacturing criteria to date. This means that Liberty Side is climate, water and energy positive.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/humanscale-ltd_liberty-side-chair_photo_0_1164a514-be8f-444d-8834-e74138647470_480x480.jpg?v=1686943604"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Self-Adjusting Recline: The Liberty Side chair features an intelligent counter-balance recline mechanism that automatically provides the right amount of support through the full range of recline motion, regardless of user size and weight. Unlike many conference chairs, it is flexible and encourages the user to stay active, while keeping them comfortable.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Environmental Design: Made predominantly from lightweight 100% recycled die-cast aluminum, the Liberty Side chair was created to be long-lasting and environmentally friendly. Overall, it is constructed from 85% recycled content and is 99% recyclable. The textiles for the chair’s seat were chosen especially to complement the high environmental standard. Its modular design means it can be customized and easily updated as needed.<br>
</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tailored Comfort: With a unique mesh back and seat, the Liberty Side chair is sturdy and supportive, ensuring complete comfort. The back tri-panel construction is breathable due to the mesh and offers customized support, while the backrest pivot offers additional comfort. The mesh seat has a frameless front edge that is supportive yet soft. The perfect chair for conferences, meeting rooms and hospitality seating, the Liberty Side chair’s ergonomic support ensure the user can sit comfortably all day long.</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Elegant and innovative.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the magnificent Diffrient World, a true embodiment of elegance and innovation! This exceptional task chair combines premium lumbar care with unparalleled adaptability, resulting in a masterpiece that will enhance any modern office environment. Get ready to experience the epitome of comfort and style!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Captivating workspace wonder.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its stunning all-mesh design, the Diffrient World effortlessly blends into any workspace, whether it's a bustling corporate headquarters or a cozy home office.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/world2_480x480.jpg?v=1688583954" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Personalized bliss and comfort.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to discomfort and hello to sublime relief as the chair adapts to your unique pressure points, ensuring an unrivaled level of personalized comfort.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Crestline-Humanscale-Diffrient-World-chair-white-white-1500x900_480x480.jpg?v=1688584532" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Create your dream workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This chair is a dream to move around, allowing you to create your ideal workspace wherever you desire.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/desktop_480x480.jpg?v=1688585067" alt=""></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">All-mesh design fits handsomely into any office – no matter where you work.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tri-panel mesh back offers intelligent support for your unique pressure points.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Lightweight design makes it exceptionally easy both to assemble and relocate.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Net Positive certification means each chair produced restores energy and clean water while reducing environmental waste.</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Invisible Recline Mechanism: Diffrient World uses the laws of physics and harnesses the user’s body weight to automatically provide the right amount of recline for every individual, every time. Its groundbreaking mechanism-free recline action leverages two parts of the chair’s frame to provide automatic, balanced support for maximum support throughout the full range of motion.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Responsive Bracket: Diffrient developed the chair’s back using the laws of physics, which eliminates the requirement for separate lumbar support, which tends to create a pressure point and requires manual adjustment. With patented Form Sensing Mesh Technology, the backrest perfectly conforms to the sitter’s entire back as if custom-made for them.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sitting on Air: A truly lightweight chair, Diffrient World replaces the standard cushion seat with a low-abrasion, non-stretch mesh. To maximize comfort, Diffrient eliminated the front edge of the chair, solving a perennial problem of hard edges placing pressure on the knees and contact stress behind the thighs, allowing long-term comfort and total support for every sitter.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

title: Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition A.T. Max Metal Detector
descriptionHtml:
Now you can have your very own Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition AT Max finished in the exclusive Garrett Camo pattern, just like Jase is using in the Duck Family Treasure TV Series! The AT Max metal detector offers maximum detection with powerful, wireless, all terrain performance. Enhanced electronics, a 13.6 kHz operating frequency, and eight Sensitivity/Depth adjustments allow you to detect targets deeper than other Garrett AT detectors. The Garrett exclusive Automated Ground Balance Window feature can simultaneously "spread" the ground balance setting to a range of values to reduce ground response in severely mineralized areas. Automatic and manually adjustable ground balance options also available. Superfast Z-Lynk wireless technology is SIX times faster than Bluetooth. Integrated circuitry transmits audio to your wireless headphones. Auto pairing. No cables, and no interference from other wireless devices. Hunt Day or Night with the backlit display feature that allows you to continue hunting in low light conditions. The Iron Audio feature allows you to hear iron trash before you dig it! Also includes True All Metal Mode, All Metal Iron Mode, Digital Target ID and Adjustable Threshold to better hear targets. The Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition AT Max Metal Detector includes: AT Max Metal Detector with 6” x 11” Viper DD coil Searchcoil, Garrett’s MS-3 wireless headphones, Coil cover, and Duck Commander Duck Call with lanyard.



  • Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition AT Max comes finished in an exclusive Garrett Camo pattern
  • As seen on TV in the Duck Family Treasure TV Series!
  • The AT Max is our most versatile and advanced all-terrain VLF metal detector and is fully waterproof up to 10 feet
  • Built-in Z-Lynk Wireless Technology helps you cut the cord!
  • 6” x 11” Viper DD coil
  • Garrett’s MS-3 wireless headphones
  • Duck Commander Duck Call with lanyard
  • Coil Cover

title: Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition Apex Metal Detector
descriptionHtml:
Now you can have your very own Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition Apex finished in the exclusive Garrett Camo pattern, just like Jase is using in the Duck Family Treasure TV Series! The APEX Metal Detector is the Pinnacle of Multi-Frequency Detection Flexibility. Fueled by a cutting edge, broad-bandwidth digital platform, the Apex's Multi-Flex frequency technology lets you choose between powerful single frequencies to enhance detection of larger, more conductive targets or simultaneous multifrequency modes for better detection of smaller, less conductive targets. Contained in a sleek control box, the detector's intuitive controls feature direct drive buttons for the most frequently used controls and easy-access menu adjustments for the other controls. Built to help you find what you want to find, this advanced system offers 8 levels of iron volume adjustment, 6 detection modes and a pinpoint mode, 175 points of ground balance resolution, audible target ID with 5 distinct tones, high resolution notch discrimination, and 8 levels of sensitivity/depth adjustment. A backlit LCD display with large target ID numbers makes it easy to monitor progress. This high-performance system comes with a lightweight and waterproof 8.5" x 11" DD Multi-Flex Raider Searchcoil. A low-impedance, broad-bandwidth coil made to support the Multi-Flex frequency technology, the Raider’s larger size provides greater detection depth and coverage. Built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery offers up to 15 hours of use and comes with a Micro-USB charging cable. The Apex is light weight and well-balanced at only 2.5 pounds, so you can go coin shooting, relic hunting, shallow water wading, beach hunting, and even prospecting for hours! The Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition Apex Metal Detector includes: APEX Metal Detector with 8.5” x 11” DD Raider Searchcoil, Coil cover, and Duck Commander Duck Call with lanyard.



  • Garrett Jase Robertson Signature Edition Apex comes finished in an exclusive Garrett Camo pattern
  • As seen on TV in the Duck Family Treasure TV Series!
  • The Apex is the Pinnacle of Multi-Frequency Detection Flexibility
  • Four Single Frequencies and Two Simultaneous Multi-Frequencies
  • 8.5”x 11” DD Raider Searchcoil
  • Duck Commander Duck Call with lanyard
  • Coil Cover

title: Dogtra 1900S Remote Dog Training Collar - 3/4 Mile Range, Rechargeable, Waterproof - Plus 1 iClick Training Card, Jestik Click Trainer - Value Bundle
descriptionHtml:
Dogtra 1900S Remote Dog Training Collar


The Dogtra 1900s electric dog collar is perfect for training dogs who weigh 35 pounds and above. It is a fully waterproof dog training collar intended for heavy-duty use, and yet, is ergonomic to keep your dog comfortable and focused on learning.

The Dogtra training collar has batteries that can charge quickly in 2 hours, which means training schedules can be adhered to. As a bark collar with a 3/4 mile range, it ensures dogs can be trained to comply with commands within a wider area.

The Dogtra dog training collar’s handheld transmitter features an LCD display where dog stimulation modes and levels, including battery life, can be easily monitored. Enhanced contact points allow for no-slip, precise dialing and grip.

Also available in Dogtra’s line of shock collars for dogs with remote, the 1902S is a two-collar, single transmitter system for training a pair of dogs at a time.

 

Specifications

Additional Features

  • Stimulation levels from 0 – 127 using the Rheostat/volume dial
  • Nick (momentary), constant, and high performance stimulation via pager vibration
  • Non-stimulating high performance pager option

Package Contents

  • Waterproof receiver and collar
  • Waterproof transmitter with belt clip and black lanyard
  • Rapid battery charger with splitter cable
  • Test light to verify active stimulation
  • Owner's manual
  • Gear bag

 



  • HEAVY-DUTY DOG TRAINING COLLAR with remote control for large dogs 35 lbs and up. An ultimate dog training tool that is durable, dependable, and designed for the most demanding conditions.
  • FULLY WATERPROOF BARK COLLAR and has a wide range covering a 3/4 mile radius.
  • ERGONOMIC SHOCK COLLAR designed to be comfortable for your beloved dog. Modern slim design receiver/collar ergonomically shaped to your dog's neck for enhanced comfort and seamless appearance.
  • RAPID-CHARGING, MULTI-MODE DEVICE for a variety of training scenarios. Nick, Constant Stimulation, and Non-Stimulating High Performance Pager Vibration modes. Rheostat/Volume Dial with low-high stimulation from 0-127 levels
  • VALUE BUNDLE includes one (1) iClick Dog Training Card + one (1) Jestik Click Trainer + one (1) Collapsible Dog Bowl

title: Dogtra 2702T&B Two Dogs Remote Training and Beeper Collar - 1 Mile Range, Rechargeable, Waterproof - Plus 1 iClick Training Card, Jestik Click Trainer - Value Bundle
descriptionHtml:
Dogtra 2702T&B Two Dogs Remote Training and Beeper Collar


The Dogtra 2702T&B electric dog collar is for training and deploying pair of bird hunting dogs who weigh 35 pounds and above. The two fully waterproof dog training collars are designed for heavy-duty field use, and yet, are ergonomic to keep your sporting dogs comfortable and on focused task.

The pair of Dogtra training collars have quick-charge batteries that reach full charge in 2 hours, which means that training sessions and hunting excursions can be easily scheduled. The pair of bark collars with a 1-mile range and downward facing beeper horns allow two dogs to be trained to follow commands and be located within a wider radius.

The Dogtra dog training collar’s handheld transmitter includes an LCD display where dog stimulation modes and levels, including battery life, can be easily monitored. Enhanced and color coded contact points allow for no-slip, precise dialing and grip, dual tones allow you to distinguish between both dogs.

Also available in Dogtra’s line of shock collars for dogs with remote, the 2700T&B is a one-collar, single transmitter system for training and deploying one bird dog at a time.

descriptionHtml:
This package includes a Garrett AT Gold Waterproof Metal Detector with 5x8 DD Search Coil, Mastersound Headphones, Garrett ProPointer AT Pinpointer and AA Batteries

AT Gold metal detector was designed to find tiny gold nuggets in the most challenging prospecting environments, including shallow fresh water hunting.

The AT Gold operates at a high frequency optimized for gold prospecting and includes a True All Metal Mode. The All Metal Mode is preferred for prospecting because it provides the greatest possible depth and sensitivity. It also provides a continuous audio response to allow the operator to hear the subtle detection signals produced by faint targets

The AT Gold is a Motion All Metal detector, meaning that slight motion of the search coil is required to maintain detection, although static detection of targets can be achieved while in Pinpoint mode. The AT Gold includes manual and automatic Ground Balance plus an exclusive Ground Balance Window feature to optimize the detector’s performance in highly mineralized ground, where gold is most often found. This detector is also waterproof to a maximum depth of 10 feet (3 meters) for searching in freshwater lakes and streams.

In addition to its True All Metal Mode, the AT Gold includes two Discrimination Modes, making it a versatile coin and relic hunting machine. When selecting either the DISC 1 or DISC 2 mode, the operator gains more Tone ID information from targets in addition to the ability to discriminate unwanted trash targets (e.g. nails, foil, pull tabs).

title: Corsair K65 RGB Mini 60% Mechanical Gaming Keyboard - Cherry MX Red - Black - CH-9194010-NA
descriptionHtml:
Corsair K65 RGB Mini 60% Mechanical Gaming Keyboard - Cherry MX Red

The CORSAIR K65 RGB MINI 60% Mechanical Gaming Keyboard combines top-level performance with portability. PBT double-shot keycaps deliver exceptional durability with a premium look and feel. With 8,000Hz hyper-polling enabled by AXON hyper-processing technology, CHERRY MX SPEED RGB Silver mechanical keyswitches, and expansive onboard shortcuts, the K65 RGB MINI offers big performance and functionality in a compact design. Vivid per-key RGB backlighting is fully customizable through CORSAIR iCUE software, alongside key remaps, custom macros, and immersive integration with select games. Save up to 50 profiles to take with you anywhere with 8MB of onboard storage. Full N-key rollover, Windows Key Lock mode, and a detachable braided USB Type-C cable make the K65 RGB MINI a high-performance gaming companion at home and on-the-go, so you can win in any space.

 

Specifications

  • Form Factor 60%
  • Keyswitches CHERRY MX SPEED, mechanical, 45g actuation force, 1.2mm actuation distance
  • Backlight Individually lit and per-key programmable
  • LED Color RGB, 16.8 million colors
  • Keycaps PBT double-shot, 1.5mm thick, backlight compatible
  • Connectivity 1 x USB 3.0 Type-A
  • USB Report Rate Up to 8,000Hz hyper-polling
  • Matrix Full key rollover (NKRO) with 100% anti-ghosting
  • On-Board Profiles Yes, up to 50
  • Media Keys Yes, FN shortcuts
  • Brightness Key Yes, FN shortcut
  • Windows Lock Key Yes, FN shortcut
  • iCUE (Software) Supported in Windows 10 and macOS 10.15
  • Cable 1.82 m / 6 ft, USB Type-C to Type-A, detachable, black, braided fiber
  • Dimensions 294(L) x 105(W) x 44(H) mm / 11.6(L) x 4.14(W) x 1.74(H) in
  • Weight 0.58 kg / 1.28 lbs
  • Warranty 2 years

Features

  • Small Size, Big Features: The K65 RGB MINI delivers big features compressed into a 60% form-factor to easily fit into even the tightest spaces for comfortable gaming
  • Powered by CORSAIR AXON Hyper-Processing Technology: Transmits your inputs to your PC up to 8x faster than conventional gaming keyboards with 8,000Hz hyper-polling
  • 100% CHERRY MX SPEED RGB Silver Mechanical Keyswitches: Lightning-fast response times with a 1.2mm actuation distance, registering up to 4x faster than standard mechanical keyboards with CORSAIR AXON
  • Personalize Your Play: Show off your style with dynamic per-key RGB backlighting as well as an optional included radiant spacebar and CORSAIR logo key, along with a standard bottom row layout
  • PBT Double-Shot Keycaps: A precision-molded keycap set that resists wear, fading, and shine, with 1.5mm thickness for rigid stability

<h3>Type smarter, not harder!</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Experience the ultimate ergonomic keyboard design with the Kinesis Advantage360 Professional. This innovative wireless keyboard offers a patented contoured design in a full split form factor, allowing for even greater ergonomic adjustability. With shoulder-width key modules and customizable tenting options, you can reduce painful ulnar deviation and forearm pronation, making typing comfortable and efficient. Trust the market leader in computer ergonomics, Kinesis, to provide over 25 years of premium-grade keyboard design.</p>

<h3 class="titleComp">Mechanical Key Switches.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Advantage360 Professional utilizes the Gateron Brown stem low-force tactile key switches. “Tactility” is a slightly elevated force around the midpoint of the stroke of the key, which lets you know the switch is about to be activated. A tactile response is preferred by many ergonomists because it cues your fingers that activation is about to occur and can reduce the frequency of “bottoming out” the switch with a hard impact. Unlike the base model, which uses Kinesis’ proprietary SmartSet Engine, the Pro uses open-source ZMK firmware. Program the keyboard using the web-based configurator or simple text syntax. Power users can access the code on GitHub to build and share their own features.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/KB360-PRO_1832x1366-2.jpg" alt="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/KB360-PRO_1832x1366-2.jpg" class="shrinkToFit" width="1225" height="919" data-mce-src="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/KB360-PRO_1832x1366-2.jpg"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Invest in Your Comfort and Productivity.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the Kinesis Advantage360 Professional Wired or Wireless Ergonomic Keyboard, you're not just purchasing a keyboard but investing in your comfort and productivity. Our customers have experienced the benefits first-hand, and now it's your turn to enjoy a more comfortable and efficient typing experience.</p>
<p class="paragraph">Customers rave about the comfort and ergonomics of the Kinesis Advantage360. Its unique contoured design, split keywells, and tenting options help reduce strain on wrists and fingers, making typing more comfortable and less fatiguing.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/ADV360PRO-lifestyle-hands-2.jpg" alt="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/ADV360PRO-lifestyle-hands-2.jpg" class="shrinkToFit" width="1226" height="919" data-mce-src="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/ADV360PRO-lifestyle-hands-2.jpg"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Improved Typing Speed and Accuracy.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Users have reported noticeable typing speed and accuracy improvements thanks to the keyboard's vertical key layout and mechanical key switches. The design encourages a more natural finger movement, helping users type faster and more accurately.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img height="919" width="1226" class="shrinkToFit" alt="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/KB360-PRO-OH-Bridge_1862x1395-1.jpg" src="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/KB360-PRO-OH-Bridge_1862x1395-1.jpg" data-mce-src="https://kinesis-ergo.com/wp-content/uploads/KB360-PRO-OH-Bridge_1862x1395-1.jpg"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features</h3>
<ul style="
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 300;
">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Concave keywells are scooped into a bowl shape to reduce hand and finger extension and relax muscles.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Separating the keywells positions the arms at shoulder-width to keep wrists straight and perpendicular to the home row to reduce abduction and ulnar deviation.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The keys are arranged in vertical columns (rather than staggered) to reflect your fingers' natural motion better.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The two keywells are “tented” to moderately raise the thumb side of the hand. Tenting puts you in a more neutral “handshake” posture and reduces the stresses caused by forearm pronation. Choose from one of three heights, depending on your preferences.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The integrated palm supports reduce stressful bending of the wrists and provide a convenient place to rest your hands when you are not actively typing. Add the new premium pads for even more support (AC360PP Sold Separately).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The thumb clusters include frequently-used keys such as Enter, Space, Backspace, and Delete to redistribute the workload from your relatively weaker, overused little fingers to stronger thumbs.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Advantage360 may look big, but it has a smaller footprint than most keyboards because we eliminated the numeric 10-key so you can place the mouse closer to your body, reducing painful “over-reach”.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Functions keys are located in the number row and accessed via the Fn Key for reduced reach and enhanced portability.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Style meets functionality.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the DMS2000 - the ultimate dual gas shock monitor mount that is more than just a simple accessory to your desktop setup. With its sleek, minimalist design fused with industrial influences, this mount offers both style and functionality to elevate your workspace to the next level.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Endless comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Say goodbye to neck and eye strain with the DMS2000's finger-tip adjustments, allowing you to easily raise, tilt, swivel, and rotate your monitors to achieve the perfect viewing angle. No more discomfort or awkward postures - this mount covers your back (and neck!).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/9_15694a51-a88f-4aca-ba09-6af055226dc7_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676561747"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Stability made easy.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The detachable base provides a seamless connection to your desk, ensuring stability and durability for your monitors. Plus, the easy-to-use clamping mechanism can be secured to any ledge or grommet hole up to 2 inches thick, making installing it a breeze.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/8_fbeae5c0-66d8-4663-8324-40be2cc32c5b_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676561747"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Tidy cables, clear space.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> The DMS2000 comes equipped with handy cable management clips to keep your cables organized and out of sight, ensuring a clutter-free workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/DMS2000S_CableManagement-copy_480x480.webp?v=1684252464"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">It provides a balance between style and functionality for the perfect desktop setup.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Minimalist design with industrial influences</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Allows for finger-tip adjustments to be made to the height and orientation of your screens</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Enables you to raise, tilt, swivel, and rotate your monitors on the fly</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The detachable base provides a seamless connection to your desk</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The easy-to-use clamping mechanism can be secured to any ledge or grommet hole up to 2 inches thick</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Includes cable management clips to route your cables conveniently</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ensures a clutter-free setup</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black, Silver</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Hands-free heaven.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Tired of constantly holding your smartphone or tablet? Say goodbye to the discomfort and hello to a whole new level of convenience with the DS150! This remarkable stand is designed to provide you with hands-free access to your favorite gadgets while delivering a seamless and immersive experience.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Device freedom.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Versatile and lightweight, the DS150 is your ultimate companion for all your device needs. Its 6" aluminum arm boasts four points of rotation, giving you the power to effortlessly adjust the position of your device for the perfect viewing angle.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/2_3f3922f0-9824-4d17-a2cd-ff097d5cc080_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676564640" alt="2_3f3922f0-9824-4d17-a2cd-ff097d5cc080_1800x1800.jpg (1305×1500)" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/2_3f3922f0-9824-4d17-a2cd-ff097d5cc080_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676564640"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Entertainment on-the-go.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The foldable base of the DS150 makes it incredibly portable, allowing you to easily carry it wherever you wander. And that's not all! With the provided mounting brackets, you can effortlessly position your device under a cabinet or on the wall, transforming any space into your personal entertainment hub.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/9_80e5884a-bbcc-4afd-a93b-ae2b4cfa9c94_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676564642" alt="9_80e5884a-bbcc-4afd-a93b-ae2b4cfa9c94_1800x1800.jpg (1200×1200)" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/9_80e5884a-bbcc-4afd-a93b-ae2b4cfa9c94_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676564642"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Seamless mobile bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The DS150 is the perfect solution for anyone who craves hands-free access to their mobile devices.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/11_4e3d0ed4-ff13-4997-a4c7-fd1c0576d325_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676564643"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Provides hands-free access to your smartphone or tablet</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Lightweight and versatile stand with a 6" aluminum arm</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Four points of rotation allow for optimal viewing angles</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">A foldable base makes it easy to carry and transport</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Mounting brackets allow for positioning under a cabinet or on the wall</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Spring-loaded clamping mechanism accommodates various screen sizes and ensures a secure fit at any angle</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comes with an adapter with a ¼”-20 screw for mounting a camera or portable projector</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy hands-free access to their mobile devices.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black, White</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Hands-free freedom.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ultimate solution for your smartphone or tablet - the DS250 stand! With its versatile and adjustable design, this stand is perfect for anyone who wants to enjoy hands-free access to their device. Featuring a sleek and sturdy 15" aluminum arm with five points of rotation, you can easily find the perfect positioning for your device, whether you're working or relaxing.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Portable powerhouse.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The lightweight and foldable base of the DS250 makes it incredibly easy to carry around, so you can take it with you wherever you go. It's also designed to fit into mounting brackets, which means you can position your device under a cabinet or on the wall for a more convenient viewing experience.<br></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/10_2dca8f3f-54e1-43e7-ad01-815405c7cfc0_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676567269"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph"><span>But what really sets the DS250 apart is its spring-loaded clamping mechanism, which accommodates various screen sizes and ensures a secure fit at any angle. So, whether you're using your device in landscape or portrait mode, you can trust that it will stay in place.</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/11_bf04f79b-6ebd-4dea-8ef7-77d79b9f2b73_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676567273"></div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Rise to innovation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Tired of the same old static monitor setup cramping your style? Elevate your work experience with the Kanto DTS1000, a sleek and versatile desktop monitor stand that's about to revolutionize the way you work and play.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash adaptability.</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> The Kanto DTS1000 lets you take control. Adjust the height, swivel left and right, tilt it just the way you want, and even switch between portrait and landscape modes with a flick of your fingers.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="4_23da5e01-50b2-4f85-b594-79aaee8b81de_1800x1800.jpg (1391×1500)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/4_23da5e01-50b2-4f85-b594-79aaee8b81de_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676570184"></div>

<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Unrivaled stability.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">No more wobbles or shaky screens. The Kanto DTS1000 boasts a heavy-duty base that's ready to support monitors up to a whopping 32 inches. Say hello to a rock-solid setup that lets you focus on your tasks without distractions.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/5_d7b8c54e-d646-4158-99b7-8e4a35abe37e_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676570182"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Revamp your workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Upgrade your workspace today with the Kanto DTS1000 and embark on a journey towards enhanced productivity, comfort, and style.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="9_0b3572dd-1941-472e-8f7c-d2115f599bdd_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1000)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/9_0b3572dd-1941-472e-8f7c-d2115f599bdd_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676570183"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height adjustable, allowing you to position your monitor at eye level for improved ergonomics and comfort</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Detachable monitor plate for easy deployment and installation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Swivel and tilt capabilities, providing flexibility to adjust the angle of your monitor</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">360° rotation, making it easy to switch between portrait and landscape orientation</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Suitable for monitors up to 32", providing stability and support throughout the day</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">No mechanical or gas spring that can wear out, ensuring long-lasting durability</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Heavy-duty base for stability and security</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Cable guide to route cables and cords for a cleaner and more organized workspace</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tool holder to adjust the tilt and swivel tension with ease</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">A reliable and easy-to-use solution for anyone seeking to improve their productivity and comfort while working at their computer.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Organize with elegance.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Tired of your precious headphones lying around, cluttering your workspace? Say goodbye to disarray and welcome the sleek and practical H1 Headphone Stand. This elegant accessory is designed to give your desktop a touch of sophistication while keeping your headphones organized and easily within reach.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Attention to every curve.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the H1 Headphone Stand is tailored specifically for on-ear headphones. Its contoured silicone cradle cradles your headphones gently, preventing unsightly headband impressions and preserving their pristine shape.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/4_cfedfe6f-3b17-4b9e-9655-d6a72fea6b19_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676573083" alt="4_cfedfe6f-3b17-4b9e-9655-d6a72fea6b19_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1409)"></div>

</div>
</div>

</div>

title: Kanto Universal Under Desk Headphone Hook
descriptionHtml:
The HH headphone hook is a product designed to provide an organized solution for headphone storage, while reducing clutter on your desktop. Made of steel and featuring a contoured silicone cradle, this hook is designed to securely hold your headphones and protect the headband. It can be easily installed using the included 3M VHB adhesive or self-tapping screws, and is compatible with most on-ear and over-ear headphones weighing up to two pounds. With its low-profile design, the HH headphone hook is a practical and stylish addition to any workspace.

  • The HH headphone hook is designed to provide an organized solution for headphone storage and reduce desktop clutter.
  • It is constructed out of steel and features a contoured silicone cradle designed to protect your headphones while keeping them securely in place.
  • The included high-strength 3M VHB adhesive allows for quick and reliable installation underneath your desk.
  • Optional self-tapping screws are provided for a more permanent setup.
  • This low-profile headphone hanger is compatible with most on-ear and over-ear headphones weighing up to two pounds.
  • With its sleek design and practical functionality, the HH headphone hook is a stylish addition to any workspace.

<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you tired of hunching over your laptop, straining your neck, and battling poor posture? Look no further! The Kanto LE1 Laptop Riser is here to revolutionize your workspace experience.</p>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The elevated and cantilevered design raises your laptop to improve posture and reduce eye and neck strain.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The open laptop platform improves and encourages airflow to reduce laptop temperatures leading to increased performance and device lifespan.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The stand features high-grip silicone that protects your laptop and keeps it secure while Velcro straps are included to route cables along the stand.<br>

<div class="header">
<h3>TV on the go.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ultimate solution to your TV viewing needs - the MTM65PL rolling TV stand! Designed to make your life easier, this sleek and sturdy stand allows you to move your TV effortlessly around your home or office, giving you complete freedom to enjoy your favorite shows wherever you want.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless TV mobility.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted from high-quality steel, the MTM65PL is built to last and is a breeze to assemble. The stand features smooth-rolling 2-inch rubber casters that let you easily glide your TV across any surface. With its height-adjustable center columns, you can customize the stand to fit your needs and preferences - whether relaxing on the couch or working at your desk.</p>
</div>
</div>

<p class="paragraph">The MTM65PL has a convenient webcam top shelf and a handy plastic tray for your laptop, PVRs, or other digital devices. </div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The stand includes 2-inch rubber casters for smooth and easy maneuverability</li>

seo.title: Kanto Rolling TV Stand for 55-inch to 86-inch TVs and Interactive Displays - MTM86PLIntroducing the revolutionary MTM86PL AV Cart: your ultimate partner in seamless and secure TV or interactive panel transportation within any bustling business environment. This dynamic cart has been meticulously designed to make your life easier, ensuring you can effortlessly navigate through rooms while keeping your valuable equipment safe and sound.  Safety is paramount, which is why the MTM86PL is UL-certified, guaranteeing you reliable and secure operation at all times. With its robust construction and attention to detail, this cart is built to withstand the demands of your fast-paced business setting.  Equipped with a convenient camera shelf and device tray, the MTM86PL goes beyond simply transporting your TV or interactive panel. It accommodates conferencing devices and collaborative equipment, allowing you to effortlessly move your entire communication arsenal from one room to another. No more hassle, no more juggling separate devices – everything you need is right there, effortlessly integrated into this versatile cart.  Maneuvering through narrow doorways is a breeze thanks to the MTM86PL's compact base. You won't have to worry about any awkward and time-consuming maneuvers. Simply glide through with ease, knowing that your equipment is secure and the path is clear.  Stability is key, and the MTM86PL delivers. Its 3-inch locking wheels ensure rock-solid stability when the cart is stationary, allowing you to confidently set up your TV or interactive panel without any wobbling or concerns. Say goodbye to distractions and hello to a focused and productive environment.  Optimal positioning is a must for an immersive viewing experience, and the MTM86PL understands that. With its height adjustable columns, you can effortlessly find the perfect viewing angle for your audience, ensuring everyone can enjoy a crystal-clear display. Additionally, the spacious cable pathways keep your setup clean and organized, eliminating the tangled mess of wires and cables that often plagues technology setups.  Experience the future of AV cart technology with the MTM86PL. It's not just a cart – it's a game-changer. Say goodbye to the days of cumbersome transportation and disorganized setups. Embrace the ease, convenience, and reliability of the MTM86PL and elevate your business presentations to new heights.

title: Kanto Universal Projector Mount
descriptionHtml:
The P101 universal projector mount is a versatile and practical tool that enables easy and secure mounting of projectors to the ceiling, making it an excellent choice for boardrooms, offices, and home theatre setups. The mount features a 360° ball swivel and tilt capability, allowing for optimal positioning and viewing angles. With a range of extension arm lengths, the mount can be adjusted between 9” and 12” from the ceiling to suit your specific needs. The mount comes with all the necessary hardware for mounting your projector, ensuring a hassle-free installation. It is available in a sleek gloss white finish and is a great solution for anyone looking to streamline their projector setup.

  • The P101 universal projector mount allows for easy and secure mounting of projectors to the ceiling.
  • Ideal for use in boardrooms, offices, and home theatre applications.
  • Features a 360° ball swivel and tilt capability for optimal positioning and viewing angles.
  • Can be extended between 9” and 12” from the ceiling, making it customizable to your specific needs.
  • Comes with a full set of extension arm lengths and projector mounting hardware for a hassle-free installation.
  • Available in a gloss white finish for a sleek and modern look.
  • Please note that the hardware to mount the P101 to your ceiling is not included.
  • Color: Black, White

seo.description: Get optimal viewing angles with the versatile P101 universal projector mount. Easy to install and customize, perfect for boardrooms and home theaters.

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Project brilliance.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Unleash the true potential of your projector with the P301, an innovation that redefines versatility and convenience. Designed by Kanto, a pioneer in cutting-edge AV solutions, this mount is not just a product – it's your gateway to cinematic excellence in any setting.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Limitless projector freedom.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether it's a ceiling that defies gravity, a slanted surface that challenges convention, or even the side of a beam that dares to be different, this mount laughs in the face of constraints.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="2_d929de83-f00d-408d-9472-913cb90e4032_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1420)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/2_d929de83-f00d-408d-9472-913cb90e4032_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676660302"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">"Perfect projector precision.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The P301's secret lies in its adjustable arms, a stroke of engineering genius that allows you to find your projector's center of gravity effortlessly. No more tilted or off-center images – just pure, immersive visuals that captivate your audience every time.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/4_32fa144b-803a-4abb-8a55-3994b7cab2f6_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676660304" alt="4_32fa144b-803a-4abb-8a55-3994b7cab2f6_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1464)" data-mce-selected="1" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/4_32fa144b-803a-4abb-8a55-3994b7cab2f6_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676660304"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate your vision.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">So, if you're a visionary who demands perfection in every frame, a creator who refuses to be confined, or simply someone who seeks the pinnacle of projector mounting solutions, the P301 is your answer.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="9_972cac27-2b64-4ace-b14d-556f699c2f28_1800x1800.jpg (767×1500)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/9_972cac27-2b64-4ace-b14d-556f699c2f28_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676660305"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The P301 is a versatile projector mount designed by Kanto.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">It allows you to mount your projector to a ceiling, a slanted surface, or the side of a beam.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable arms enable you to center the mount to the projector's center of gravity, which is essential for vertical hanging.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The mount offers extension, pivot, tilt, and swivel adjustments to help you set up your projector in almost any situation.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The P301 is designed for ease of use, making almost any projector mounting configuration possible.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>
</div>
</div>

<h3>Heightened audio bliss.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the S2 Speaker Stands, your ultimate secret weapon for unlocking the full potential of your desktop speaker setup. Prepare to be blown away as these stands take your audio experience to new heights, delivering a symphony of sound that will captivate your senses.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Sleek sound solutions.</h3>

</div>
</div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">We understand the importance of stability and reducing unwanted vibrations. That's why the S2 Speaker Stands are equipped with strategically placed foam padding. This ingenious feature not only keeps your speakers firmly in place but it also eliminates any pesky vibrations, even when you crank up the volume to the max.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/3_d27fb913-d89c-49c4-b7f1-23b74db90566_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676668168"></div>

<div class="textBlock">

<h3 class="titleComp">Audio evolution begins.</h3>

</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/893b7481-c354-42c0-a494-0e8fc55dbc2f.__CR0_15_970_600_PT0_SX970_V1_480x480.jpg?v=1688751922"></div>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">These stands enhance the sound quality of your desktop speakers</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ideal for music enthusiasts and professionals who demand clear and accurate sound reproduction.</li>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Audio ascension achieved.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the S4 Speaker Stands - the ultimate boost to your desktop speaker setup! Elevate your audio experience to new heights with these sleek and ingenious stands designed to captivate your senses.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Audio adventure awaits.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of sound as you explore the range of frequencies your speakers can produce.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/6_1800x1800_6d972e21-2724-4e67-a3be-bbd59747a6a6_480x480.jpg?v=1688748809"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Vibration-free audio bliss.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The S4 stands are engineered to eliminate unwanted vibrations, ensuring absolute clarity and purity in your audio playback. Thanks to the strategically placed foam padding, you can bid farewell to disruptive resonances that hinder your sonic bliss.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/3_d27fb913-d89c-49c4-b7f1-23b74db90566_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676668168"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Speaker stability maximized.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Equipped with a purposeful mounting hole and a sturdy 1/4”-20 screw, these stands provide a rock-solid foundation for your beloved YU4 speakers or other compatible audio companions.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/5_fc78872f-268f-44fc-add1-5f5838db439a_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676668166"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">S4 speaker stands are designed for desktop speaker setups.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The stands provide 16° of upward tilt, enhancing the listening experience.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Foam padding on the stands helps to reduce vibration at high volume levels.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The stands come with a mounting hole and 1/4”-20 screw to secure compatible speakers in place.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">These stands are compatible with YU4 speakers and other compatible models.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The S4 speaker stands are a great addition to any desktop audio system, providing high-quality sound at any volume.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black, White</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Elevate and enhance.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer for your audio setup: The S6 Desktop Speaker Stands. Elevate your listening experience to extraordinary heights with these sleek and innovative stands designed to unleash the true potential of your 4- to 7-inch speakers.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Perfect sound precision.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Equipped with a 16° tilt, these stands to ensure that every beat, every note, and every melody reaches your ears with utmost precision. Say goodbye to missed details and hidden nuances as the S6 directs the sound waves right where they belong – your eager ears.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/4_f5464929-b29e-4232-907f-9d26f3de8d2a_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676670010"></div>

</div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Firm foundation guaranteed.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The S6 stands come equipped with a convenient mounting hole and a reliable 1/4”-20 screw, ensuring your prized audio devices stay firmly in place.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/3_c4dc8c34-f2a6-424c-b299-4b1e2b8dcd43_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676670008"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Sleek sophistication.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The S6 stands effortlessly blend into any desktop setup. Their low-profile design adds a touch of elegance to your space while taking your audio quality to new heights.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/kanto-audio-s6-desktop-speaker-stands-for-large-speakers-pair-speaker-brackets-stands-kanto-audio-377978_1800x1800_ab9575b9-5277-41bd-914c-bdee9cc6380a_480x480.jpg?v=1688746675" alt=""></div>
</div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">S6 desktop speaker stands are designed to improve the placement of your 4- to 7-inch speakers while maintaining a low-profile desktop setup.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The stands provide 16° of tilt, allowing you to angle your speakers towards your ears and experience the full range of frequencies they have to offer.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Foam padding is included in the stands to reduce vibration when the sound is turned up.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Each stand comes with a mounting hole and 1/4”-20 screw to secure your YU6, TUK, or other compatible speakers in place.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">These stands are perfect for those who want to enhance their listening experience while keeping a minimalist desktop setup.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Black, White</li>

title: Kanto Elevated Desktop Speaker Stands for Large Speakers
descriptionHtml:
The SE6 Elevated Speaker Stand is a product designed to enhance the sound quality of your speakers by lifting them off the surface of your desk to better align with your ears. With a height of 6.9", the SE6 provides a cantilevered and angled platform to absorb resonance and minimize reflections for a pure sound. The stand features 2.5mm of silicone padding to provide a strong grip and prevent accidental slips and falls. It comes with a set of mounting screws to securely attach compatible speakers to the stand for maximum protection. Available in black and white, the SE6 can hold up to 22 lbs.

  • The SE6 Elevated Speaker Stand is designed to enhance the sound quality of your speakers.
  • The stand raises your speakers to a height of 6.9", aligning them better with your ears.
  • The cantilevered and angled platform absorbs resonance and reduces reflections for a pure sound.
  • The stand features 2.5mm of silicone padding to prevent your speakers from slipping or falling.
  • A set of mounting screws are included to securely attach compatible speakers to the stand for maximum protection.
  • The SE6 is available in black and white and can hold up to 22 lbs.

title: Kanto Bookshelf Speaker Stands
descriptionHtml:
The SP series is a range of low-profile speaker stands designed to enhance the audio experience of your YU4, YU6, or other compatible speakers. These stands come in 26 and 32-inch models and are made of heavy-duty steel to reduce vibration, ensuring clear and crisp sound. The stands feature a rotating top plate, allowing sound to reach your ears from any angle. The hollow core of the stands also conceals cables and speaker wire for a neat and organized setup. Two top plate sizes are provided for maximum stability, and interchangeable spiked and domed feet are included for carpet and hardwood flooring. The stands come in a black or white powder-coated finish, making them a stylish addition to any home audio setup.

  • The SP series is a range of low-profile speaker stands designed to enhance the audio experience of your compatible speakers.
  • The stands are made of heavy-duty steel to reduce vibration and ensure clear and crisp sound.
  • Available in 26 and 32-inch models, with a black or white powder-coated finish.
  • The stands feature a rotating top plate, allowing sound to reach your ears from any angle.
  • The hollow core of the stands conceals cables and speaker wire for a neat and organized setup.
  • Two top plate sizes are provided for maximum stability, each with a mounting hole and ¼” – 20 screw to secure your speakers in place.
  • Interchangeable spiked and domed feet are included for carpet and hardwood flooring.
  • Compatible with YU4, YU6, or other compatible speakers.

seo.description: Elevate your audio experience with the SP series! These sleek and sturdy low-profile speaker stands feature a rotating top plate and cable concealment.

title: Kanto Universal Desktop Speaker Stand
descriptionHtml:
The SP6HD and SP9 desktop speaker stands are designed to enhance the listening experience of 2 to 7-inch speakers such as YU4, YU6, TUK, and others. The SP6HD stands measure 6 inches tall, while the SP9 stands measure 9 inches tall. Both stands are made of heavy steel with closed cell foam padding to minimize vibrations, resulting in cleaner and more accurate sound. Two top-plate sizes are included, each with 30 degrees of rotation and a mounting hole and 1/4" - 20 screw to securely attach your speakers. Additionally, the stands feature a cable routing system to keep your setup organized and clutter-free. By aligning your speakers with your ears, the stands allow you to capture a wider range of frequencies and improve your nearfield listening experience.

  • The SP6HD (4 to 7-inch speakers )and SP9 (2 to 4-inch speakers) desktop speaker stands are designed for speakers such as YU4, YU6, and TUK.

title: Kanto Sealed Powered Subwoofer
descriptionHtml:
The Sub8 is a high-performance, sealed subwoofer that delivers fast and accurate bass response, ideal for small to medium-sized rooms. It features an 8-inch woofer driven by a 300-watt amplifier, which ensures minimal distortion and maximum precision. Its compact design ensures that it can fit easily into any audio system setup without taking up too much floor space. Additionally, the Sub8 comes with a crossover filter and phase control for easy integration into any audio system. With its durable MDF construction, solid rubber feet, metal grill, and vinyl finish, the Sub8 is built to last, providing worry-free longevity. The Sub8's sleek and stylish design matches perfectly with Kanto speakers, making it the perfect addition to any audio setup where tight bass in a tight space is needed.

title: Kanto Tall Fillable Speaker Stands with Isolation Feet
descriptionHtml:
The SX series is a range of premium floor-standing speaker stands that are designed to provide class-leading audio performance by isolating the speakers from the floor. These stands feature a bespoke isolation system that decouples the stands from the floor, and the heavy-duty base plates provide a stable platform with a dedicated channel for cable management. The leveling system is accessible from the top of the base plate, making it easy to adjust the level with the included bullseye level. The stands also come with hard floor discs with silicone pads to protect wooden floors, and optional top plate adhesive foam pads that improve dampening. The stands are available in 22” or 26” tall models and black or white finishes, making them suitable for any space or aesthetic.

  • The SX series are premium floor-standing speaker stands.
  • The stands use a bespoke isolation system to decouple the speaker stands from the floor.
  • The leveling system is accessible from the top of the base plate and includes a bullseye level for easy adjustment.
  • Heavy-duty base plates provide a stable platform for the speakers.
  • The stands have a dedicated channel for cable management.
  • The stands come with hard floor discs with silicone pads to protect wooden floors.
  • Optional top plate adhesive foam pads improve dampening.
  • The stands are available in 22” or 26” tall models.
  • The stands come in black or white finishes to match any space or aesthetic.

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Transcend ordinary sound.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Step into a world of audio perfection with TUK, the ultimate bookshelf speaker that transcends the boundaries of ordinary sound. Prepare to be captivated by its high-performance design, meticulously engineered to deliver unparalleled clarity and audio brilliance.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Unleash audio brilliance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Equipped with cutting-edge technology, TUK boasts an onboard DSP (Digital Signal Processor) that takes your audio experience to new heights. Say goodbye to muffled sounds and distorted frequencies as TUK unveils a universe of sparkling highs and deep, resonating bass.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="7_e2f4a411-2787-4270-9737-12f7d40d8257_1800x1800.jpg (1200×1200)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/7_e2f4a411-2787-4270-9737-12f7d40d8257_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676935527"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp">Connect with limitless possibilities.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Versatility is at the core of TUK's design philosophy. It understands the need to connect seamlessly with a wide range of devices. That's why it offers a plethora of inputs including phono, RCA, Optical TOSLINK, built-in USB DAC, and Bluetooth 4.2 with aptX HD and AAC codecs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/4_a057a69f-33df-4a47-9b33-287edd255428_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676935526"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">

<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Personal symphony unleashed.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">It features a dedicated headphone amplifier that elevates your private listening sessions to a whole new level. Immerse yourself in a personal symphony of sound, where every note, every beat, and every whisper is brought to life with stunning clarity and precision.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/6_5a80d5ab-d6c5-4e15-9ddd-31afe2bf570a_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676935525"></div>
</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">TUK is a high-performance bookshelf speaker designed for exceptional clarity and audio performance.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">It features onboard DSP, high-performance AMT tweeters, and 5.25" aluminum drivers that produce sparkling highs and rich bass for an immersive and vibrant audio experience.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Its active crossover enhances low-end resolution by filtering out sub-80Hz frequencies when connected to a subwoofer.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">TUK offers various inputs including phono, RCA, Optical TOSLINK, built-in USB DAC, and Bluetooth 4.2 with aptX HD and AAC codecs, making it versatile and compatible with multiple devices.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">It also includes a headphone amp to enhance the listening experience, making it an ideal choice for audiophiles and music enthusiasts.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Available in Matte Black and Matte White</li>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Music's ultimate power.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Unleash the power of music like never before with the YU Powered Speaker System. Prepare to be captivated by its compact design and astounding audio performance that will transport you to a world of pure sonic bliss.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Heart-skipping audio perfection.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Harnessing the latest audio technology, this dynamic powerhouse boasts 4-inch Kevlar® drivers and 1-inch silk dome tweeters, ensuring a rich and natural sound experience that will make your heart skip a beat.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/2_d20a1c0f-8464-4c25-8227-5fea096ec9c0_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676999656"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Wireless music dominance.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Bid farewell to tangled cables as you effortlessly pair your devices and let the music take control. Feel the energy of your music as powerful bass reverberates through your surroundings.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="3_090e8639-e45e-44e2-9586-18d34367ef43_1800x1800.jpg (1200×1200)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/3_090e8639-e45e-44e2-9586-18d34367ef43_1800x1800.jpg?v=1676999655"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elegant and functional.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Seamlessly integrate it with your existing setup for a personalized audio journey that suits your taste and style.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/YU_EntertainmentStand_480x480.jpg?v=1689016636"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">YU powered speaker system is a compact audio solution with high-performance capabilities.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">4-inch Kevlar® drivers and 1-inch silk dome tweeters deliver natural and smooth audio quality</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Bluetooth 4.2 with aptX provides high-quality streaming</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">A single RCA input covers analog audio sources</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">SUB OUT port for increased bass and impact</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comes with a remote for easy adjustments to volume, tone, balance, and playback controls while streaming via Bluetooth</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Designed for music lovers who want a simple-to-use audio system with high-quality sound.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Available in Black</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>
