<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Space-saving a<span data-mce-fragment="1">udio bliss</span>.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Looking to elevate your audio experience without compromising on space? Look no further than the YU2 desktop mini-monitor. This extraordinary Canadian-designed speaker system packs a punch, delivering mind-blowing sound quality in a sleek and compact form factor.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Captivating sound brilliance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Prepare to be amazed as the YU2 captivates your senses with its powerful performance. Equipped with 3" composite drivers and 3/4" silk dome tweeters, these speakers produce flawless bass, crystal-clear midrange, and scintillating highs that will transport you into a world of sonic brilliance.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="5_49c70606-5d9c-4bc4-9cdf-9add5d640f68_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1043)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/5_49c70606-5d9c-4bc4-9cdf-9add5d640f68_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677001982"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Optimized audio oasis.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The YU2 is intelligently designed to optimize your audio experience. Its rear-tuned bass port not only extends the low end to deliver deep, resonating bass, but it also ensures that airflow remains away from your workspace, so you can focus on your work or play without distractions.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="6_f0318c49-bbcc-4748-8ccf-db3a81a1b913.jpg (1080×753)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/6_f0318c49-bbcc-4748-8ccf-db3a81a1b913.jpg?v=1677001982&width=1080"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Style meets sonic power.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The YU2 is not only a powerhouse of sound, but it also adds a touch of elegance to your workspace. Choose between matte or gloss finishes to match your aesthetic preferences and create an environment that reflects your style.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/9_1965a5a0-c866-4690-90e5-6102c3791f32_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677001983"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">YU2 is a compact and high-performance mini-monitor speaker system designed in Canada.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The speaker system is equipped with 3" composite drivers and 3/4" silk dome tweeters to deliver distortion-free bass, midrange, and scintillating highs.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The built-in soundcard allows for high-quality audio streaming from a computer's USB port, and the speaker system can also connect to any 3.5mm AUX jack for maximum input flexibility.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The specially tuned bass-port at the rear extends the low end while keeping airflow away from your workspace.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The SUB OUT port allows for connecting a subwoofer for pure low-end bliss.<br>Available in Bamboo, Matte Black, Matte White, Walnut Finish</li>
</ul>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__1mpoO">
<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Unleash audio wonder.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Are you ready to immerse yourself in a world of extraordinary sound? Say hello to YU4, the ultimate high-quality speaker system designed to captivate your senses and redefine your audio journey.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Powerful audio revolution.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Prepare to be blown away by the breathtaking power of YU4's Class D amplifier, unleashing an astonishing 140W peak power that will transport you into the heart of your music.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="1_fa5041f5-aafe-4475-b689-e4c737dd0980_1800x1800.jpg (1415×1061)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/1_fa5041f5-aafe-4475-b689-e4c737dd0980_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677003500"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Versatile connection hub.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Its built-in phono preamp ensures a seamless connection to your turntable, while Bluetooth compatibility allows you to stream your music from any compatible device effortlessly. Embrace the freedom to enjoy your music in any format you desire.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="6_bd2993b0-f768-4a9b-9e94-1c832960dc73_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1109)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/6_bd2993b0-f768-4a9b-9e94-1c832960dc73_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677003500"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Surrender to the sound.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Close your eyes, sink into your favorite chair, and let YU4 transport you to a realm of pure bliss. Lose yourself in the nuances, the subtleties, and the emotions of your favorite songs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="10_3efba9ed-d4b3-4f6e-a4c7-89b21939aacc_1800x1800.jpg (1800×1200)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/10_3efba9ed-d4b3-4f6e-a4c7-89b21939aacc_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677003500"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">YU4 is a high-quality speaker system designed for music sharing.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The speaker delivers rich and spacious sound with its Class D amplifier that produces 140W peak power.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The 4" Kevlar drivers and 1" silk dome tweeters are carefully designed to reproduce your favorite tunes in crystal-clear, detailed sound.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The speaker comes with a built-in phono preamp and Bluetooth compatibility, making it easy to enjoy your music in any format.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">YU4 is perfect for sharing music with friends or enjoying a solo listening session</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The speaker provides an immersive and enjoyable experience for all.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Available in Bamboo, Matte Black, Matte White, Walnut Finish</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Audio bliss amplified.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Prepare to be captivated by the immersive audio experience that awaits you with the YU6 speaker system. Crafted to perfection, this powerhouse of sound will transport you to new sonic dimensions, enveloping your living space with breathtaking, high-fidelity sound.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Rediscover vinyl magic.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Prepare to rediscover your vinyl collection with its built-in phono preamp, effortlessly bringing the rich warmth of analog music back to life. Dust off those cherished records and allow yourself to be swept away by the nostalgia and authenticity of vinyl.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="6_fc441799-f5b9-4bce-b45d-c4e34fbcdb71_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1111)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/6_fc441799-f5b9-4bce-b45d-c4e34fbcdb71_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677005293"></div>

</div>

<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Wireless melody unleashed.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Embrace the freedom of wireless streaming with YU6's cutting-edge Bluetooth connectivity. Seamlessly connect your smartphone or any other compatible device and let the music flow untethered from the constraints of cables.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="9_fcf6ae3c-31a5-4452-9d05-90aaced4eb88_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1403)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/9_fcf6ae3c-31a5-4452-9d05-90aaced4eb88_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677005295"></div>

<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Audiophile's dream.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether you're a music enthusiast, an audiophile, or simply someone who appreciates exceptional sound, YU6 is your ultimate choice.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="11_11278638-a118-41e5-a1f1-58a4fb0f90d3_1800x1800.jpg (1500×1500)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/11_11278638-a118-41e5-a1f1-58a4fb0f90d3_1800x1800.jpg?v=1677005295"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">YU6 is a powerful and dynamic speaker system that delivers full-impact, high-quality sound.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The speaker is equipped with a 200W peak power Class D amplifier for an undeniably loud experience.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">It features 5.25" Kevlar drivers and 1" silk dome tweeters that inject detailed sound into every square inch of your living space.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">YU6 has a built-in phono preamp that makes it easy to play your favorite vinyl records.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Bluetooth connectivity lets you stream music wirelessly from your smartphone or other devices, keeping the party going from the palm of your hand.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">YU6 is the perfect choice for anyone who wants to enjoy high-quality audio with a powerful, room-filling sound.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Available in Bamboo, Matte Black, Matte White, Walnut Finish</li>

title: Humanscale 6G Big Compact Keyboard Platform System with Foam Palm Rest & 22" Track (6G550F-22)
descriptionHtml:
Humanscale 6G Keyboard System  6G550F-22

Introducing the Humanscale 6G Keyboard System 6G550F-22 - where ergonomic innovation meets unparalleled design! Get ready to revolutionize your typing experience with the industry's leading product that's backed by over a decade of research and design mastery.

Step into the future of productivity with this cutting-edge keyboard system that leaves no comfort or functionality compromised. Boasting an ultra-thin profile and lightweight design, the 6G Keyboard System combines style and substance like never before. Say goodbye to clunky keyboards and hello to a sleek, streamlined companion that enhances your workspace aesthetics.

But it's not just about looks! The 6G Keyboard System has been crafted to prioritize your well-being and productivity. Designed to be ergonomically sound, it provides unmatched comfort and support, allowing you to bid farewell to discomfort and fatigue. Say goodbye to strained wrists and hello to a healthier, more enjoyable workday.

What sets the 6G Keyboard System apart from the competition is its simplicity. With the simplest mechanism on the market today, typing becomes a breeze. The smooth, effortless keystrokes will make you feel like you're dancing on the keys, all while maintaining precision and accuracy.

Experience the ultimate in utility with this remarkable keyboard system. Every key is strategically placed for easy access, allowing you to navigate through tasks seamlessly. Boost your efficiency and embrace the joy of smooth typing like never before.

Upgrade your workspace to the next level with the Humanscale 6G Keyboard System 6G550F-22. This masterpiece of ergonomic design promises to transform your workday, providing you with unparalleled comfort, support, and style. Get ready to immerse yourself in a typing experience that's as enjoyable as it is productive. Say hello to a healthier, happier you!

Big Board Keyboard Platform

  • Accommodates both keyboard and mouse
  • Allows you to mouse on either the left or right side of the keyboard
  • Removable 19" synthetic leather foam core palm support
  • Dimensions: 25"W x 10.625"D keyboard platform
  • Platform material: .25" phenolic composite
  • Platform color: Graphite Spektrum
  • Palm support color:  Black

6G Keyboard Mechanism

  • Independent height and dial-a-tilt adjustment
  • Simple one-handed motion allows the keyboard to be repositioned instantly, without the use of locks or levers
  • Total knee clearance - Nylon glide track
  • 360° swivel for easy positioning and storage
  • Platform tilt adjustment: 0° to -15° (no positive slope adjustment)
  • Height adjustment: 7" (1.5" above track to 5.5" below track)
  • Track length: 22"
  • Color: Black

<h3>Sleek & elevated workspace.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Looking for a sleek and functional monitor arm attachment option that will take your workspace to the next level? Look no further than this top-mount c-clamp!</p>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Ergo-perfect arm upgrade.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Specifically designed to work with select LX and MXV monitor arms, this slim and versatile attachment allows you to easily install your arm above your desk surface, providing a more ergonomic solution for your work setup.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/1066751542_480x480.jpg?v=1690833311"></div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether you're working on a freestanding sit-stand workstation, a shallow worksurface, or any other workspace configuration, this top-mount c-clamp offers the perfect solution for enhancing your comfort and productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/1_d6161b45-9cff-4e33-9814-1a5ae8f48822.jpg?v=1678990644&width=1080"></div>

</div>
</div>

title: Hat Design Works FlexShield Protective Countertop Screen - 5875645
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works FlexShield Protective Countertop Screen

 Introducing our latest product: the ultimate solution to maintain a safe and secure working environment without sacrificing communication and interaction. Our lightweight and freestanding barrier is specially designed to provide a physical barrier during person-to-person interaction, ensuring the safety of your employees and customers.

Crafted with clear polycarbonate construction, this barrier allows for face-to-face viewing while providing a strong protective barrier. Our product provides the perfect balance between safety and communication, enabling you to maintain productivity and efficiency while ensuring the well-being of your employees.

Our solution is perfect for any industry that requires person-to-person interaction, from healthcare to retail and beyond. It is easy to set up and maintain, making it the ideal solution for companies looking for an effortless way to safeguard their employees and customers.

Invest in our innovative barrier solution today and provide your employees with the peace of mind they need to perform at their best, knowing that their safety is always our top priority.

Specifications

  • Fast: Quick, toolless installation.
  • Easy: Freestanding structure, no damage to counters on installation.
  • Strong: Constructed of polycarbonate: 250 times stronger than glass and virtually indestructible.
  • Adjustable: Flexible extruded hinges with adhesive allows you to configure panels at any angle.
  • Customizable: Custom sizes available upon request.

 

Dimensions

23.5" W x 30" H
Material

Polycarbonate

<div class="header">
<h3>Double the flexibility.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing our amazing Double Joint Mount, the perfect solution for anyone looking to optimize their display setup! With full articulation extending up to 15.7 inches from the pole, this mount allows you to customize your viewing experience in any way you desire.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Limitless display possibilities.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Our mount also features height adjustment along the 17-inch pole, tilt, and portrait-to-landscape rotation, giving you unparalleled flexibility when it comes to positioning your display. And with the ability to fit displays up to 32 inches and 17.6 lbs or less with VESA, this mount can handle just about any setup you can throw at it.</p>
</div>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Flex your workspace.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph"> Introducing the HX Desk Monitor Arm - the ultimate solution for a versatile and stylish workspace! With this monitor arm, you can finally bid farewell to the limitations of a static monitor setup. Say goodbye to neck and eye strain caused by awkward viewing angles and hello to the ultimate comfort and flexibility.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate your screen.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted with the latest technology and sleek design, this monitor arm can easily reposition large monitors weighing up to 42 lbs (19.1 kg) to any angle and height that suits your needs. Whether you're working on a project, gaming, or watching a movie, the HX Desk Monitor Arm ensures that your display is always at the perfect viewing angle.</p>
</div>
</div>

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But that's not all! The HX Desk Monitor Arm is also a great space saver. By lifting your monitor off your desk, you can free up valuable workspace for other essentials. Plus, with its elegant and modern design, this monitor arm enhances the look of any workspace.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/45-475-026-g-1500x1000_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679329759"></div>

<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Style meets flexibility.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">So, if you're looking for a monitor arm that's as adaptable as you are, look no further than the HX Desk Monitor Arm. It's the perfect solution for anyone who values comfort, flexibility, and style in their workspace. Upgrade your setup today!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/45-475-224_f-1500x1000_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679329801"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">

<li style="text-align: left;">Rotation stop: Avoid hitting cube walls with a rotation stop on the base.</li>

<li style="text-align: left;">Sleek build: Cables stay hidden under the arm and through the extension</li>

<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__1mpoO">
<div class="ProductFeatures_ProductFeatures__wrapper__2EaK2">
<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Your workday wonder.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing Tango, the ultimate workday partner for healthcare professionals! Designed to make your job easier and more efficient, Tango is a versatile, ergonomic cart that can effortlessly keep up with your busy schedule.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Heightened flexibility.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its single-hand height adjustment feature, you can easily customize the height of your workspace to fit your needs. And with its antimicrobial worksurface, you can rest assured that your workspace is clean and hygienic.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/I9732233_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679328949" alt="I9732233_1800x1800.jpg (1200×900)" data-mce-src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/I9732233_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679328949"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Smooth mobility.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Tango also comes equipped with 2 non-locking and 2 locking four-inch casters, allowing you to move it around the room as needed easily. And with a base that measures 19.2in W x 20in D, you'll have plenty of space to work with.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/tango-tng-l-np-front_480x480.jpg?v=1688143039"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Simplicity refined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">This expertly-designed cart has all the features you need without any unnecessary frills, making it easy to use, maneuver, and configure. And if you need additional accessories, they're available and sold separately, giving you even more flexibility.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/tango-tng-l-np-back_34d967a2-fd35-4636-82ed-3e2fd9854e30_480x480.jpg?v=1688143453"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Base Dimension: 19.2 in. W x 20 in. D</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Worksurface Size: 20 in. W x 12 in. D</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Worksurface Height: 31.3 in. – 43.1 in.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Casters: 4 in. double wheels (2 non-locking, 2 locking)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Worksurface Type: Plastic</li>
</ul>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ergonomic: Gas spring lift assists for effortless adjustment.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Organized: Included track for mounting accessories and integrated cable management.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated: Built-in, forward-facing handles allow for easy maneuvering and control.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Adjustable: User comfort is enhanced by single-hand height adjustment while standing or sitting.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Secure: Stop bar included for added safety.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Modular Now Dual Yoke Adapter, Black 

Introducing the incredible Dual Yoke, the ultimate solution for all your multi-device mounting needs! With its innovative design, this game-changing product provides a single, centralized mounting point for not just one, but two devices simultaneously. Prepare to revolutionize your setup and maximize your productivity like never before!

Designed with versatility in mind, the Dual Yoke gives you the freedom to customize your workstation exactly how you want it. Whether you're a tech-savvy professional or a multitasking enthusiast, this sleek and reliable yoke is the perfect addition to your arsenal. And remember, the pole is ordered separately, allowing you to tailor the height and positioning to your specific preferences.

But what truly sets the Dual Yoke apart is its unrivaled compatibility. This powerhouse accessory seamlessly integrates with a wide range of devices, including the popular 9189, 9183, MNPL, and 9230 models. No matter what combination of devices you need to mount, rest assured that the Dual Yoke has got you covered!

Elegantly designed in a sleek black finish, the Dual Yoke not only enhances your productivity but also adds a touch of sophistication to your workspace. It's the perfect blend of style and functionality, making it an absolute must-have for anyone seeking a professional and polished setup.

title: Hat Design Works Dual Side by Side Pole Arm - 3651704
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Dual Side by Side Pole Arm 3651704

Introducing the ultimate solution for your productivity needs - the Dual Monitor Mount! With this innovative product, you can now mount two monitors side by side, making it easier than ever to multitask and get more done in less time.

Featuring an articulating arm and a 28-inch pole, this mount provides the perfect viewing angle and height for your monitors, giving you a comfortable and ergonomic setup. You can easily adjust the height, tilt, and swivel of your monitors, allowing you to find the perfect position for your work.

The Dual Monitor Mount also comes with a Flexmount for desk clamp, grommet, thrubolt, and wall mount configurations, making it a versatile option that can be adapted to any workspace. And with its sleek and stylish black design, it's the perfect addition to any PC setup.

What's more, the Dual Monitor Mount is TAA compliant, meaning that it meets the strictest government standards for trade compliance. So you can rest assured that you're getting a top-quality product that's both reliable and safe.

So if you're looking to boost your productivity and create a more comfortable and efficient workspace, look no further than the Dual Monitor Mount. Order now and experience the ultimate in multitasking and productivity!

Specifications

Product Type: Monitor Mount
Screen Dimension: 28"
Color: Black

title: Hat Design Works Dual Side by Side LCD Arm w/14" Pole 3666161
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Dual Side by Side LCD Arm w/14" Pole 3666161

Absolutely! Here's an engaging version of the product description for the Dual Side by Side LCD Arm:

Introducing the Dual Side by Side LCD Arm – the perfect solution for those who demand the best in workspace flexibility! This amazing arm is designed to accommodate widescreen monitors up to 32 inches in size, so you can enjoy a larger and more immersive viewing experience. With its sleek and stylish black design, this arm is the perfect complement to any modern workspace.

Thanks to its 14-inch pole, this arm allows you to position your monitors at the perfect height and angle for maximum comfort and productivity. It includes a tilter and Vesa PC vista, ensuring that your monitors stay securely in place and are easy to adjust when needed. Plus, it's TAA compliant, so you can rest assured that it meets the highest standards of quality and safety.

Please note that the arm does not come with a mount, so be sure to order one separately. Whether you're a gamer, a professional designer, or just someone who wants to make the most of their workspace, the Dual Side by Side LCD Arm is the perfect choice. Order yours today and experience the ultimate in flexibility and convenience!

Specifications

  • Extra-long dual monitor arms enable proper positioning of large and widescreen LCD monitors (20" or more)

  • FLEXmount with six mounting options is available

  • Includes at 14" standard pole mount; custom pole mount lengths are also available

  • Provides 200 degrees of monitor rotation at two pivot points

  • Space saving monitor desk mount design allows approximately three inches of space behind the dual monitors

  • Friction control system provides smooth adjustment while adjusting the position of the dual monitor arms

  • Able to adjust each monitor independently

  • VESA monitor stand compatible - 100mm VESA adapter included; please call for non-VESA options

  • The 9163-S-14 Oversized LCD Dual Monitor Mount can be combined with all Innovative monitor mounting options (sold separately)

  • Optional upgrade to quick install/release monitor mount bracket; please consult your sales rep for details.

Introducing the ultimate workstation for your home or office - our height-adjustable, antimicrobial worksurface desk! With a spacious 20x12 inch surface area and a locking computer compartment, you can work with ease and peace of mind knowing that your work environment is clean and secure.

The desk also features a retractable keyboard and mouse tray, allowing you to easily switch between typing and using your mouse. And with 2 non-locking and 2 locking four inch casters, you can move your workstation wherever you need it to be.

But that's not all! Our desk is also designed with your health and comfort in mind, thanks to its height-adjustable feature. No more hunching over your computer or straining your neck and back - you can adjust the height of your desk to suit your needs and keep you comfortable all day long.

And for even more convenience, you can personalize your workstation with our range of accessories, such as a power cord, basket, shelf, and more! With our workstation, you'll have everything you need to stay productive and comfortable all day long.

Invest in your health and productivity today with our height-adjustable, antimicrobial worksurface desk - the perfect addition to any home or office!

title: Hat Design Works Power Module & USB Hub w/ Desk Clamp - 5899178
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Power Module & USB Hub w/ Desk Clamp 5899178

Introducing the ultimate desktop accessory - the sleek and versatile SmartGuard Power Hub! Say goodbye to the cluttered mess of cords and power strips and hello to a streamlined workspace.

Featuring two three-hole power sockets and two USB-A 5V DC ports, this powerhouse is perfect for charging your devices, powering your computer, and keeping your workspace organized. And with a generous 72 inch power cord and UL approval, you can be sure that you're getting a top-of-the-line product that's both safe and efficient.

The SmartGuard Power Hub is designed to fit seamlessly into your workspace, with a white hub that blends in seamlessly and a black cord that stays out of sight. Plus, its unique clamping system means it can attach securely to any desk edge between 0.75 and 1.75 inches thick, making it the perfect addition to any home office, dorm room, or workspace.

So why settle for a messy, inefficient workspace when you can have the SmartGuard Power Hub? Order yours today and experience the ultimate in desktop power and organization!

title: Hat Design Works Sit Stand Data Entry Arm - 3911289
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works Sit Stand Data Entry Arm 3911289

Introducing the 9139 heavy-duty data entry monitor arm - the perfect solution for industrial and manufacturing environments! With its durable construction and reliable design, this computer mount is built to withstand even the toughest conditions.

What sets the 9139 apart from other monitor arms is its independent adjustment of the monitor and keyboard platform. This means that you can adjust each component separately to achieve the most comfortable and ergonomic working position for you.

Plus, the 9139's heavy-duty construction ensures that your equipment stays secure and stable, even in high-traffic areas. Whether you're working in a busy factory or a bustling warehouse, you can count on the 9139 to keep your monitor and keyboard in place.

So, if you're looking for a high-quality monitor arm that can handle the demands of industrial and manufacturing environments, look no further than the 9139 heavy-duty data entry monitor arm!

seo.description: Improve your workplace ergonomics with the durable 9139 heavy-duty data entry monitor arm, designed for industrial and manufacturing settings. Independent monitor and keyboard adjustment for ultimate comfort and stability.

title: Hat Design Works 8111 – FLEXmount
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 8111 – FLEXmount 

Introducing FLEXmount, the ultimate solution for all your mounting needs! With its innovative design, FLEXmount offers six different configurations—all in one kit! That's right, you read it correctly—six different configurations, all available in a single mount.

Whether you need to mount your computer monitor, laptop, tablet, or even your phone, FLEXmount has got you covered. And the best part? You won't need to buy a separate mount for each device or scenario! FLEXmount's versatile design allows it to handle most mounting scenarios, making it the only mount you'll ever need.

But what if you decide to change the way your arm is mounted several months after purchase? No problem! With FLEXmount, there's nothing more to buy—simply reconfigure your mount to suit your needs. It's that easy!

So why settle for a single-purpose mount when you can have the ultimate solution with FLEXmount? Say goodbye to the hassle and expense of buying multiple mounts, and say hello to the convenience and versatility of FLEXmount. Get yours today and experience the ultimate in mounting flexibility!

Features

  • FLEXmount with six mounting options, including: desk clamp, thru-desk, grommet, wall, reverse wall and side bolt.
  • Compatibility: 7000 Series Articulating Mounts and Single Tier Pole Mounts.
  • For 7500 Series Articulating Mounts and Dual Tier Pole Mounts use the 8318 FLEXmount.

Specifications

Color

Flat White, Silver, Vista Black
Mount Configurations

Desk Edge, Thru-Desk, Grommet, Wall, Reverse Wall, Side Bolt
Warranty

10 Years

seo.description: Introducing FLEXmount - the ultimate mount solution with 6 configurations in one kit! No need for separate mounts. Get the ultimate in flexibility today!

title: 8210 Pole Clamp Mount - 8210-104
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 8210 – Pole Clamp Mount 

Looking for a way to take your workspace to the next level? Look no further than the HAT Design Works 8210 – Pole Clamp Mount!

Made from premium die-cast aluminum, this monitor arm is as sturdy as it is stylish. But what really sets it apart is its versatile clamp system, which lets you attach it to vertical poles of various sizes - 1.5", 1.75", and 2" diameter - giving you unmatched flexibility and convenience.

And with adjustable height, tilt, and swivel angles, you can customize your monitor's position to suit your comfort and productivity needs. Say goodbye to neck and eye strain, and hello to a healthier, more comfortable workspace!

Upgrade your setup today with the HAT Design Works 8210 – Pole Clamp Mount, and experience the ultimate in ergonomic comfort and style.

 Vista Black
Warranty

10 Years

title: Hat Design Works 9170 Pole Mount Clamp
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9170 Pole Mount Clamp

Introducing the ultimate solution for dental offices, kiosks, and retail environments - the 9170 pole mount clamp! Say goodbye to bulky monitor stands that take up valuable desk space, and hello to a sleek and efficient solution for mounting your flat panel monitor.

With the 9170 pole mount clamp, you can easily mount your monitor to a pole with minimal footprint. Its handy pole clamp allows for quick installation and effortless repositioning, making it perfect for any environment where flexibility is key. The monitor can be tilted, pivoted, and rotated to any desired angle, giving you complete control over your display.

But that's not all - the 9170 pole mount clamp is also incredibly versatile. Its pole clamp works with poles of diameter 1.5", 1.75", and 2", making it compatible with a wide range of mounting options. Plus, its durable construction ensures that your monitor will stay securely in place, no matter how often you adjust it.

Upgrade your workspace with the 9170 pole mount clamp today and enjoy the benefits of a more flexible and efficient display solution. Whether you're a dental professional, a retailer, or a kiosk owner, this mount clamp is the perfect way to take your workspace to the next level.

 

Specifications

Color

Flat White, Silver, Vista Black
Weight Capacity

Up to 30 lbs
Tilt

Up to 190°
Pivot

Landscape / Portrait
VESA Compatibility

100mm, quick-release adapter included

<div class="header">
<h3>Tablet freedom unleashed.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;"> Introducing the Neo-Flex® Desk Tablet Arm – the perfect accessory to give your tablet more flexibility than ever before! With just a snap into the cradle, you'll free up your hands to make the most of your device. Whether you need to use a Bluetooth keyboard for intensive computing or want to position your tablet alongside your main workstation monitor, this arm has got you covered.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Total tablet comfort.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">No longer will you need to hold your tablet awkwardly or struggle to find a comfortable position. With the Neo-Flex® Desk Tablet Arm, you can effortlessly adjust the angle and height of your tablet to suit your needs. This means you can work or play for longer periods without experiencing fatigue or discomfort.</p>
</div>
</div>

Its durable construction ensures that your tablet will be securely held in place while you work, so you can focus on what matters most – your productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/45-306-101_inuse_1-1500x1000_480x480.jpg?v=1692658037"></div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Works with many tablets and eReaders, including Apple iPad, Barnes & Noble Nook and Amazon Kindle</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Easily remove the tablet from the cradle when you need to go mobile.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The cradle’s adjustable contact points keep ports free.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sliding brackets allow adjustment to a variety of tablet sizes, with or without case †</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The cradle firmly grasps tablet with latch for secure placement</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The arm’s sturdy design maintains touch-screen stability</li>

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works DMRS 1 Single Monitor Stand

Introducing our game-changing affordable single monitor desk stand - the ultimate solution for those looking to optimize their workspace and improve their posture! Say goodbye to cluttered desks and hello to a more ergonomic and organized workspace with our easy-to-use desk stand.

Our desk stand is the perfect replacement for your existing monitor stand, providing a quick and effortless setup that frees up valuable desk space. With a full-motion quick-install VESA plate, you can easily adjust and rotate your monitor to find the perfect viewing angle, promoting a comfortable and healthy posture throughout the workday.

Not only is our desk stand easy to use, it's also built to last. Constructed with high-quality steel, our stand is robust and durable, providing a solid foundation for your monitor. And with an integrated cable management system, you can keep your cables organized and protected, ensuring a clean and clutter-free workspace.

So why settle for an outdated and bulky monitor stand when you can have the ultimate ergonomic and organized solution? Upgrade to our affordable single monitor desk stand today and start enjoying a more productive and comfortable work experience!

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 100-D28-B11 – Dual Vertical Desk Stand -3349373 

Introducing the perfect solution for working in tight spaces - our innovative display stacking system! Whether you're in a broadcasting booth, financial trading floor, or a war room, our vertical stacking system offers space-saving convenience like no other.

With the ability to stack displays vertically, one over the other, you can now save precious desk space while enjoying the luxury of multiple screens. And with compatibility for some widescreen displays with a 32:9 ratio, you can be sure that our stacking system is perfect for your needs.

Not only is our system space-saving and compatible with a range of displays, but it's also incredibly versatile. With height adjustment options along the entire pole, you can customize the system to suit your preferences and ensure maximum comfort during those long work hours.

Our display stacking system is also built to last. Constructed from robust steel, it provides a solid and long-lasting performance that you can rely on. Plus, with both desk clamp and grommet mount options included, it's easy to find the perfect setup for your workspace.

Say goodbye to messy cables and hello to organization with our integrated cable management system. With cable clips that route cables along the pole, you can enjoy a tidy and organized workspace that's free from clutter and distractions.

So what are you waiting for? Experience the ultimate in space-saving convenience and productivity with our innovative display stacking system.

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 100-D28-B33 – Quad/Hex Monitor Desk Stand 

Transform your workspace into a more organized and efficient hub with our state-of-the-art quad/hex monitor mount! Designed specifically for industries that require multiple screens, including finance, broadcasting, video surveillance, emergency management, communications dispatch, telemetry, command & control, this mount can accommodate up to six 27" displays or four 34" displays.

Gone are the days of struggling with tangled cables and cluttered desks. Our quad/hex monitor mount saves you valuable space while improving your viewing comfort. With adjustable height options along the entire pole, you can customize the monitor setup to suit your needs, and the easy-install quick release pivots ensure fast setup without the need for complicated tools.

Additionally, this mount offers flexible viewing options that allow you to easily adjust monitors to perfect bezel alignment. With cable clips that route cables along the pole, you can keep your workspace neat and tidy, further enhancing your productivity.

Make your life easier and improve your workflow with our quad/hex monitor mount - the ultimate solution for anyone who needs to juggle multiple screens in their daily work

title: Triple Monitor Desk Stand 100-D16-B03
descriptionHtml:
Maximize productivity.

Introducing the ultimate solution for multitasking and boosting your productivity - our triple monitor mount! With the ability to support up to three monitors, each up to 27 inches wide (or two monitors up to 34 inches), you'll have all the screen space you need to take on any project with ease.

Perfectly positioned monitors.

Our mount features quick-release pivots with fine-tuned alignment, allowing you to adjust the angle, tilt, left-to-right pivot, and portrait-to-landscape rotation of your monitors for the perfect viewing experience. Plus, with VESA compatibility and 75 or 100-mm hole patterns, you can rest easy knowing that your monitors will be securely attached.


Declutter your desk.

Say goodbye to the clutter and mess on your desk and hello to a more organized and efficient workspace. With our mount's ability to support up to 25 pounds per monitor, you'll have peace of mind knowing that your expensive equipment is in good hands.


Work Smarter not harder.

Invest in our triple monitor mount today and revolutionize the way you work!


Specifications

  • Screen Size: Dual Monitors: Up to 34", Triple Monitors: Up to 27"
  • Color: Black
  • Weight Capacity: Up to 25 lbs per monitor
  • Tilt: +20° / -10°
  • Pivot: Landscape / Portrait

  • Mount Configurations: Desktop stand
  • VESA Compatibility: 75 & 100mm, adapters included

<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Electric Sit Stand Desktop Converter, the ultimate solution to help you stay healthy and productive while working! </div>

<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron_45-361-026_Height_Adjustable_Wall_Mount_Arm_for_TV_LD_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679601429"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">20-inch (51 cm) height range allows users to move between sitting and standing positions while they interact with the display</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Patented CF motion technology provides premium ease-of-use adjustment</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Secure installation—locking connection between arm and base</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Flexibility meets strength.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Looking for a TV wall mount that's both flexible and sturdy? Look no further than the LX HD Wall Mount Swing Arm! With its embedded CF technology, this arm offers effortless screen adjustment for the ultimate in viewing comfort. Plus, its rock-solid construction ensures your display investment is well-secured</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Maximize your viewing.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The LX HD Wall Mount Swing Arm is the perfect solution for displays weighing up to 50 lbs (23 kg). Its arm extends the display out from the wall up to 13" (33 cm), providing better sight lines and premium viewing angles. And with its easy three-step installation process, you'll have it up and running quickly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/45-268-026_480x480.jpg?v=1684790170"></div>

<div class="innerText">

<h3 class="titleComp">Versatile and reliable.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether you're mounting it to a wood stud or concrete wall, the LX HD Wall Mount Swing Arm comes complete with all the hardware you need to get started. And with its integrated tilt lock-down feature, you can be sure your display will stay in place, no matter what.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron_45-268-026_LX_HD_Wall_Mount_Swing_Arm_3_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679603570"></div>

</div>

<div class="container">

<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Style meets function.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">So if you're looking for a TV wall mount that's both functional and aesthetically pleasing, look no further than the LX HD Wall Mount Swing Arm. It's the ultimate solution for your display needs, perfect for the home or office.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron_45-268-026_LX_HD_Wall_Mount_Swing_Arm_5_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679603569"></div>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Smooth adjustment: Offers 20° of continuous tilt and 360° pan motion</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Flexible views: Allows display to be rotated for portrait or landscape mode</li>

title: Ergotron Neo-Flex® Tilting Wall Mount UHD-2904569
descriptionHtml:
Ergotron Neo-Flex® Tilting Wall Mount UHD

  Introducing the Neo-Flex® Tilting Wall Mount UHD - the ultimate solution for all your large flat panel mounting needs! Whether you're a movie buff, a gaming enthusiast, or simply love binge-watching your favorite shows, this mount is guaranteed to take your viewing experience to the next level.

Designed to fit most 37"-63" flat panels up to a whopping 175 lbs (79 kg), this mount is the perfect blend of strength and versatility. With its easy-to-use tilt mechanism, you can effortlessly adjust the viewing angle to achieve the perfect position for your screen.

Installation is a breeze with the Neo-Flex® Tilting Wall Mount UHD, thanks to its intuitive design and user-friendly instructions. Plus, with its sleek and stylish appearance, this mount seamlessly blends in with any décor, making it the perfect addition to any room in your home or office.

So, if you're looking for a mount that combines strength, versatility, and ease-of-use, look no further than the Neo-Flex® Tilting Wall Mount UHD. It's the perfect choice for anyone who wants to take their viewing experience to the next level!

Specifications

  • Tilt range up to 15º to reduce glare
  • A universal TV wall mount: rails provide greater display compatibility
  • Lift n’ Lock™ allows you to easily attach your flat panel to the mount
  • Tension adjustment for variable tilt
  • Sliding lateral on-wall adjustment
  • Open architecture provides easy access to in-wall wiring
  • Locking bar secures panel to mount
  • Simple to install and use
  • Includes complete hardware kit

seo.description: Upgrade your viewing experience with the Neo-Flex® Tilting Wall Mount UHD! Effortlessly adjust your 37"-63" flat panel up to 175 lbs for the perfect angle.

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Artistry in motion.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Neo-Flex Cantilever UHD mount - the perfect blend of form and function for your large flat panel display. With its sleek, low-profile design, this mount seamlessly integrates with your space, making your display a true work of art.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Heavyweight performance.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Neo-Flex Cantilever UHD mount is a true powerhouse. It can support up to 120 lbs (54 kg) and's a perfect fit for even the largest flat panels.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="Ergotron-61-132-223-Neo-Flex-Cantilever-Wall-Mount-UHD_1800x1800.jpg (1800×1800)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron-61-132-223-Neo-Flex-Cantilever-Wall-Mount-UHD_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679605541"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Angle your vision.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph"> And with its cantilever design, you can easily adjust the display's position to find the perfect viewing angle..</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Ergotron-61-142-003-TM-Tilting-TV-Wall-Mount-XL_1_480x480.jpg?v=1692133515"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">AV excellence.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Whether you're setting up a home theater or outfitting your boardroom with the latest in AV technology, the Neo-Flex Cantilever UHD mount is the perfect solution.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="Ergotron-61-132-223-Neo-Flex-Cantilever-Wall-Mount-UHD_lg_1668850519_1800x1800.jpg (1800×1800)" src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron-61-132-223-Neo-Flex-Cantilever-Wall-Mount-UHD_lg_1668850519_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679605541"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extends up to 18.8" (48 cm) from wall. Minimum profile is just 3.8" (10 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sliding lateral adjustment of 2.9" (7.4 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Tilt and pan for maximum viewing flexibility</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Includes universal adapter for greater panel compatibility</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Integrated cable management guides and hides cords</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Lift n’ Lock™ allows you to attach your flat panel to the mount easily</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Open frame provides ample room for power and A/V cutouts behind the TV</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Built-in screen leveling</li>
</ul>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;"></ul>

title: Ergotron SIM90 Signage Integration Mount-2548396
descriptionHtml:
Ergotron SIM90 Signage Integration Mount

  Introducing the SIM90 Signage Integration Mount - the ultimate all-in-one solution for mounting large digital displays with ease and efficiency! Say goodbye to the hassle of purchasing multiple components from different suppliers, because with SIM90, everything you need comes in one convenient box with just one part number.

With its fully integrated design, SIM90 is the ultimate time-saver when it comes to installing your digital signage solutions. Featuring a VESA-compliant thin client CPU holder, portrait-to-landscape pivot, and all the necessary fasteners, you'll be able to quickly and easily mount your displays in no time.

No more fumbling around with different pieces and parts, SIM90 has got you covered. Whether you're a business owner looking to enhance your customer experience or an office manager looking to streamline your workspace, SIM90 Signage Integration Mount is the perfect choice for all your digital display needs.

So what are you waiting for? Order your SIM90 today and experience the ultimate in simplicity and convenience when it comes to mounting your digital signage displays!

Specifications

  • Complete, fully integrated, all-in-one mounting system includes all components for installing large display digital signage solutions
  • Simplifies digital signage installation with preassembled components; no need for additional equipment
  • Flexible deployment options to accommodate your digital signage messaging and space requirements; portrait-to-landscape orientation, scalable for future hardware refreshes
  • Easy, do-it-yourself portrait or landscape adjustment—no need to reinstall display; knobs are available for locking tilt orientation in place
  • Security fasteners deter theft to protect your investment
  • Conveniently attaches VESA-compliant (75 x 75 or 100 x 100 mm) thin client CPU to the back of the display
  • Single SKU design fits most screens from 32" and larger up to 105 lbs (47.6 kg)
  • Cable management system conceals and organize cables
  • Patented Constant Force™ motion technology

seo.description: Get your digital displays up and running in no time with the SIM90 Signage Integration Mount - the ultimate all-in-one wall mounting system! Order yours now.

title: Ergotron LX HD Wall Mount Pivot- 45-269-009
descriptionHtml:
Ergotron LX HD Wall Mount Pivot

  Introducing the ultimate solution for flexible display mounting - Ergotron's LX HD mounts! Say goodbye to rigid and boring wall mounts and hello to a dynamic and versatile mounting option that can hold LCD displays or TVs weighing up to 50 lbs (23 kg).

With Ergotron's LX HD mounts, you get more than just a mount - you get reliability, quality, and innovative design, all at an unbeatable price. Whether you're a gamer, a creative professional, or a movie enthusiast, these mounts offer the perfect solution for your display needs.

With the LX HD mounts, you can easily adjust your display to your desired height, angle, and distance with just a touch, giving you ultimate flexibility and comfort while using your screen. Say goodbye to awkward neck strains and hello to a customizable and comfortable viewing experience.

Plus, the sleek and modern design of these mounts adds a touch of style and sophistication to any space. So, whether you're mounting your display in your home office, living room, or bedroom, Ergotron's LX HD mounts are the perfect choice.

Choose reliability, quality, and innovation without breaking the bank with Ergotron's LX HD mounts. Upgrade your display mounting experience today!

Specifications

  • Heavy duty

    Fits VESA-compliant monitors weighing up to 50 lbs (23 kg)

  • Smooth adjustment

    Offers 20° of continuous tilt and 40° pan motion

  • Flexible views

    Allows display to be rotated for portrait or landscape mode

  • Reliable option

    Tested to four times its maximum weight capacity for a secure fit

  • Excellent value

    Affordable wall mount solution for medium displays

  • Easy install

    Set up your mount in three simple steps

<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;"> Introducing the Glide Wall Mount HD, your ultimate solution to transform your TV or large display into a dynamic viewing experience. title: 8335-MD Medium CPU Holder
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 8335-MD – Medium CPU Holder

Introducing our cutting-edge CPU holder, designed to give your workstation a boost in both efficiency and safety! Our sturdy holder is fully adjustable, allowing you to securely mount CPUs ranging from 3 to 5 inches in size, keeping them safe and secure from the hazards of static electricity.

But that's not all - our holder is also incredibly space-efficient, thanks to its innovative mounting system. By attaching it to our 8326 Vertical Mounting Track, you'll be able to free up valuable desk space, while still maintaining easy access to your computer.

Whether you're looking to streamline your workspace or simply keep your CPU safe and secure, our CPU holder is the ultimate solution. With its sleek design, sturdy construction, and unbeatable performance, it's the perfect addition to any modern workspace. So why wait? Try it out today and take your workstation to the next level!

title: 8335-LG Large CPU Holder
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 8335-LG – Large CPU Holder

A sturdy CPU holder that can be adjusted from 5″-7.5″ provides flexibility to accommodate a wide range of CPU sizes. This allows the CPU to be securely mounted and easily accessible, while also helping to save valuable desk space.

In addition, isolating the CPU from hazardous static electricity can help prevent damage to sensitive components and ensure reliable performance. This is especially important in environments where electrostatic discharge (ESD) is a concern, such as in manufacturing or laboratory settings.

Mounting the CPU holder to a 8326 Vertical Mounting Track provides even more space savings, as the CPU can be mounted vertically instead of horizontally, freeing up desk space and making it easier to access cables and ports.

Overall, a sturdy CPU holder that isolates from static electricity and can be mounted to a vertical track is a practical and efficient solution for keeping your computer hardware secure and organized.

Specifications

Color

Vista Black. Silver, White
Warranty

10 Years

descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 7VESA2x2 – 200mm x 200mm VESA Adapter 

If you have a monitor with a 200mm x 200mm VESA hole pattern and want to mount it using a VESA adapter plate, you will need to find an adapter plate that is compatible with that hole pattern.

One option is to look for a universal VESA adapter plate that supports a range of hole patterns, including 200mm x 200mm. There are several such adapter plates available on the market from different manufacturers. Make sure to verify that the plate is compatible with your monitor's weight and size specifications before purchasing.

Alternatively, you can look for a VESA adapter plate specifically designed for monitors with a 200mm x 200mm hole pattern. These adapters are less common, but there are still several options available on the market. Again, make sure to verify compatibility with your monitor before purchasing.

When selecting a VESA adapter plate, pay attention to the weight capacity and size limitations of the plate to ensure that it is suitable for your monitor. You may also want to consider factors such as adjustability and ease of installation when making your selection.

title: 8131 52-10  Monitor Arm Keyboard Adapter
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 8131-52-10 Monitor Arm Keyboard Adapter 

Introducing the perfect solution for maximizing your workspace efficiency and comfort – the Innovative Mounting Arm Keyboard Tray Adapter! This innovative product allows you to add a keyboard tray to certain Innovative mounting arms, giving you the freedom to adjust the height, rotation, and pivot of both your monitor and keyboard simultaneously.

Say goodbye to uncomfortable, cramped workspaces and hello to a more ergonomic and streamlined setup. With the Innovative Mounting Arm Keyboard Tray Adapter, you'll be able to effortlessly adjust the height of your monitor and keyboard, so you can work in a comfortable position that suits your needs.

Plus, with the ability to independently rotate and pivot your monitor and keyboard, you'll have the flexibility to customize your workspace to your exact preferences. Whether you're working on a project, typing up a report, or simply browsing the web, you'll be able to do so with ease and comfort.

Don't settle for a cluttered and uncomfortable workspace any longer. Upgrade to the Innovative Mounting Arm Keyboard Tray Adapter and experience the benefits of a more ergonomic and efficient setup today!

Specifications

Model 8131-52-10
Manufacturer Innovative LCD Arms
Part Number 8131-52-10
Weight 2 lbs

Features

  • Allows monitor and keyboard simutaneous vertical motion (height adjustment).
  • REQUIRED attachment for 8136, 8137 and 8138 keyboard trays.
  • Individual rotation & pivot of monitor and keyboard.

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Revive and succeed.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the ultimate solution to your work fatigue - the WorkFit-C Single LD Sit-Stand Workstation! Say goodbye to the sedentary lifestyle and hello to increased productivity and energy with this revolutionary workstation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Effortless elevation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Featuring a large worksurface, height-adjustable keyboard tray, and display, this workstation ensures optimal comfort even during prolonged computing sessions. Thanks to its counterbalanced adjustment points, you can effortlessly transition from sitting to standing whenever you desire, without requiring any tools or interruptions to your work.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron_24-215-085_WorkFit-C_Single_LD_Sit-Stand_Workstation_2_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679689717"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Height for all.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With a total height adjustment of 25 inches (63 cm), this workstation accommodates individuals of all heights and sizes. Its compact footprint allows you to save precious desk space while the advanced cable management system keeps your workspace neat and organized.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron_24-215-085_WorkFit-C_Single_LD_Sit-Stand_Workstation_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679689716"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Secure and adjustable.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The integrated brake secures the table in place, providing added stability and safety while you work. And with just a touch, the brake releases for easy height adjustment, giving you complete control over your workstation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron_24-215-085_WorkFit-C_Single_LD_Sit-Stand_Workstation_lg_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679689716" alt="Ergotron_24-215-085_WorkFit-C_Single_LD_Sit-Stand_Workstation_lg_1800x1800.jpg (1000×1000)"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Easy motion: Adjusts between sitting and standing with an intuitive hand-brake lever</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Quiet adjustment: Offers 25" (63 cm) of smooth vertical lift to keep your space, your space</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Comfortable fit: Includes an ergonomic back-tilt keyboard tray and adjustable monitor riser</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Stay organized: The cable management box stores six-outlet power strips, power bricks, and cables for a neat workspace.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extra workspace: Large work surface keeps your tablet, smartphone or notes nearby</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Sit-stand computer cart</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">25" height adjustability: Enables sitting or standing while working</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">24" screen size: Holds a monitor up to 24" in screen size</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">24.9 lbs weight capacity: Maximum load on the height adjustment assembly 24.9 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">24"w x 23"d Large worksurface</li>

  Introducing the Ergotron LX Wall Mount System - the ultimate space-saving solution that will revolutionize the way you work! Crafted from durable polished aluminum, this wall mount system is built to last and provides unbeatable support for your LCD, keyboard and CPU.

<div class="html-container">
<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Productivity perfected.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the Ergotron 200 Series Combo Arm – your ultimate space-saving solution for a clutter-free workspace! Say goodbye to the hassle of a messy desk and hello to a streamlined setup that maximizes your productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Expand your reach.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With its 3-point telescoping motion, the Ergotron 200 Series Combo Arm provides you with greater reach, allowing you to easily bring your monitor and keyboard to exactly where you need them. And with its versatile combination wall mount, you can accommodate your monitor and keyboard and your bar-code scanner, wrist rest, and mouse – all in one convenient location!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/45-230-200_greyscrnlogo-orig_1800x1800_3eb00d30-852b-4963-a8cc-6a1bb2468592_480x480.jpg?v=1684512087"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn textMedia">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Streamlined simplicity.<br>
</h3>
<p class="paragraph">But that's not all - this product is designed to simplify your life. The unique cable management system ensures that your cords are concealed and organized, making cleaning a breeze. So you can focus on your work without being distracted by cable clutter.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/auto_20210222110302_44339994_05_a3b537c0-bf36-4b42-9033-bde63aac5c31_45-230-200_480x480.webp?v=1684511589"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Productivity powerhouse.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">So, if you're looking for a space-saving solution that will enhance your productivity and streamline your workspace, look no further than the Ergotron 200 Series Combo Arm!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/ergotron-200-series-combo-arm-black-45-230-200-200317_1024x1024_2x_56771ea6-9bbd-48e1-9768-afd3dfd345c9_480x480.webp?v=1684511873"></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oneColumn paddingTop">
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Easily position the flat panel monitor and keyboard for maximum comfort and productivity.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The distance between the screen and the keyboard is adjustable.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Five-inch (13 cm) LCD height adjustment</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Rugged steel construction</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extremely easy to clean; promotes infection control</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Barcode scanner holder provides easy access to hand-held scanner</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Extends keyboard out up to 39" (99 cm); fold equipment back out of the way when not in use. With the keyboard folded up, total system depth is as little as 12.1" (31 cm)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Ergonomic negative-tilt keyboard tray with left or right mouse tray ensures wrists remain in a neutral position during data entry</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Constant Force, patented lift technology provides fluid, one-touch adjustment of LCD</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Clean, concealed and neat routing of cables through the expansive cable management system<br>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features<br>
</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Wall Mount Combo Arm: Holds monitor, bar code scanner, keyboard tray, wrist rest, mouse</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">24" screen size: Mounts monitors up to 24" in screen size</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">6-18 lbs weight: Carries a monitor in the weight range of 6-18 lbs</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">5" height adjustment: The monitor adjusts 5" vertically, keyboard height is fixed</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">39" extension: keyboard extends 39" horizontally</li>

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Ergonomics redefined.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the game-changer in workplace ergonomics - the Winston Workstation! Say goodbye to the days of sitting at your desk for hours on end and hello to a healthier, more productive work environment.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Powerful sit-stand innovation.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The Winston Workstation is a versatile sit-stand workstation that easily transforms any desk into a sit-stand workspace with just the push of a button. This freestanding workstation fits anywhere on your desk and supports an impressive 1026 lbs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/Winston-Workstation-Dual-White-Private-Office-Environment_480x480.jpg?v=1686075435"></div>

<div class="textBlock">

</h3>
<p class="paragraph">The workstation is designed to support two monitors and features an expansive work surface measuring 30in x 24in, providing ample space for all your work essentials. The included accessory tray keeps your desk organized and clutter-free, making it easier to focus on your tasks.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/winston-desk-converter-best-2022-home-office-1_1200x_2397b6e2-ea34-4a50-879a-e13a6f4eeb47_480x480.webp?v=1686075677"></div>

<p class="paragraph">The Winston Workstation is also compatible with 75 mm and 100 mm VESA monitors up to 30 inches wide, allowing you to customize your workspace to meet your specific needs. And with its dual sit-stand capabilities, you can easily switch between sitting and standing throughout the day, promoting a healthier lifestyle and boosting productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/winston-desk-converter-best-2022-home-office-5_1200x_6331ebba-caa3-4ec3-998f-b89e77705718_480x480.webp?v=1686075907"></div>

<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Height Adjustment Mechanism: Pneumatic</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Screen Size: Up to 30"</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Color: Flat White, Silver, Vista Black</li>

<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Stability: Features an overall height adjust range of 17" and a locking cylinder to keep the workstation in place.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Convenient: Expansive worksurface and storage tray allow you to bring all necessities with you when you stand.</li>

<h3>Flex your space.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the revolutionary 7Flex monitor arm – the ultimate solution to your workspace woes! Say goodbye to cluttered desks and hello to ergonomic comfort with just one hand.</p>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Maximize your desk.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">With the 7Flex monitor arm, you can suspend your flat panel above your desk, freeing up valuable space on your workspace. The slim profile design folds up to occupy just 3.5 inches of space, allowing you to make the most of your desk space.</p>
</div>
</div>

</h3>

It's the perfect solution for anyone who needs to keep their workspace tidy and their body in a comfortable ergonomic position.</p>
</div>
</div>
