title: Ergotron Neo-Flex Projector Ceiling Mount - 2904578
descriptionHtml:
Ergotron Neo-Flex Projector Ceiling Mount

  Introducing the Neo-Flex Projector Ceiling Mount, the ultimate solution for all your projector mounting needs! This sleek and streamlined mount is designed to provide you with maximum adjustability and user-friendliness, making it the perfect choice for anyone looking for a hassle-free and highly customizable projector mounting experience.

With its infinitely adjustable tilt and pitch features, the Neo-Flex Projector Ceiling Mount allows you to achieve the perfect angle and projection height with ease. Whether you need to make post-installation adjustments or simply want to fine-tune your setup to perfection, this mount has got you covered.

But that's not all - the Neo-Flex Projector Ceiling Mount also boasts a range of other user-friendly features, including a quick-release mechanism that allows you to easily detach your projector for cleaning or maintenance, as well as a secure locking system that ensures your projector stays firmly in place at all times.

So why wait? Elevate your projector setup to the next level with the Neo-Flex Projector Ceiling Mount - the ultimate choice for anyone looking for maximum adjustability, user-friendliness, and convenience. Order yours today and experience the ultimate in projector mounting!

Specifications

  • Adaptable, universal mounting capability
  • Fits projectors with most hole patterns
  • Legs adjustable from 5" to 19.8" (13–50 cm) diagonally for small to large projectors
  • Built-in pitch/roll adjustment
  • Includes ceiling plate and PFC-A coupler
  • Hex pin anti-theft security feature

<div class="oneColumn">
<div class="header">
<h3>Double the screens and double the efficiency!</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;" class="paragraph" data-mce-style="text-align: center;">Introducing the DS100 Dual-Monitor Desk Stand, Vertical - the ultimate solution for taking back your workspace and unleashing your productivity! This sleek and innovative stand suspends two flat panel monitors on a single base, giving you the freedom to uncover more work area and reclaim your desk space.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="twoColumn mediaText">
<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<h3 class="titleComp">Elevate and excel.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Gone are the days of dealing with cluttered and cramped workspaces. With the DS100 Dual-Monitor Desk Stand, Vertical, you can elevate your monitors to a comfortable viewing height and easily switch between applications. Whether you're a graphic designer, video editor, or multitasking master, this stand provides the perfect solution for streamlining your workflow and maximizing productivity.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron-33-091-200-DS100-Dual-Monitor-Desk-Stand-Vertical_lg_1668181388_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679956613"></div>

</div>

<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Premium, Sleek and Secure.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Crafted from premium materials, this stand is built to last and designed to impress. Its sleek and modern design blends seamlessly into any workspace, while its sturdy construction ensures that your monitors remain safe and secure. Plus, its easy-to-use adjustment features make it a breeze to customize your viewing experience and achieve the perfect angle for your needs.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/Ergotron_33_091_200_DS100_Dual_Monitor_Vertical_Desk_Stand_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679956613"></div>

<div class="container">
<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle"><br></p>
<h3 class="titleComp">Revamp, reclaim and thrive!</h3>
<p class="paragraph">So, what are you waiting for? Say goodbye to cluttered desks and hello to a more efficient, organized, and productive workspace with the DS100 Dual-Monitor Desk Stand, Vertical!</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img src="https://www.jestik.com/cdn/shop/products/ds100-33-091-200_ls_a-orig_1800x1800.jpg?v=1679956614"></div>

<h3 class="titleComp" style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Specifications</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Multi-display stand: Position the height and angle for comfort and productivity</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Medium size: Supports screens up to 27" and 23 lbs (10.4 kg)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Saves space: Low-profile base opens up more work area</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Streamlined views: Slide screens into place so the edges align</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Stable platform: Durable steel construction locks in screens</li>

title: Hat Design Works 9112-D-FM Dual Monitor Pole Mount
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 9112-D-FM Dual Monitor Pole Mount

Introducing the ultimate solution for a more organized and ergonomic workspace - the Dual 9112-D-FM Monitor Desk Mount! Say goodbye to cluttered desks and strained necks caused by constantly adjusting your monitors. With the Dual 9112-D-FM Monitor Desk Mount, you can easily display not just one, but two flat panel monitors side-by-side with dual articulating monitor arms that allow for easy and customizable positioning.

Not only that, but you can also choose from various pole mount lengths and monitor extension arms to further customize your setup to your liking. The Dual Tier Foldable LCD arm with 28 Pole offers the perfect combination of durability and flexibility, while including both 75mm and 100mm VESA adapters and a Flex Mount to ensure compatibility with almost any flat panel monitor.

Take your workspace to the next level with the Dual 9112-D-FM Monitor Desk Mount and experience the benefits of a more organized, efficient, and comfortable work environment.

Specifications

Screen Size

Up to 27"
Color

Silver, Vista Black
Weight Capacity

Up to 30 lbs
Extension Range

13.4"
Tilt

Up to 190°
Pivot

Landscape / Portrait
Rotation

Three rotation joints
Mount Configurations

Desk Edge, Thru-Desk, Grommet, Wall, Reverse Wall, Side Bolt
VESA Compatibility

75 & 100mm, quick-release adapters included
Warranty

10 Years

Ergotron TeachWell Mobile Digital Workspace

Introducing TeachWell, the ultimate solution for educators seeking to break free from the confines of traditional teaching setups! Our mobile digital workspace is a true game-changer, offering you the freedom to move and collaborate with ease.

Gone are the days of being tethered to a desk or podium. descriptionHtml:

Introducing the revolutionary 9140 flexible data entry arm, designed to provide you with an unparalleled level of comfort and customization in your workspace. Say goodbye to the discomfort of awkward and rigid workstations that cause unnecessary strain on your body. With the 9140, you can easily adjust the height and position of your workstation to fit your unique needs, whether you're tall or short.

The 9140's flexibility and ease of use are unmatched, allowing you to effortlessly adjust the position and height of your keyboard and monitor to ensure maximum comfort and productivity. Plus, with the S7 end cap to end cap arm rated at 1000N, you can trust that your equipment will be securely and safely held in place.

And that's not all - the 9140 also features a sleek and modern design that will elevate the look of your workspace. It's the perfect combination of form and function, providing you with the tools you need to work comfortably and efficiently, all while looking great.

Please note that the keyboard tray is sold separately, but with the 813510 flexmount and VESA plates, you can easily attach your existing keyboard tray to the 9140 arm.

Upgrade your workspace today with the 9140 flexible data entry arm and experience the ultimate in comfort, productivity, and style.

<h3>An ergonomic experience you will love.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">Kiss sore wrists, tired shoulders, and typing discomfort goodbye. Once you experience the Cloud Nine typing difference, you’ll never go back to a standard keyboard.</p>

<p class="paragraph">The ErgoTKL keeps your hands comfortable by separating them a natural width apart. It also keeps your wrists supported in their natural inward angle with 7° of built in tenting.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="Internet and screentime" src="https://cdn.autonomous.ai/static/upload/images/common/upload/20220208/1._Type_naturally.99f4670de5.jpg" class="img-responsive" data-mce-src="https://cdn.autonomous.ai/static/upload/images/common/upload/20220208/1._Type_naturally.99f4670de5.jpg"></div>

<p class="paragraph">With 0°/4°/7° of forward tilt, you’ll always have palm support whether you sit, stand or transition between the two throughout the day.</p>
</div>

<p class="paragraph">Boost productivity with dedicated CUT, COPY, PASTE, SELECT ALL hotkeys. Or program your own custom functions using the app. Includes an extra set of “M” keycaps for custom assignments.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/clean_your_keyboard_480x480.jpg?v=1679513018" data-mce-src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/clean_your_keyboard_480x480.jpg?v=1679513018"></div>
</div>

<div class="textBlock">
<div class="innerText">
<p class="subTitle">BACKLIT KEYS</p>
<h3 class="titleComp">It’s ergo, not boring.</h3>
<p class="paragraph">All keys are fully backlit and easy to read in any environment. They feature premium CHERRY MX (Brown) RGB mechanical switches and can be customized with any of the 19 built-in backlighting patterns and colors. Or set a custom color using the app.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="mediaBlock"><img alt="" src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1354/6667/files/45-489-026black_a-1500x1000_480x480.jpg?v=1683049242"></div>
</div>
</div>

<h2><br></h2>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features</h3>
<ul style=" font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300; ">
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Concave keywells are scooped into a bowl shape to reduce hand and finger extension and relax muscles.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Separating the keywells positions the arms at shoulder-width to keep wrists straight and perpendicular to the home row to reduce abduction and ulnar deviation.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The keys are arranged in vertical columns (rather than staggered) to reflect your fingers' natural motion better.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The two keywells are “tented” to moderately raise the thumb side of the hand. Tenting puts you in a more neutral “handshake” posture and reduces the stresses caused by forearm pronation. Choose from one of three heights, depending on your preferences.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The integrated palm supports reduce stressful bending of the wrists and provide a convenient place to rest your hands when you are not actively typing. Add the new premium pads for even more support (AC360PP Sold Separately).</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The thumb clusters include frequently-used keys such as Enter, Space, Backspace, and Delete to redistribute the workload from your relatively weaker, overused little fingers to stronger thumbs.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">The Advantage360 may look big, but it has a smaller footprint than most keyboards because we eliminated the numeric 10-key so you can place the mouse closer to your body, reducing painful “over-reach”.</li>
<li style="text-align: left;" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Functions keys are located in the number row and accessed via the Fn Key for reduced reach and enhanced portability.</li>
</ul>

title: Hat Design Works 7000 Busby 8408 Dual Monitor Arm with Integrated USB Hub
descriptionHtml:
Hat Design Works 7000 Busby 8408 Dual Monitor Arm with Integrated USB Hub

Introducing the ultimate space-saving and productivity-boosting solution - the 7000-8408 Dual Monitor Arm with integrated USB hub! With this sleek and sturdy arm, you can effortlessly position your two monitors independently with just one hand. No more wasting time and effort adjusting two separate arms - this dual monitor arm makes it a breeze to create the perfect viewing angle.

Not only is the 7000-8408 Dual Monitor Arm super easy to use, but it also offers incredible versatility. Thanks to the FLEXmount, you can mount your monitors in six different ways, including desk edge, wall, thru-desk, side bolt, grommet, or reverse wall. And with the integrated cable organizer, you can keep your workspace neat and tidy by hiding all your wires and cables out of sight.

But that's not all! This dual monitor arm is also equipped with four USB 3.1 ports, providing you with convenient access to charge and power all of your USB-enabled devices. And with 24" of horizontal range and 16" of vertical range, you can enjoy extremely flexible positioning of your dual flat panel monitors.

So why settle for a cluttered, inefficient workspace when you can have the ultimate space-efficient, productivity-boosting solution with the 7000-8408 Dual Monitor Arm? Upgrade your workspace today and experience the difference for yourself!

 

Models

  • 7000-500-Busby-8408 3 - 10 lbs per monitor
  • 7000-800-Busby-8408 10 - 22 lbs per monitor

Features

  • Dual monitor arm offers convenient access to charge and power all of your USB-enabled devices
  • Features four USB 3.1 ports
  • The monitor arm offers 24" of horizontal range and 16" of vertical range (8" up and down from horizontal)
  • Extremely flexible positioning of dual flat panel monitors
  • Independently move and adjust each arm
  • Mount the monitor arms to your desk edge, through a grommet hole, or bolt through desk

Specifications

Screen Size

Up to 32"
Color

Flat White, Silver, Vista Black
Weight Capacity

3 – 22 lbs per monitor
Height Adjustment

16"
Extension Range

Tilt

Up to 190°
Pivot

Landscape / Portrait
Rotation

360° at three joints
Mount Configurations

Desk Edge, Thru-Desk, Grommet
VESA Compatibility

100mm, quick-release adapters included
Warranty

10 Years

title: WorkRite JIBE Dual Articulating Arms
descriptionHtml:
WorkRite JIBE Dual Articulating Arms

Introducing the JIBE monitor arm – the ultimate solution for optimizing your workspace! With its unique arm design, you can now push your arms back in and keep your monitors seamlessly positioned side by side. No more awkward angles and cramped spaces!

The JIBE monitor arm boasts a detachable VESA plate that makes installation and removal of your monitors quick and effortless. Plus, with the help of an Allen wrench, you can fine-tune the spring tension to perfectly counterbalance any monitor weighing between 5-20 lb. Say goodbye to wobbly screens and hello to smooth and effortless adjustments.

The JIBE monitor arm also features a 180 degree pivot limiter that locks out the rotation of the arm, preventing any unwanted collisions with walls and panels. This ensures maximum safety and convenience in any workspace.

But that's not all! The JIBE monitor arm takes convenience to the next level with its integrated USB 3.0 cables. Bring power right to your monitor arm base and enjoy easy access to your USB devices without the hassle of messy cables.

Upgrade your workspace with the JIBE monitor arm today and experience the ultimate in comfort, convenience, and style. With its sleek design and unparalleled functionality, you won't want to go back to your old setup. Order now and discover the power of JIBE!

Specifications

  • Dual arm supports two monitors 5–20 lb ea
  • Maximum monitor height: 20.27"
  • Articulation range: 12.60"
  • Forward reach: 22.67"
  • Stowed depth: 3.55"
  • Monitor:
    • Tilt: +/- 40 degrees

title: WorkRite Astra 3 Double Arm Desk Light
descriptionHtml:
WorkRite Astra 3 Double Arm Desk Light

Introducing the Astra 3 Double Arm, the ultimate solution for big reach and big performance! With an impressive extension of nearly 3 feet from its base, this cutting-edge lighting system is designed to provide outstanding reach in a small and efficient footprint.

Thanks to its 270° rotating head, the Astra 3 Double Arm allows you to direct illumination exactly where you need it, eliminating any shadowing effects and providing a crisp white light that's sure to impress. And with clustered, high-output, high CRI LEDs, you'll enjoy exceptional brightness and clarity, even in smaller spaces.

But that's not all - the Astra 3 also features programmable touch button controls, giving you the power to customize your lighting experience like never before. With the ability to return to your last dimming level, double-tap for maximum brightness, and even set auto shut-off after 5 or 10 hours of use, you'll enjoy unmatched convenience and control.

And for even greater energy savings, the Astra 3 also includes an advanced Occupancy Sensor that automatically turns on the system with movement and shuts off after 15 minutes of inactivity.

So whether you're working in a small workspace or a large industrial environment, the Astra 3 Double Arm is the ultimate lighting solution for superior performance, unmatched convenience, and exceptional energy savings. Don't settle for less - upgrade to the Astra 3 Double Arm today and experience the power of big reach and big performance!

Specifications

  • Foot candle power (@ 15"): 157 fc
  • Light output (lumens): 384 lm
  • Power consumption (wattage): 5.7 W
  • Lumens per watt: 67 lm/W
  • Light color temperature (CCT): 3100 K
  • Color Rendering Index (CRI): 93 CRI
  • Includes energy saving Occupancy Sensor

Technical Drawing

Features

  • 34.9" Reach from base/mount
  • Multiple base options
  • Bright white light output: 3100 K, 93 CRI
  • Included occupancy sensor
  • Continuous dimming from 100%–5%

  • UL Certified, Energy Star Compliant Luminaires V1.2
  • 50,000+ hour life LED’s (L70 rating)
  • 5 year fixture warranty • Available in silver
  • 12 W transformer included:
    • 24 V, 0.5 A, Class 2 transformer: 3" × 1.125" × 1.75"
    • Two prong plug on 6' cord, connects to 3' cord attached to fixture

Base Options

title: test product Chris
descriptionHtml:
Kinesis Advantage360 Professional Wireless and Wired Split Keyboard

Looking for an ergonomic keyboard that won't tie you down? The Kinesis Advantage360 Professional is the perfect solution. This wireless keyboard features our patented contoured keyboard design, now in a full split form factor for even more ergonomic adjustability. Separate the two key modules to shoulder width and rotate them to reduce the painful ulnar deviation. And use the integrated tenting mechanism to choose from one of three heights (High, Medium, and Low) to reduce forearm pronation. As the market leader in computer ergonomics, Kinesis has designed and built premium-grade keyboards for over 25 years

Mechanical Key Switches

The Advantage360 Professional utilizes the Gateron Brown stem low-force tactile key switches. “Tactility” is a slightly elevated force around the midpoint of the stroke of the key which lets you know the switch is about to be activated. A tactile response is preferred by many ergonomists because it cues your fingers that activation is about to occur and can reduce the frequency of “bottoming out” the switch with a hard impact. Unlike the base model which uses Kinesis’ proprietary SmartSet Engine, the Pro uses open-source ZMK firmware. Program the keyboard using the web-based configurator or simple text syntax. Power users can access the code on GitHub to build and share their own features.

Split Design for Optimal Ergonomics

Cloud Nine's split keyboard design allows users to position each half of the keyboard at a comfortable angle, reducing strain on wrists and shoulders. The keyboard also features adjustable tenting to help you find the perfect typing position.

High-Quality Mechanical Switches

The ErgoTKL features high-quality Cherry MX mechanical switches, providing a responsive and satisfying typing experience. Choose from a variety of switch types to suit your typing preferences, including tactile, linear, and clicky options.

Kinesis 360 Professional Wireless and Wired Split Keyboard Features:

  • Concave keywells are scooped into a bowl shape to reduce hand and finger extension and relax muscles.
  • Separating the keywells positions the arms at shoulder-width to keep wrists straight and perpendicular to the home row to reduce abduction and ulnar deviation.
  • The keys are arranged in vertical columns (rather than staggered) to reflect the natural motion of your fingers better.
  • The two keywells are “tented” to moderately raise the thumb side of the hand. Tenting puts you in a more neutral, “handshake” posture and reduces the stresses caused by forearm pronation. Choose from one of three heights depending on your preferences.
  • DThe integrated palm supports reduce stressful bending of the wrists and provide a convenient place to rest your hands when you are not actively typing. Add the new premium pads for even more support (AC360PP Sold Separately).
  • The thumb clusters include frequently-used keys such as Enter, Space, Backspace, and Delete to redistribute the workload away from your relatively weaker and overused little fingers to stronger thumbs.
  • The Advantage360 may look big, but it actually has a smaller footprint than most keyboards because we eliminated the numeric 10-key so you can place the mouse closer to your body, reducing painful “over-reach”.
  • Functions keys are located in the number row and accessed via the Fn Key for reduced reach and enhanced portability.

<h3>First split mechanical gaming keyboard.</h3>
<p class="paragraph" style="text-align: center;">The Freestyle Edge RGB is the first split mechanical keyboard designed specifically for gaming. It was engineered with input from serious gamers to meet the strictest standards for quality and design. An adjustable 20” braided cable links the key modules, giving you unparalleled freedom to customize your rig. Move the right module out of the way for one-handed FPS play or split the modules apart and place your HOTAS or stream mic between the two halves for incredible convenience.</p>

<p class="paragraph">For maximum typing comfort, split the two modules to shoulder-width and angle them slightly to achieve a neutral wrist angle. Separate the modules to shoulder width for an ergonomic typing experience.</p>

<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;"><br></h3>
<h3 style="text-align: left;" class="titleComp" data-mce-style="text-align: left;">Features</h3>
<ul style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;" data-mce-style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;">
<li style="text-align: left;">20″ Split (Hidden storage compartment stores excess cable)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">NEW- 16.8M Color Per-Key RGB Backlighting\</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">NEW- 10 fully customizable Lighting Effects: Freestyle, Monochrome, RGB Wave, RGB Spectrum,</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">Pulse, Loop, Rebound, Rain, Breathe, and Starlight</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">Genuine Cherry MX RGB Mechanical Switches\</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">Fully-Programmable with the SmartSet Programming Engine (No software or drivers)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">9 Customizable Profiles (Layouts & Lighting)</li>
<li style="text-align: left;">NEW- Enhanced layout with Escape position over tilde and an extra programmable double-wide Game Key</li>
